chapters.title: Chapter 201: A small Favour
paragraphs: After the two 2nd legion rank humans had turned into soul wraiths, Vritra raised all the other corpses into soul wraiths and kept them for now to feed them to Bob and Bobby, then he merged all the collected weapons into his axes.
Finally done with all the work he needed to do, Vritra was ready to leave this inheritance. Now the only question was whether the empress would wait for him outside.

"Let’s move close to the portal, she isn’t someone who would hide her aura wherever she goes so I will be able to sense her presence just from there." Yasmine said, as she started leading him towards the exit.

Vritra’s speed was extremely fast even without Shift or anything else, he covered a large distance within seconds. It didn’t take them long before they had finally arrived at the exit portal, it seemed like a crack in the space, and couldn’t be seen from the other side.
"Let’s go." Vritra touched the space crack and his hand easily passed through it, he moved half of his body to the other side and waited for Yasmine to make sure.

After a couple of minutes, Yasmine finally spoke: "She really isn’t here, I thought she would wait a day or two even considering her impatient personality. I think a little less than a day has passed since we entered the inheritance."

"She also got Null, her strength must be even higher now. But once my level increases I will meet her again." Vritra mumbled to himself as he walked out of the crack and found himself floating in the sky.
It was the same place from where Yennefer had abducted him, though no one noticed him since there wasn’t a big commotion like when the empress had come out.
[Fourth Dimension activated.]

Vritra disappeared and started flying directly towards the place his mother and the others were staying at. As the two observed the roads, they noticed that only the guards of the Blue Kingdom remained there now, all the other strong presences had disappeared completely.
"I guess since the empress’s work is done, they all went back. Even Han Gratt must have left. Well, that’s a good thing." Vritra said as he arrived close to the suite.
"Yeah that takes away one of the threats. Now if we don’t end up against the Grieves, then the king should be the only danger. How are you planning to deal with him, hubby?" Yasmine questioned.

"With my current strength I can kill him directly if I wish, but that would pull even more dangers, so it would be better if I could get him killed indirectly." He replied. Vritra had a plan but a few key pieces were still missing.
"And how are you going to do it?" the beautiful dragon lady asked.
"Hmm... Oh, there he is. I didn’t expect him to still be lingering around this place." Vritra said as he saw Rich walking the market streets with an intrigued expression.
Vritra removed the Fourth Dimension and flashed beside Rich, who was too busy observing various shops.
"Hey, how have you been?" Vritra spoke, startling Rich as he jumped to the side and only relaxed upon seeing that it was Jin Woo. Of course, Vritra had already changed the appearance of his face.

"Oh Jin Woo, it is you!! Congratulations for winning the competition, I really didn’t expect you to perform so well. I tried looking for you earlier to congratulate but I couldn’t." Rich said as a big smile appeared on his face.
"Thank you but... sigh." Vritra shook his head while releasing an exhausted sigh, looking very miserable.
"Oh, what’s wrong?" Rich asked. He looked like an innocent boy from a very prominent family who had never seen the evil of the world, though he was certainly not a fool.

"You know the gift that I received after my victory, that storage glyph, I ended up losing it somehow. Sigh, it is all my fault. I don’t care about the other things but the emblem provided to me by that mystery man is also lost. Now everything was for nothing, and I don’t know what to do." Vritra said, trying to make sense of his doubt about this Rich guy.
"Oh no, that’s too bad. How did you lose it? Can’t you find it again?" Rich asked, showing concern.
"I can’t find it anywhere. As for how, I was chasing after a demon and in the fight, I lost it somewhere." Vritra said, sighing again.
"Ah, this situation is really troubling." Rich said while observing Vritra to see if he really didn’t have the emblem, and he really didn’t sense it on Vritra.
"I know someone who could help you, but how do I find you?" Rich said after a moment.
"I am not sure, I move all over the kingdom and might even leave it soon." Vritra said, shrugging his shoulder.

"Hmm... Then take this for now. When you inject mana into it, I’ll be informed of your location. I will come and find you." From his pocket, Rich took out a similar-looking white token and handed it to Vritra.
"Keep it, it doesn’t have any direct way to find your location. Unless you inject your mana into it, no one could detect you." Yasmine said. Having this emblem would definitely be helpful later.

"Thank you, I will inform you after two days." Vritra said with a grateful smile, and now knew for sure that this guy was far from simple. He should also be from the emperor’s family or some family of similar status.

After talking for a bit more, Vritra walked away, arriving in front of the inn. He sensed the presence of all four of the soul wraiths, and even the three women. He heaved a sigh of relief that the king didn’t try anything while he was away.

Just as he was about to step into the building, Vritra’s ears pricked as he heard some distant shouts. Scanning his surroundings, he soon found the cause of the problem. It was some man whose bull seemed to have gone mad. They were rampaging on the market street.
"Just in time, I really needed his help." Vritra’s lips curled into an evil smile as he sensed Monk Shitless’s presence. In the plan to kill the king, he was his biggest card.

Before meeting his mother, Fiona, and the goddess, Vritra decided to help the poor monk. His body disappeared in the next moment, and then he appeared in the sky right above the street in which the bull was running.
Vritra landed softly at the end of the street as the bull continued to charge forward. The guards hadn’t arrived there yet. The bull charged forward madly, it seemed quite mad for some reason.
As it got close to the street’s end, the bull saw Vritra standing there calmly and with all its might the bull applied its brakes, sensing a deadly aura around Vritra.
The bull’s feet skidded over the ground and finally it came to a halt, but the passenger on top of it was still screaming as he got thrown off and landed in front of Vritra.
"Oh hello there, pitiful one. Shitless here, hehe." Monk looked up from his feet and spoke while coughing out mud.
"Sir Shitless, can you do me a small favour?" Vritra asked, extending a hand forward like an evil and fraud merchant.

chapters.title: Chapter 202: The Evil Monk
paragraphs: "Sir Shitless, can you do me a small favour?" Vritra asked, extending a hand forward like an evil and fraudulent merchant.
The semi-innocent monk took Vritra’s hand and stood up before asking curiously: "What kind of favour?"
"If you help me, you will get to see a lot of chaos and you might become the biggest factor resulting in the death of the king.
This time, you would be the one creating the ultimate chaos, and all you have to do is help me a bit—just a little. It’s really a minuscule help," Vritra said.
"Oh, I am getting really excited. Just tell me already what I have to do. I will do anything," Monk Shitless said, his smile widening just at the mention of the wordchaos.
"Anything?" Vritra asked, the evil becoming more evident on his face.

"Uh... Y-Yeah, almost anything." Seeing Vritra’s smile, Monk Shitless was now a little unsure. Even though he loved chaos, it was only if others were involved in it—he didn’t want to become the victim of the same chaos.
"Good, then you just need to..." Vritra explained his plan to Shitless.
"W-W-What? That’s impossibly absurd! I can’t do that. I am a monk, no way." Monk Shitless shook his head so hard that any lingering traces of hair on his head fell off.
"You are a fallen monk, and you are Shitless the Greatest. You don’t give a shit about anything, right? Don’t you want to create chaos, put the entire kingdom in trouble, and become really famous?
Imagine walking on the streets and people shouting, ’There goes the most evil monk in the world, the harbinger of chaos,’" Vritra said, putting a hand over Shitless’s shoulder.
"..." Monk Shitless’s eyes were shining brightly as he imagined that dazzling future. He really would love to be calledevilas he walked over the streets.
"Would you help me?" Vritra asked after saying a few more coaxing words, even using the Natural Hypnosis to slightly shift his thinking.
"Fine, but there won’t be any danger, right?" Monk Shitless asked, still looking a bit unsure.

"Of course there won’t be any danger. No one would even touch you, and I will send one of my strongest fighters to protect you secretly. You really have nothing to fear, and as the greatest Shitless, you should be more daring," Vritra added, with a nonchalant expression.
"Okay, I will do it, pitiful one. I believe you." Monk Shitless nodded vigorously.
"Good, good. Just believe in me." Vritra shook hands with the monk, then the two walked towards the building where Vritra had booked the suite.
He booked another room there for the monk, where he and his mad bull were staying. After locking Monk Shitless in his room, Vritra made his way to meet up with his mother and the others.
After climbing to the floor above, he knocked on the door and called out to his mother and Fiona.
Soon, hurried footsteps sounded from inside, and then the door opened. Fiona was the first to pounce on him, as she wrapped her arms around him and hugged him tightly.
Vanessa and Diana also appeared at the door. Just from seeing him, the two women somehow had the feeling that he had become incredibly strong.
"Where did you disappear off to for four days?" Fiona hugged him tightly and asked, looking really upset that she wasn’t able to feel him for so long.
"Four days?!!" Vritra asked in surprise. It should have been around a day. He didn’t stay that long inside the inheritance ground, so he asked again.
"Have I really been gone for four days?"
"Yeah, it’s almost been four days. I was starting to get really worried about you." Vanessa stepped forward. As Fiona let go, she hugged her son.
’Wifey, am I missing something? It shouldn’t be more than a day, right?’ Vritra asked in confusion.
"Yeah, we were only there for around a day... I wonder if it’s because of the inheritance ground or wait—" Both Yasmine and Vritra came to the same conclusion almost at the same time.
’It’s because of Null. Don’t tell me when I used that ability, I accidentally travelled a little forward in time,’ he thought.
"There is a high chance that is the case. I guess that’s why Yennefer wasn’t outside. With her patience level, she wouldn’t have waited more than a day outside.
You shouldn’t use that skill too often. Imagine if instead of two to three days, you travelled two or three centuries ahead," Yasmine said. This ability was definitely too strange.
GULP
Vritra really felt a slight chill. He really needed to be extremely careful with this Null ability. Imagine him accidentally disrupting the time stream and bringing chaos everywhere.
’Yeah, I will use that more cautiously from now on,’ Vritra thought, as he closed his eyes and relaxed in his mother’s soft embrace.
"Nothing happened while I was gone, right?" he asked.
"Yes, at least not around us. But the Blue Kingdom has been quite lively ever since the empress came out of that crack in space for the third time.

Strange things have been happening all over the kingdom, and I heard something like... the inheritances have been opening," Diana answered as she took a step forward, hoping to get a hug from him too.
"Anyway, I think it is time that all three of you should get stronger too. So tomorrow we will be going to another city and into the castle, after which we will hunt demons," Vritra announced.
"Huh? The castle? But wasn’t the king trying to spy on us? I thought he had ill motives towards us. Should we really be going to his home?" Vanessa asked in surprise.
"Yeah, don’t worry about that. We should be living in a better place, and getting all sorts of resources there would be much easier," he answered and wondered:

’It would be so good if I can turn these three into demons. Then they would gain level no matter what they kill. Becoming a demon doesn’t really have any sort of negative effect aside from becoming the world enemy. Hmm, I guess I can only take things slowly.’
It was still around noon, so the sun was high in the sky, and the streets were bustling with crowds.
’Oh right, I wonder if that inheritance ground has also opened. Ghoul, go and check,’ Vritra ordered in his mind as a shadow flew out from under his feet.
He had given the names Ghoul and Ghost to his two new Soul Wraiths. Their strength was top-notch, and they were worth keeping for now.

Remembering something, he checked the status of his other Soul Wraiths and found that all three of them—Dark Knight, Hellmancer, and the Chimera—had already reached the 1st legion rank, and they were still leveling up constantly.
Dark Knight, Hellmancer, Chimera, Bob, Bobby, Ghost, and Ghoul—these were the stack of his current Soul Wraiths. The rest were just food for them, even the two spies from the king.
"Mom, let’s eat. I am feeling really hungry," Vritra said. All the meat in his inventory was from low-level demons. He felt that now it was time to refill it.
The group of four soon walked down to eat together.

chapters.title: Chapter 203: Sweet~
paragraphs: After eating, Vritra left the hotel along with Monk Shitless to prepare for the next day, while the women returned to their rooms. Even they weren’t sure what Vritra had planned.
Monk Shitless and Vritra searched through the market and soon found the perfect shop they were searching for. The two entered, and after a few hours, they came out.
Then Vritra and Shitless made their way back to the hotel after shopping for a few more things.

"I-Is this really alright? I am a monk, you know. I can’t be doing such things... ugh, everyone is staring at me," Monk Shitless asked in a low voice, gazing around at the people that kept staring at him.
"It is perfectly fine. Don’t worry and just follow along with our plan. It won’t be long before everyone knows of your evil deeds—the greatest devil Monk Shitless," Vritra said, patting his shoulder.
Silently, they made their way back to the hotel. Monk Shitless went straight to his room, as if escaping from some nightmare, and Vritra climbed up the floor and returned to his room.

First, he decided to spend some time with Fiona. He knocked on her door and waited. The redhead soon opened the door and smiled joyfully. She grabbed his hand and pulled him inside before shutting the door.
Pulling him onto the bed, she cuddled into his arms, burying her face into his neck and wrapping her arms around him, coiling her legs around his.

"I missed you so much, my darling..." Fiona spoke, her lips brushing against his skin. She loved feeling him so close, as if their bodies were melting into one, as she completely wrapped herself in his fragrance.

Vritra gently pressed his lips against her forehead and closed his eyes, just losing himself in the warm feeling of his lover’s body. It was definitely one of the best decisions to take such a good girl away from that degenerate Max.
"Mmm, I love you," Vritra whispered into her ear, his breath tingling her senses as Fiona smiled sweetly, snuggling even closer to him.
"I brought a small gift for you," Vritra said as a small box appeared in his hand. He had bought it just earlier in the market.
"Oh, what is it?" Fiona pulled her face back a bit and glanced at the box, smiling brightly at getting a gift from him. It was such a nice feeling.
Sitting up, she took the wooden box from his hands and excitedly started opening it. Her eyes instantly brightened as she exclaimed: "Chocolates? They exist in this world too?"

"Yeah, I was a little surprised too, but there have been people from Earth on this planet so I guess it makes sense," Vritra said before adding, "And I remember you loved to eat chocolates a lot when we were in school before."
"You know that!! I thought you had no interest in others," Fiona exclaimed, feeling even happier.

"Yeah, you sat not far from me and you were often eating them, looking very joyful. So I brought some for you. Give it a try, I’m not sure if it tastes the same," Vritra said as he sat up with his back against the pillow.
Fiona picked one of the spherical chocolate pieces and removed its wrap before throwing it into her mouth. She released a delighted sound at the sweet taste exploding on her taste buds.
"Mmmm, Iks gook," Fiona spoke, then pointed for Vritra to try one too from the box, while rolling the chocolate piece around her tongue.
"Then let me try it too," Vritra said as he leaned forward. Sliding an arm along her waist, he suddenly pulled her forward and captured her sweet, moist lips.

Fiona was surprised and froze as Vritra’s tongue nimbly entered her mouth, but she came to her senses as his tongue gently rubbed against hers. The redhead’s cheeks became red as she pulled the piece of chocolate back along with her tongue, while his tongue continued to march forward into her mouth.

And so began the great battle in Fiona’s mouth. Vritra swept his tongue over hers and took the piece of chocolate while Fiona followed his tongue, entangling with his and trying to take back her chocolate.
"Mmmm~ SLURP GULP Hmmm~" Their salivas and the chocolate became a sweet mess in her mouth as the two sucked hard and rolled their tongues over one another, fighting over that single piece.
After a minute or so, Vritra finally became the victor as he took the chocolate from her mouth and pulled back, tasting the chocolate as he spoke.
"Hmmm, it tastes even better than the ones back on Earth, maybe because you fed it to me."
"Y-You stole it from me!!" Fiona was still baffled at the whole thing, her face flushed red at the intimate exchange.
"Well, the chocolate and the owner of this chocolate, my lovely Fiona, are both mine. So I can eat them whenever I want, right?" Vritra asked, giving a peck on her lips.
"Hmm." Fiona nodded shyly as she picked another piece of chocolate.
"Sigh, what a pity. I wish I could also get a treat like that," Yasmine said with a pitiful sigh, but it was a good thing that Vritra’s strength was increasing so rapidly.
It won’t be too long before they could return to her home and she would be able to get her body back.
’I will remember to bring chocolates for you when you finally get a body. How could I forget my first wife,’ Vritra replied, wishing to help her as soon as possible.
Pulling Fiona into his arms, Vritra lay on the bed, as the two just enjoyed each other’s presence in silence.
"I feel like you have grown much stronger..." Fiona mumbled.
"Sure I have." Vritra answered while his fingers continued to comb through her long, smooth red hair.
After a few moments, Fiona brought her face closer to his and gave a kiss on his cheek. Her face was bright red as she asked:
"Uhm... Do you want to do it?"

Vritra smiled. While caressing her cheek, he spoke: "But are you really ready? I think we need to spend more time together, fall even deeper in love, and know each other completely before we take that step.

It’s not like either of us is running off to somewhere, and you are going to be with me for the rest of our lives—whether you want to or not. You didn’t have a choice since the moment you accepted me."
"...Okay." Fiona finally relaxed. There was a little bit of fear in her heart that she didn’t want to think about.
With how fast Vritra was growing, Fiona felt that she would be left behind while he continued to move forward, and she didn’t like that thought one bit.
But now, she felt at ease, as if his words could never be wrong.
She rested her head over his chest and listened to the beating of his heart—hearts?!!
THUMP THUMP
THUMP THUMP
Surprised, she raised her head and looked at Vritra’s relaxed face before asking in confusion: "Did the chocolate contain alcohol or are there really two hearts in your chest?"
Vritra smiled. He lightly pinched the cheeks of his cute and innocent but naughty redhead, while speaking: "Well, that’s a long story. Let’s start from the beginning..."

chapters.title: Chapter 204: Hard Working
paragraphs: "Woah, so much has happened with you after coming to this world?!!" Fiona exclaimed after hearing everything Vritra shared, from falling into the trap to coming to this place.
The redhead was filled with anger after hearing it all; she really wanted to burn a few people to death.

"I can’t believe that rotten king did that to you—to all of us. He really deserved to die. And that mighty goddess, Diana, she even tried to kill you? Hmph, let me burn her up a bit. I will make her regret it.

Then that bastard Max, I can’t believe he tried to kill you for no reason. What a scum. Is he dead yet? If not, let’s go back and kill him." Fiona was fuming with rage, and Vritra barely held her back from bursting out of the room and attacking Diana.
"Sigh, I guess going through so much danger is the reason you became so strong, darling. No matter what, I will always be with you," Fiona said while hugging him tightly.

Except for the existence of his dragon waifu, Vritra had told her almost all of his secrets, just like he did with Vanessa. It felt much better not to hide all this from his small family—it was such a relaxing feeling.
Though Yasmine’s presence still needed to be a secret, since if any of them even accidentally said anything, Yasmine’s life might really get in danger then.
After spending some more time with Fiona, Vritra returned to his room. Vanessa was waiting patiently there.

As soon as he entered, she placed her arms over his shoulders and, taking a deep breath, she asked: "Hmm, aside from Fiona, I can smell the delicious smell of chocolate. Did you not bring any for your mother?"
She asked with a slight pout. Of course, she could also smell a faint scent of a different woman.

"Haha, of course I did. How could I forget my sweet mommy?" Vritra smiled as he pulled another box of chocolates. He opened the box and unwrapped one of the pieces before bringing it close to her juicy lips.
"Aaah~" Vanessa released a seductive sound as she took the chocolate in her mouth and even licked his finger sensually, before giving a kiss on his lips.
The pair of mother and son shared kisses and chocolates as they started a training session after not meeting for so long. Their training was even more intense than the ones before.

In the morning the next day, Vritra, Monk Shitless and the others ate breakfast together while he explained their plan to the group. All the women looked strangely at Monk Shitless, wondering how he could agree to such a thing. Fiona couldn’t help but ask:
"Are you really a Monk? Or is that just your name or something?"
"Um..." Monk Shitless was on the verge of refusing again, when Vritra spoke:
"Our great devil Monk Shitless is the evil main character of this plan. No one is allowed to judge him."
Diana shook her head, looking pitifully at the Monk, but she didn’t have any good impression of that baldy so she decided not to interfere in this task.
"Now, that’s all there is to it. We can leave for the castle right away if all of you are ready." Vritra said as he clapped his hands and changed the topic.
"But won’t the king recognize me? I don’t think he saw my face before, but he was still staring at me so strangely. I wonder how he found out about that," Vanessa spoke with a pondering expression.
"Yeah, you don’t have to worry about that. This time he won’t recognize you," Vritra replied with confidence. After a short discussion, all of them were ready to leave.
After finding a rather big carriage, Vritra paid the money and so the journey began.
To arrive at the castle, they needed to reach another city and travel for almost 12 hours, so by the time they arrived it would already be evening.
"Let’s wreck havoc in the castle now, and the first step to that goes through the crown prince," Yasmine said excitedly. She really wished to see some action.
I am Henry Junior 1st, the biggest achievement of my life is being born before all my siblings. That alone made me the crown prince of the Blue Kingdom.
But I worked really hard to raise my level by killing the nearly dead demons my guards brought.
I worked even harder to show my father how good I am at politics and tactics by sharing various schemes developed by my advisors.
Just my appearance could defeat all my siblings, yet I never stopped growing—trying to prove to my father that I am the best candidate by gathering various kinds of talents under me.
I have lived for more than ninety years and have long crossed into the 1st Legion rank.
I married a woman according to my father’s wish even though I didn’t like her one bit. She was a bit too old for me and a little too fat, but it was what my father wanted.
My hard work paid off and I had a son on the first try. I made my father proud by showing my ability, proving again that I am indeed the perfect king.

Today I wasn’t expecting any new guests. I was just in my office working hard—watching my advisors do all my basic work while I focused on important things like planning a second son to make my father happy.

Just while I was about to crack the code, a guard knocked on the door. It did break my concentration and my second son disappeared. I was in the mood to execute the guard right there and then, but I needed to show my patience to my father.
So I held it.
I was informed that some important guests had come to meet me, so I had no choice but to end my hard work and stop imagining as I walked out of the office and towards the entrance of the castle.
Normally, as the next king, I wouldn’t welcome anyone at the gate personally, but this guest had the marked ring of my father, so of course I had to treat him with the best of my ability.
After arriving at the door, I found that it was none other than Jin Woo, the person who is considered the biggest talent of the Blue Kingdom—the same man I had personally tried to recruit.
Beside him were three women with their faces covered with veils, though I could tell they must be really beautiful from the sight of their eyes.
But I am not like my father who drools over every woman. After nodding at them, I looked at the last person of the group.
And then I saw her!!
I fell hard the moment I looked into those brown eyes, those long brown hair, that smooth milky skin, those large jugs—cough, that heavy bosom, that voluptuous body, and those luscious lips.
The moment our eyes met, I knew I had fallen in love and I needed to get this beautiful woman for myself.
Before I knew it, I was standing in front of her as I extended my right hand toward her for a handshake—but secretly I just wanted to touch her buttery skin.

chapters.title: Chapter 205: Shit-Sonia
paragraphs: After an almost twelve hours’ travel, Vritra and the others had finally arrived at the entrance of the castle. The security here was several times higher when compared to the Dunshire Kingdom; even the guards’ levels were higher.
Upon their arrival, several guards approached them and began asking questions — asking for their names, the reason for their arrival, and many other things.
But as soon as Vritra showed the ring that King Henry had given him after he won the competition, they became a lot more respectful and allowed Vritra to head inside directly.
"Currently the king is busy in an important meeting, so if you wish to meet him, then you will have to wait a little," one of the guards informed with a slight bow of his head.
"I see. Can you tell me who he is meeting?" Vritra asked casually.

"I am sorry, but even we don’t know that. Do you wish to enter the castle, or should we call someone out for you?" the same guard asked, glancing at the four women standing beside Vritra. They all seemed really beautiful.
"Oh, it’s alright. Can you call the crown prince outside? He had asked me to come meet him after the competition," Vritra said, smiling as he noticed the guard’s gaze focused on the fourth woman.
"Y-Yes, I can do that. Please give me a couple of minutes." Feeling flustered upon getting caught gazing at the brown-haired woman, he stuttered and ran away in haste.
’Wifey, everything is going fine, right?’ Vritra asked in his mind.
"Yes, surprisingly, you learned to create an energy barrier rather fast, and it seems to be working as intended. I am sure the king wouldn’t be able to sense anything out of the ordinary,"
Yasmine replied confidently. She had taught Vritra to use his energy to create a few types of barriers — like barriers to conceal one’s presence, lock sound, block attacks, and so on.

Vritra learned it all quickly, and now the two of them had created a barrier that would completely hide any trace of the succubus’s bloodline and physique from the others. It would even lower their beauty in the eyes of others.
This effect was added by Vritra using his Natural Hypnosis skill, so Vanessa, Fiona, and Diana weren’t really attracting much attention towards themselves.

As the guard ran away, Vritra and the others waited for a few minutes. Finally, the guard returned at the same pace. He took a couple of breaths before speaking: "The crown prince is coming here. Please wait a bit longer."
And soon the crown prince, Henry Junior 1st, came into sight. He was followed by many of his guards and advisors, walking with pride in each step — acting as if he was already the king.

"..." Vritra stood silently and observed the prince. After arriving before them, he also began to gaze at the group of five. His gaze moved from Diana, Fiona, and Vanessa, then back onto Fiona, and finally landed on the final member of their group.
And right at that moment, his eyes widened, and an awestruck expression appeared on his face. He seemed to be struck in some sort of trance and just stood there like a fool.
Then he started walking forward in a daze and stopped right in front of the brown-haired woman. Like an idiot, he extended his right hand and waited.

"Prince, sorry for coming so late, but travel here was longer than we expected. Thank you for coming out to meet me," Vritra said, and finally the prince’s gaze tore away from the brown-haired girl, who seemed quite shy.
He took a few steps back and stood at a comfortable distance from them, coughing to remove the awkwardness.

"Ah... It is no trouble. I am really happy that you actually came to meet me, Jin Woo. With your talent, I was sure you would turn my offer down. You are going to be so popular in the near future." The prince narrowed his eyes and then spoke with a big smile while extending his right hand towards him:
"Congratulations, it seems you have finally entered the elite ranks by becoming a Legion. Haha, you certainly are very talented. You are definitely going to rise very high."
Vritra nodded and shook hands with the prince.
"Thank you, prince. I am very happy that you think like that," Vritra said with a flattering smile.
{Sin Point Gained: Envious +28}
{Sin Point Gained: Praised +34}

After sharing a few more flattering words, the crown prince cleared his throat and spoke: "Uhm... Why don’t you introduce your group? Ah right, I am Henry Jr 1st, as you know — the crown prince of the Blue Kingdom."
"Who doesn’t know our crown prince? Anyway, I am Jin Woo, and these three are my women," Vritra said as he pointed toward Diana, Fiona, and Vanessa.
Hearing this, two of the three were really surprised. Vanessa stood without any reaction, but Diana and Fiona were shocked.
Diana was shocked because she didn’t think he would introduce her as his woman — but for some reason, it felt good... to be called his woman.
While Fiona glanced at the other two women, since she had a deep feeling that he wasn’t lying when he said that just now.
Vritra didn’t speak much about the three of them and, skipping even over their names, he shifted to the final woman.
"And this right here is my sister. She is Shit— Sonia, my older sister," Vritra corrected himself. That name was too hard to forget after all.
"Shit Sonia? What a great name..." the crown prince spoke in a daze while looking into the eyes of Monk Shitless, who was dressed up like a beautiful, voluptuous woman.

With long brown hair, big boobs and ass, a beautiful face after a lot of makeup, and that alluring aura — the makeup artist needed to put a lot of effort into making him look this good. Then Vritra created a barrier that increased his charms even more.
"No, she is just Sonia," Vritra added.
"Oh ’Just Sonia’? What a wonderful name, just the name from my dreams..." the crown prince said while staring dazedly into those brown eyes that were no less bewitching than a succubus’s.

’Hmm. It is working better than I expected. I didn’t think the crown prince would fall for our evil monk so fast and so badly. He is already a lost cause, and controlling him will be so much easier in the future.’ Vritra thought as his evil smile flashed for a moment before disappearing altogether.
"Hello, I am Sonia. Nice to meet you, Sir Henry Jr. I have heard a lot about you. I will be in your care for a while — of course, if you don’t mind."
Fluttering her long eyelashes, Sonia combed her fingers through her long hair and spoke in a seductive tone, her scent making the prince drunk.

"OH!! Hello Sonia, I am Sonia- I mean Henry Jr 1st, the crown prince. Yes yes, I could take care of you for the rest of my life— cough, I mean, Jin Woo, can you tell me your reason behind coming here?" the crown prince asked, while his gaze remained on the beautiful Monk Shitless.

Vritra learned it all quickly, and now the two of them had created a barrier that would completely hide any trace of the succubus’s bloodline and physique from the others.
It would even lower their beauty in the eyes of others.
This effect was added by Vritra using his Natural Hypnosis skill, so Vanessa, Fiona, and Diana weren’t really attracting much attention towards themselves.
As the guard ran away, Vritra and the others waited for a few minutes.
Finally, the guard returned at the same pace.
He took a couple of breaths before speaking: "The crown prince is coming here.
Please wait a bit longer."
And soon the crown prince, Henry Junior 1st, came into sight.
He was followed by many of his guards and advisors, walking with pride in each step — acting as if he was already the king.
"..." Vritra stood silently and observed the prince.
After arriving before them, he also began to gaze at the group of five.
His gaze moved from Diana, Fiona, and Vanessa, then back onto Fiona, and finally landed on the final member of their group.
And right at that moment, his eyes widened, and an awestruck expression appeared on his face.
He seemed to be struck in some sort of trance and just stood there like a fool.
Then he started walking forward in a daze and stopped right in front of the brown-haired woman.
Like an idiot, he extended his right hand and waited.
"Prince, sorry for coming so late, but travel here was longer than we expected.
Thank you for coming out to meet me," Vritra said, and finally the prince’s gaze tore away from the brown-haired girl, who seemed quite shy.
He took a few steps back and stood at a comfortable distance from them, coughing to remove the awkwardness.
It is no trouble.
I am really happy that you actually came to meet me, Jin Woo.
With your talent, I was sure you would turn my offer down.
You are going to be so popular in the near future." The prince narrowed his eyes and then spoke with a big smile while extending his right hand towards him:
"Congratulations, it seems you have finally entered the elite ranks by becoming a Legion.
Haha, you certainly are very talented.
You are definitely going to rise very high."
Vritra nodded and shook hands with the prince.
"Thank you, prince.
I am very happy that you think like that," Vritra said with a flattering smile.
{Sin Point Gained: Envious +28}
{Sin Point Gained: Praised +34}
After sharing a few more flattering words, the crown prince cleared his throat and spoke: "Uhm...
Why don’t you introduce your group?
Ah right, I am Henry Jr 1st, as you know — the crown prince of the Blue Kingdom."
"Who doesn’t know our crown prince?
Anyway, I am Jin Woo, and these three are my women," Vritra said as he pointed toward Diana, Fiona, and Vanessa.
Hearing this, two of the three were really surprised.
Vanessa stood without any reaction, but Diana and Fiona were shocked.
Diana was shocked because she didn’t think he would introduce her as his woman — but for some reason, it felt good... to be called his woman.
While Fiona glanced at the other two women, since she had a deep feeling that he wasn’t lying when he said that just now.
Vritra didn’t speak much about the three of them and, skipping even over their names, he shifted to the final woman.
"And this right here is my sister.
She is Shit— Sonia, my older sister," Vritra corrected himself.
That name was too hard to forget after all.
"Shit Sonia?
What a great name..." the crown prince spoke in a daze while looking into the eyes of Monk Shitless, who was dressed up like a beautiful, voluptuous woman.
With long brown hair, big boobs and ass, a beautiful face after a lot of makeup, and that alluring aura — the makeup artist needed to put a lot of effort into making him look this good.
Then Vritra created a barrier that increased his charms even more.
"No, she is just Sonia," Vritra added.
"Oh ’Just Sonia’?
What a wonderful name, just the name from my dreams..." the crown prince said while staring dazedly into those brown eyes that were no less bewitching than a succubus’s.
’Hmm.
It is working better than I expected.
I didn’t think the crown prince would fall for our evil monk so fast and so badly.
He is already a lost cause, and controlling him will be so much easier in the future.’ Vritra thought as his evil smile flashed for a moment before disappearing altogether.
"Hello, I am Sonia.
Nice to meet you, Sir Henry Jr.
I have heard a lot about you.
I will be in your care for a while — of course, if you don’t mind."
Fluttering her long eyelashes, Sonia combed her fingers through her long hair and spoke in a seductive tone, her scent making the prince drunk.
"OH!!
Hello Sonia, I am Sonia- I mean Henry Jr 1st, the crown prince.

Yes yes, I could take care of you for the rest of my life— cough, I mean, Jin Woo, can you tell me your reason behind coming here?" the crown prince asked, while his gaze remained on the beautiful Monk Shitless.

chapters.title: Chapter 206: Investigators
paragraphs: "Yes, actually, if you don’t mind, I wish to stay in the castle for a short while. I need to borrow a few resources while I stay. Of course, I will help you with any tasks you have for me. But if it’s not okay, I will immediately leave along with my sister," Vritra said, releasing a tired sigh.
"Huh? Of course you can stay here, who can say no to that?" Henry said hastily. How could he separate from the love of his life just after meeting her?

’Sob, why me?!! Why do I have to pretend to be a woman? I am a monk for demon’s sake. I can’t believe I have to do this, but... Vritra is a little scary. If I didn’t agree, he really might have turned me into a eunuch.’ Monk Shitless thought, feeling really uncomfortable in this appearance.
"By the way, Sonia, are you single?" Henry asked, trying to sound as casual as possible.
"Of course she is completely single and ready to mingle—I mean, she has reached the age of marriage and we are looking for the perfect husband for her," Vritra said before continuing.
"Someone handsome, rich, strong, from a good family, respectful, kind, caring..."
Each quality Vritra pointed out, the crown prince compared it to himself and felt his chest swell with confidence. He wondered who could be a better husband for the beautiful Sonia than himself.
"Why are you waiting here? Let’s go inside. I will prepare rooms for you immediately—the best ones in the castle.
Well, my father is currently in a meeting or I would have brought you all to him and asked to marry—cough, anyway, let’s go," the crown prince said and led them toward the castle.
He walked beside the irritated Monk Shitless and pointed toward various things, singing songs of praise for himself.
Vritra had given Bob to Shitless for safety. It wouldn’t be good if the prince actually made some move on the poor monk—that was no part of the plan.
The loyalty of the crown prince toward his kingdom and the king was famous all over the land. He wouldn’t do anything that his father objected to.
But a woman could easily sow discord between two men, and this work was given to the Monk. Vritra planned to use the crown prince to murder the king.
Though it would take a little more time than just directly killing him, it was a safer option, while he could also use all sorts of resources.

’Wifey, it is time to raise your level and empty the storages of this kingdom. The treasures here should be much better than the previous kingdom. After I have gotten a rough idea of this place, we will do it. I wonder how much of your strength will return this time.’ Vritra thought while following the prince into the castle.

"If there are no external people here, then you can easily handle almost everyone with your current strength," Yasmine said. Vritra was getting stronger so fast, especially after obtaining that divine sin wheel—his strength had just skyrocketed.
For now, others might not treat him like a big threat, even after the rumors of him being the next demon lord spread.
But if they were to know his growth rate, they would certainly bring Vritra to the top positions of their kill list.
"This is our humble abode. Do you like it, Shit—I mean Sonia?" the crown prince asked as he pointed toward the majestic castle, feeling even prouder.
He glanced at Vritra and wanted to appear good in the eyes of his future brother-in-law. Then he began to speak of his achievements, though almost all of them were done by the people working for him.

’Oh right, when I was fighting those people in the Dunshire Kingdom, why didn’t they use their full strength? I felt that they were much stronger than that, but despite getting beaten so badly, they didn’t go all out,’ Vritra asked, ignoring the crown prince.

"There is a rule set by an organization—that the strength they can display in particular kingdoms can’t cross a certain level. If the Golden Moon is the government and police among the humans of this world, then that organization is the one that makes sure everything is going fine.

They only interfere in big matters which involve the lives of millions or more. They make moves secretly, and each member is extremely strong. They hold equal or probably more power than the human emperor himself.

Well, with your luck, we will be meeting them sooner or later—but it’s better to stay away from them," Yasmine explained. This world was too big, and giving all the information to him just wasn’t possible or optimal.
’Oh, sounds like a troublesome organization. What are they called?’ Vritra asked as he sensed several footsteps getting closer.
"It is called..." After a dramatic pause, she added: "The Divine Kage Organization!!"

’Oh, Divine?!! I wonder if it is related to that Divine—’ Vritra’s thoughts paused as he saw a group of men walking toward them. Among them, the king looked the most eye-catching because of his flashy appearance.
"Father, is your meeting finished?" the crown prince asked with a respectful bow of his head.

"Hmm, do we have guests? Yes, I was seeing our important guests out—oh, is that Jin Woo? I didn’t expect to see you so soon, young man." The king laughed and patted Vritra’s shoulder before looking at all the people standing beside him.
Vritra observed the group of four that was walking beside the king. They wore ordinary clothes, but their strength seemed far from ordinary, and they certainly weren’t from this kingdom.
"Thank you, my lord. This time I came here to meet the crown prince. Ah, and this is my family," Vritra said as he focused on Henry’s expression.

After gazing at Diana and Fiona, his gaze moved to Vanessa, and after narrowing his eyes as if he remembered something, he continued to look further. Thankfully, he didn’t recognize Vanessa nor could he sense the aura or whatever of a succubus on her.
"Oh, and who is this?" Henry asked as his gaze landed on Monk Shitless, who felt as if he was about to cry.
When he was a man, no woman paid him any attention—but right after becoming a woman, a prince had already fallen for her, and now the king was in the process.

"Father, this is Jin Woo’s sister ’Just Sonia.’ They will be staying here in the castle for a while with us," the crown prince said as he hastily stepped forward. He was afraid that his father might take a liking to this woman.
"Oh, that’s good. Stay here as long as you want," Henry said, narrowing his gaze at the beautiful and busty Sonia. He could almost sense that same aura around her as he did before on Vanessa.
’Is she a succubus as well? I wasn’t able to get the last one. Looks like the gods sent the compensation right to my door. I won’t let it go this time,’ the king thought.
"Are you Jin Woo? I am from the Golden Moon, and we are investigating the death of King Aldric and thousands of innocent people," one of the four men stepped forward and spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 207: Confidential
paragraphs: "Well hello, Golden Moon folks. Jin Woo here. Sigh, you people are so useless, I still feel a shiver thinking that under your watch someone killed the king of an entire kingdom and even murdered thousands of innocent people," Vritra said, releasing a long sigh.
"We are shocked as well by the news of an emerging demon lord. Anyway, I am ’K’. Can you tell me a little about yourself?" K spoke, his face full of suspicion for absolutely no reason.
K looked like a middle-aged man who was getting fucked by life every single day. Even his hair was starting to disappear from the center of his head.

"Haha, sorry about my partner. I am J, by the way. He has a bad habit of suspecting everyone. Just earlier, he was even suspecting Henry of murdering his rival. And before that, he suspected me of killing the king so I can keep him busy for a while so I can eat his—" J began to chatter.
J was like the friendly neighbor who only knows how to start and not when to pause. He always carried a big smile on his face.

"Sigh. Enough, both of you. That is no way to treat the guest of King Henry. Be more respectful. Anyway, young man, I am ’O’. Are you a member of this kingdom?" O spoke. He seemed the oldest in the group and also the leader. The others seemed to respect him quite a bit.

"Yes, I was born in this kingdom, but since I love traveling, I am constantly moving all over the continent. That’s why I have spent more time outside than here," Vritra replied in a relaxed manner before asking:

"About those murders, how do you know about them? Did you see the corpses yourselves? And are you sure that new demon lord or whatever is the one responsible for it?" Vritra asked, showing genuine interest like a gossip.
"The corpses had been removed, but those men were from the Blue Kingdom and we have already made sure that they were killed in the Dunshire Kingdom after going there.
Well, we don’t know exactly who is responsible for all this, but Vritra from the Dunshire Kingdom is our biggest suspect right now, even for King Aldric’s death," O spoke.
"Oh, I wonder who gave you all that intel. There must be someone who told you about all this, right?" Vritra asked casually.
The fourth man stood silently in the corner, just tired of the entire mission; he just wanted to return home and lie down in bed while getting his salary for free.

"That is confidential information. You aren’t eligible to know that. But why do you even want to know all that? Are you the criminal?" J spoke, his brows furrowed. Just then, K plucked a bunch of hair from his head and placed them back while whistling.
"Well, I have heard a flying news. I heard in that incident..." Vritra began to speak as if he was about to disclose some big secret. After pausing and looking around, he continued in a low voice:
"Bone Blood Cult and the Nine Pacts were involved as well."
"Oh, and how do you know that? What is the source of your information?" J asked hurriedly, his eyes narrowing into thin lines.
"That is confidential information. You aren’t eligible to know that," Vritra said while shrugging his shoulder.
"You!!" J almost burst out in rage.
"Young man, is it really reliable information or were you only joking just now? Answer seriously," O asked in a solemn tone.
"I am 100% sure. If you change your starting point, you will get answers fast," Vritra said before glancing at the crown prince, who was trying to shield Sonia from his father’s prying gaze.
"Shall we go?" Vritra asked. These four men were certainly strong, almost as strong as Blunder and Faceless. It seemed Golden Moon was indeed taking this matter quite seriously.
"Yes yes, let’s go," the crown prince nodded. And after bowing towards the king and the four men, he began to lead them forward.
"Let’s go as well," the fourth man finally spoke as he started walking ahead of the others.

Soon, Vritra’s and the others’ rooms were arranged. Vritra and Vanessa took one room, Fiona and Diana were on either side of him, and Monk Shitless was a bit further away from them, his room quite close to the crown prince’s.

’Heh, since I am doing this, then I am going to make full use of my new power. I will make the crown prince dance over my fingertips and soon there will be chaos everywhere, kekekeke.’ Monk Shitless began to form his evil plan.

As Vritra saw his evil twisted smile, he wondered if he had awakened something strange in the monk. The first and most important promise Vritra made to him was to keep him safe even as the father or son tried to make a move on him. Monk Shitless was disgusted by just the thought of it.
All of them entered their rooms and made sure that everything was fine. Then a servant came to invite them all for dinner along with the crown prince.
Vritra and the four women walked out of their rooms and found the crown prince waiting not far away with a big smile. He kept stealing glances at Sonia.
"Prince, come here," Monk Shitless spoke while snapping his fingers, as if calling some servant.
"Prince, my feet hurt. Can you take off my shoe?" raising his right leg, he spoke.
Vritra and the others: "..."
This monk seemed to have gone off trail. His task now was to make the crown prince fall even harder for him, but he was acting strangely.
"Of course, Sonia, anything for you, hehe," the crown prince ran forward like a loyal puppy and knelt down, as he took off Sonia’s shoe.
’Keke, this might be more fun than I thought.’ Monk Shitless was already imagining ways he could torture the crown prince of such a large kingdom.
Vritra shook his head but didn’t interrupt. It was Shitless’s duty to control the prince and get him to kill the king, no matter how he wanted to do it.

’I wonder when that inheritance ground will open. It would be great if I can get Misty Essence Mythic Halo,’ he thought. Many inheritance and other treasure places were opening all over the Blue Kingdom right now.
Soon all of them began eating. The crown prince seemed an even bigger simp than Jack. Monk Shitless was already treating him like trash, yet he was still happy.

It was already night. After eating their food, the crown prince gave the group of five a tour of the castle. To flatter Sonia, he brought them to almost every place, even showing off his wealth to win her heart.

’Damn, the number of soul potions here is much higher than the Dunshire Kingdom. I have to take them all. Hmm, I guess the crown prince would be very helpful for that,’ Vritra thought, as he looked at the poor crown prince who had already fallen into his and the evil monk’s clutches.
"Well, that’s about it in this house of ours. Sonia, did you like it?" the crown prince asked.
"Hmm, not bad. Anyway, is it true your father takes any beautiful woman for himself?" Sonia asked, acting fearful.

Early the next morning, Vritra and Vanessa walked out of their room after getting ready. Fiona and Diana also walked out after a minute; all of them were ready to head into the Small Forest for some hunting.

Monk Shitless was still sleeping. Vritra had to wake him up himself to start the act. Now the monk was rather optimistic about his role. After getting ready, he walked out of his room, and as expected, the crown prince came to see them so early.
"So all of you are ready to head into the Small Forest? Are you sure you don’t need any guards just in case?" the crown prince asked as he stopped beside Sonia.

"No, we don’t need any. Is the carriage ready?" Vritra asked as they began to walk out of the castle. He could clearly sense the eyes hidden in the darkness that were constantly keeping an eye on their group—or on Sonia, to be exact.

’Looks like the king has taken the bait, as expected of the father of the biggest simp. With how capable this prince is, I think our task will be faster than expected,’ Vritra thought, as he saw Monk Shitless doing his role perfectly.
"Yes, everything is ready. Tell me if you need anything else," the crown prince replied. Soon they arrived, and there waited the luxurious carriage.
"Let’s go." Vritra and the three women sat in the carriage, while Monk Shitless was left behind with the crown prince. He wasn’t as afraid or awkward as before.

After getting the shit beaten out of them in the Dunshire Kingdom, Faceless, Blunder, and their teams—as well as the three demon generals—had run out of that kingdom, a trauma settling deeply within their hearts.

Blunder had run straight back to the White Kingdom where his base was located—or rather, he was brought there by his team since he was too badly injured. And the injuries given by the demon lord’s energy take quite long to heal, that is, if they can heal at all.
The three generals heard that Vritra had entered the Blue Kingdom, so despite their reluctance, they entered the kingdom since they still needed to find the core of their lord.
They still planned to sacrifice almost all the people of the Dunshire Kingdom to bring Voromir back to life.
But they couldn’t find Vritra anywhere, and since demons can’t move around in the kingdom freely, they could only join hands with some nasty humans and make use of them.

Faceless had returned to his secondary base, which was located in the Blue Kingdom, instead of returning to his primary base in the White Kingdom, since that was too far and they were in no condition for long travel.

But Vritra had killed more than thirty thousand of his men. Aside from the few strongest, almost all of the base in the Blue Kingdom had been emptied, and they desperately needed more men to continue their work.
But before they could start recruitment, they received a message from the demon general Silquor to meet him and discuss some serious business.
And so, a meeting was set between the demon generals and Faceless of the Nine Pacts. Also, what could be a better place for a meeting than the forest where humans and demons could venture alike?

After their first meeting, they quickly formed a new kind of partnership. The three generals’ aim was just to get the demon lord’s core from Vritra, while the Nine Pacts wanted Vritra dead first before moving on to their next goals.

Today again, they had set a meeting to share whatever information they had obtained. Even after so many days had passed, there had been no news about Vritra. Of course, they deduced that he had most likely disguised himself, so it was quite difficult to find him in such a huge kingdom—but he didn’t seem like the type that would lay low.
In a large wooden room built in the middle of the Small Forest, Faceless sat on one side of a large table and poured tea for himself. Behind him stood five of his underlings.

They waited in silence for the three demon generals for their second meeting. The Nine Pacts wanted to get their hands on the Scarlet Couple Inheritance, but because of the emperor’s interference, they weren’t able to go inside.
Just before leaving, Blunder had told him about big news. The Grieves had made their way into the Blue Kingdom, and one of their targets was an unknown inheritance.

Faceless had been keeping a close eye on all the inheritances that were opening all over the Blue Kingdom after the Scarlet Inheritance was taken by the Empress, but there hasn’t been anything important.

Soon they heard the sound of wind rushing. Faceless stood up and walked out of the wooden house calmly to welcome his guests. These demon generals were much stronger than him and would be of great use.

The three demon generals were so strong that they could slaughter the entire Blue Kingdom within minutes. They truly showed just how fearsome the demons could actually be. All three of them had lived for so long, Faceless wondered just how high their levels must be. To be honest, he was also quite afraid of them.
’Hmm, they are being a bit late today. I wonder if something happened,’ Faceless thought, though he doubted anything in this kingdom could really threaten them.
Just then, he saw the three demon generals flying toward him at extreme speed. At first, they were just small dots in the distance, but within a moment, they arrived just a few meters away from him.

"Generals, you are truly as magnificent as always—" but Faceless and the other five were baffled when the demon generals didn’t even glance at them and rushed forward as if fire had been set on their asses.

Thaddeus, Silquor, and Morvik— all three of them held terrified expressions as they fled with all their might as if their lives depended on it. If they were a bit slower, they would be beaten to a pulp.

’W-What’s going on? I did hear that some people from the Golden Moon had arrived here. Did they send such strong people that could make even the fearless demon generals cower like that?’ Faceless gulped. They couldn’t oppose the Golden Moon directly; that organisation was quite dangerous.
He looked at the five others and nodded at them, quickly coming to a decision to flee as soon as possible.
Just then, he noticed a single dot in the distance that seemed to be chasing after the three demon generals.
’It is just a single person?’ Faceless was even more shocked, and soon he saw...
A demon with bluish energy swirling around his body, two horns on his head, and... a leather belt in hand?!!
Faceless instantly recognised that demonic energy. He felt goosebumps all over his body. The injuries from the previous time hadn’t even healed properly yet, and there he was—
The demon lord Vritra, looking as bloodthirsty as ever, his face stained with red blood as if he had just devoured someone alive.

Monk Shitless’s face twisted into an evil smirk—he was getting close to his goal.

The carriage brought Vritra and the others to the entrance of the Small Forest quite fast. Seeing the royal carriage, all the people moved out of the way on their own. It took less than an hour to arrive at their destination.
The coachman parked the carriage there and went to rest in a hotel while they continued their hunt.
The four of them started walking into the forest, which seemed wild. There were marks of fights everywhere and blood on trees and grass.
The further they moved, the stronger the smell of blood became. They even saw corpses lying here and there—some belonged to humans and some to demons.

"Ughh... this place smells so bad. There are limbs lying all over. There’s no such place in the entire Dunshire Kingdom. Are we really supposed to fight the demons here?" Diana said while pinching her nose from over the veil.
"The demons here seem a lot more dangerous than the ones we faced before. I wonder what kind of demons live in this forest?" Fiona spoke.
The demons she faced before were all captured and weakened by the guards, so this place seemed a little scary to her. She clung to Vritra while looking around carefully.
Because of the thick trees, the surroundings were a little dark, so it was like playing a dangerous horror game in VR.
"Honey, are we all going to hunt the demons together?" Vanessa asked, as she walked to Vritra’s other side. She wasn’t really afraid.

"..." After scanning the entire surroundings, Vritra soon created a map in his mind. He saw through all the demons and humans currently in the forest around them and knew which level of demons were located in which places.
"You three will be hunting on your own while I will be hunting in the deeper parts of the forest. Don’t worry, I’ll send wraiths to protect you, and I won’t be too far," Vritra said.
After making sure no one else was around, he raised his hand and muttered: "Exhume!!"

In the next instant, thousands upon thousands of soul wraiths rose around the four of them. Fiona and Vanessa had heard about them, but they were still quite surprised to see so many—and all of them seemed so strong.

Diana just straight-up froze. She only knew that he possessed the Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo, but she had no idea that he already commanded such a large army. She gulped and was thankful she had accepted her role as his slave just in time.
"Bobby, devour them all," Vritra ordered, pointing toward more than twenty thousand soul wraiths along with the two spies sent by King Henry, while Ghoul and Ghost remained standing to the side.

Under the shocked gazes of the three women, the metallic ball’s size suddenly increased, and in the next moment, Bobby dived into the large crowd of soul wraiths and began to devour them all rapidly, while its own level began to increase.

Vritra observed the scene silently. More than two days had passed in the labyrinth, and the three soul wraiths were still absorbing energy from the demon lord’s broken core. Everything was going perfectly for now.
In a short time, Bobby had absorbed more than half of the soul wraiths and continued to go on.
"Whoa, that small cute ball is such a dangerous thing?!!" Fiona asked in shock.
"What level is it at, m-master?" Diana asked while gulping her saliva. He seemed more and more dangerous.
"Wait a little and let Bobby consume the others first," Vritra said, as they waited patiently.
Soon, Bobby had devoured all the others and rolled around Vritra in joy. Its strength had grown by a lot.
"Bobby is above level 1,800 now. Soul wraiths certainly grow faster than others," Vritra mumbled before saying, "All three of you just follow Bobby.

Face the demons it points to, and if there is any stronger demon, then just let Bobby beat it half to death. Take any weapon from Diana if you need. After you have finished hunting, Ghost and Ghoul will bring more demons to you."
"Be careful, honey," Vanessa hugged him and said with a smile. She was happy that she could finally grow strong—at least with some strength she wouldn’t be a burden to him.
"Thank you, darling." Fiona stood on her tiptoes and gave a peck on Vritra’s lips, smiling sweetly though she was still a bit afraid of this forest.

"Everything will be fine, don’t worry." Vritra touched her cheek and said warmly. After giving her a tight and protective hug, he ordered: "Ghoul, Ghost, go along with them. Protect them and bring strong demons to them in a barely alive state after they are done with their hunting..."
After Vritra had given his instructions, he looked at Diana, who seemed to be longing for him. With a nod, he spoke: "Take care."
Then he disappeared from their sight. The three women made some sort of plan among themselves, and Diana distributed whatever they needed from her large stock of treasure.
And soon, the hunting began.
[Nether Eye activated.]
A vertical eye appeared over Vritra’s head as he flew deeper into the forest. He would keep constant watch over them.
"Oh, this forest sure is dangerous. I have already located a 1st Legion-ranked demon when I haven’t even reached the centre of the forest yet," he mumbled.

So, Lady Sonia, would you like to spend your day with me?" the crown prince asked, looking at Monk with stars in his eyes.
"Hmm...
Should I?
SighToo many people have been chasing me, why should I give you a chance?
Don’t tell me it’s just because you are the crown prince or because of your pretty face?" Sonia said, as she started walking, the prince following her like a loyal puppy.
"Oh, I can fulfill every single one of your wishes.
I can do anything for you," the prince said.
"But I heard you already have a wife and even a child.Sigh, are you truly deserving of me?

chapters.title: Chapter 211: One Step
paragraphs: Vritra quickly located a demon that seemed to be following behind a group of weak humans, who were following behind a group of even weaker demons searching for food.
"It’s quite weak but..." Vritra observed the demon, which looked like a large lava hound, and decided to have a taste of a high-levelled demon.

Just as that hound demon was about to launch a sneak attack, a human figure appeared in front of him. The demon was shocked at first, but then it launched a sudden attack as flames burst out of its sharp claws.
’Let’s see how much I have grown.’

An axe appeared in Vritra’s hand. He casually slashed vertically as the sharp blade of the axe tore the demon’s body into two instantly. It released a loud whimper as both parts of its body passed through either side of Vritra.
The level of the hound demon was around 1300, so despite getting slashed in two, it still held some vitality. Vritra gazed at the demon and launched a mental attack with the third eye.
With a high Intelligence stat, the demon was instantly killed as the last of its vitality disappeared. Vritra stored the corpse and axe in his inventory and started to walk forward.
[You have killed a level 1,342 Lava Hound.]
[+Exp]
"Well, that was quite easy, though even killing it was not enough to increase my level," Vritra mumbled and decided to find a place to have a meal.

Vanessa, Fiona, and Diana had already started fighting the demons. Vanessa was the calmest of the three. Fiona panicked a bit at the start, but she quickly got the hang of it. Diana, however, was a complete mess—she had never fought demons before, so it took her longer to get used to it all.

"Sigh... What a useless goddess, she reminds me of a certain blue-haired goddess. Anyway, this place is fine. Let’s eat the already cooked meat," Vritra spoke as he used dust to create a table and chair for himself and set his dish on the table.

"I still can’t understand why you’ve taken a liking to demon meat. Is it really that good? Well, to others it’s like poison, so no one really eats it," Yasmine said, watching as Vritra started eating.

"Mmmm, don’t worry, I will let you taste it too. It might seem strange at first, but this is really delicious—better than animal meat. By the way, after your disappearance, didn’t any dragon try to look for you?"

"... The news of my death had spread everywhere. Maybe they also believe I’m dead, and it wouldn’t be easy to find me. Maybe they did try to search for me," Yasmine said, sounding unsure of her own words.

"I still don’t understand one thing, though. Isn’t there some kind of penalty from the demon god for attacking you? From your memory, I saw that gods don’t directly do anything. They can at most send people to do their work," Vritra asked as he continued to devour the large pieces of meat.
"Yeah, there must have been a high penalty for attacking me, but I don’t understand why they would go so far just to kill me.

I mean, yeah, I might have been the dragon with the highest potential and fastest growth, but that still doesn’t explain it. And there are many mysteries associated with that attack on me," she replied. Yasmine even doubted some dragons might have betrayed her.
They chatted while Vritra almost devoured all the meat. Holding the last piece in his hand, he stood up and began walking forward, sensing another presence not too far away.
As he bit the hot meat of the Lava Hound, a trickle of red blood flowed from the corner of his lips.
"Hmm, looks like another legion-ranked demon. There are so many of them here. I’ll turn the demons I hunt from now on into soul wraiths and feed them to Bobby.
It would be great if it could reach the 2nd legion rank," Vritra mumbled, but then his step halted as he sensed three presences rapidly charging in his direction.
"What is that?!!" Vritra was shocked by that speed. As he turned and focused, with his third eye he soon saw three familiar people.
Thaddeus, Silquor, and Morvik—the three demon generals.

Vritra didn’t remember much after the Elegy Parasite took control of his body, so he didn’t know how badly he had beaten them. But if they hadn’t been holding back their strength, they could’ve definitely beaten him back then.
In the blink of an eye, they had appeared close to Vritra’s location. All three of them glanced casually toward him.
Vritra’s first instinct was to turn around and escape. Even if he went all out, there was little chance of surviving against them.

Although he looked different now, how could the three demons not sense that deadly presence lingering around Vritra? They instantly knew it was the same demon who had beaten fear into their bones and flesh.

"!!!" Their bodies shivered, and their first instinct was to turn and escape. Their bodies were still hurting from the last time he beat them up. It would take quite some time for all their injuries to heal.
The three demons and Vritra turned around at the same time and ran at full speed.
It was such a cartoon-like scene. Just after taking a few steps, all four of them noticed something was strange.
They halted and cautiously turned their heads. Vritra saw the three demons who had tried to flee upon seeing him, while the three of them wondered why that demon had tried to flee.
"..." A skeptical look appeared on Vritra’s face. As he and the three demons turned, he took one step forward while the three took one step back.
One forward, one back.
One forward, one back.
’What’s going on?’ Vritra wondered.

The three demons noticed that something was strange. They wondered if Vritra was no longer able to use that power. Still feeling fear inside, the three looked at one another before taking one step forward, while Vritra remained still.
He quickly understood his part and asked in his mind:
’Wifey, did I somehow beat the shit out of them last time?’
"I don’t know much since I was also unconscious at that time, but I did see when you beat up Blunder. He certainly seemed traumatized," Yasmine answered.
’Do you know anything about their lord? I guess the situation has just become right.’ Vritra’s smile curled up as he stood in front of them confidently.

"Yes. He was way too arrogant—like really, really arrogant. And he had a habit of beating his underlings whenever they made a mistake with anything he got his hands on, like shoes, belts, and whatnot," Yasmine gave a short intro.
’Got it. Shall we start the show now?’ Vritra thought before rising into the air. He looked at them haughtily and shouted in rage:
"You imbeciles! How dare you try to attack your own lord? Are you trying to rebel? Planning treason? You wish to usurp my position?! Betrayal?!!"
Right after speaking, Vritra pulled out a leather belt from his inventory and swung it in the air, making a loud slapping sound.

chapters.title: Chapter 212: Trauma Triggered
paragraphs: The three generals stared at Vritra skeptically; they clearly knew he was lying. How could the labyrinth be intact? It would have collapsed soon after it lost the energy supply from the demon lord.
But upon seeing that leather belt in his hand, they became even more confused. They glanced at one another with questioning looks. There was little to no chance of him being their lord.
[Switch Activated.]
[Switch: Demonification (0.5%)]

Blue energy instantly burst out of his body and horns appeared on his head. Vritra still remained in Jin Woo’s appearance as the two hearts in his chest thumped wildly, supplying energy all over his body.

Vritra could easily control this much level of power, and his strength quickly rose to close to the 2nd legion rank with just that much energy from the demon lord’s core. The surroundings instantly became suffocating.
All the people that were hunting in the small forest nearby instantly became alert. They threw up all their plans and immediately made their escape—this new demon seemed way too dangerous.
"Hah! You fools think anyone other than me will be able to control my own core and energy? Did you think I am an idiot like you and that just you three would be my backup plan?
Sigh... I still can’t believe you have the audacity to attack me with others when you should have protected me," Vritra spoke, wrinkling his nose at the three confused demons.
The more they listened to him, the more confused they became. None of the three could tell if they should believe him or not.
"I-If you are our lord, then prove it," Thaddeus said after a few seconds, scratching his face.
"WHAT?!! You want me, Voromir Zuke, to prove myself in front of you... mere servants?" Blue energy burst out of Vritra’s body as he swung the leather belt in the air, showing his rage.
"Do you think a random kid could take control of one of the strongest Mythic Halos? Do you think a random kid could control my core?
You believe a normal human could beat so many of you with his low level?" Vritra’s anger burst even more as he showed the invisible flames over his hand, shocking the three.

The muscle memory of the three demon generals kicked in as they remembered the time when their lord would beat them up for the smallest mistake, and seeing the current Vritra and his arrogance, they really felt as if their lord had truly returned.
"S-Sorry, we didn’t mean that..." The old Silquor’s back bent even more as he tried to hide behind the giant Thaddeus. They still had their doubts, but they still felt fear towards Vritra.
"Hah!! You three kids need to get spanked. Get here."
All of a sudden, Vritra began charging towards them at such a high speed.
His speed was also enhanced by the demon lord’s energy, on top of which he activated his newly upgraded skill.
[Shift Activated.]
[Strength + Endurance → Agility]
Agility: 99,715Strength: 15,909
Endurance: 14,968

The new Shift was much more powerful than the previous version. Not only could he shift the stats of two of his attributes to one, but even if he shifted all of the points from the two, half of it would still remain in those two.
Though after Shift is deactivated, he would get into a weakened state. Vritra decided to test this skill now.

His speed increased explosively, and it was certainly as fast as someone at the 2nd legion rank. Even though there is a large gap between each level, with his skills and the demon lord’s energy, he crossed that large gap.
Thaddeus, Silquor, and Morvik were startled when Vritra charged towards them at such a speed. There was no way a normal human could grow at that rate, so they really wondered if it was their lord.

Sensing that familiar energy and the belt swinging in his hand, the three generals released a fearful whimper and rotated at the speed of lightning before making a run for their lives, since their traumatic memories were triggered.

And so began the chase. The three demon generals were obviously faster than Vritra, but even here they didn’t seem to use their full strength, as if they were afraid of attracting the wrong attention towards them.

The trees swung and strong wind blew as the three demon generals ran in fear. Their clothes were almost torn to shreds, and Thaddeus’s tongue was hanging out of his mouth—their only focus was on escaping.
WHOOSH WHOOSH WHOOSH
They didn’t even notice the wooden room on the ground or the people looking at them as they continued to flee, while Vritra enjoyed his new speed. Shift would get even more awesome in the future.

"W-What?!! Is that Vritra?!!" Faceless exclaimed on the ground. Seeing the three generals being so afraid of Vritra filled him with dread as well. Without a second thought, he fled with his underlings.
Of course, Vritra had already noticed them, but for now, he only focused on the three generals.
[Fourth Dimension Activated.]
Vritra disappeared suddenly.

After running for a bit longer, the three generals noticed that no one was chasing them. If they weren’t so panicked, they could have easily sensed Vritra’s presence even if he was in a separate space.
The three panted heavily and looked around in fear, and in the next moment, Vritra appeared in front of them. Startled, they were about to flee again.
{Sin Points Gained: Terrified +3}

"Stop. I understand you have your doubts about me, and it makes sense since you are so incapable. Anyway, if you really wish to confirm whether or not I am your lord, go back to the Dunshire Kingdom and see the labyrinth crumble as soon as my lingering energy fades away."
Vritra said as he put away the belt and closed Switch. His horns disappeared via Intra Shuffle. Though he kept Shift activated for now.

"W- We understand. Although everything did indicate that you are our lord, think of us as incompetent. So please forgive us for our rudeness," Silquor spoke. If it really was their lord, then they really were being too rude.
"Yes, if it is as you said, then we will serve you with all our heart," Morvik said, trying to calm his heart.
"Okay, then go right ahead to the Dunshire Kingdom and see it for yourself. I will wait for you in this kingdom," Vritra said as he crossed his arms in front of his chest.
The three demon generals bowed and were about to leave—they just wanted to escape from here for now.
"Wait, so your purpose for coming here was to meet the... Nine Pacts, to try to find me, right?" Vritra asked.
"GULP... Y- Yes, that’s correct," Thaddeus said, hiding his giant body behind Morvik.
"Hmm. Did you obtain any important information from Faceless?" Vritra asked as he watched Faceless run out of the small forest along with the other five men.
"Uh... Nothing much, but he did tell me that the Grieves are looking for some inheritance and they are planning something big in this and the White Kingdom," Silquor spoke after slight hesitation.
’Inheritance? Could it be that they are looking for the same thing as me? Do they know about the existence of the Misty Essence Mythic Halo in one of the inheritances here?’ Vritra pondered.
