"S-Sorry, we didn’t mean that..." The old Silquor’s back bent even more as he tried to hide behind the giant Thaddeus.
They still had their doubts, but they still felt fear towards Vritra.
"Hah!!
You three kids need to get spanked.
Get here."
All of a sudden, Vritra began charging towards them at such a high speed.
His speed was also enhanced by the demon lord’s energy, on top of which he activated his newly upgraded skill.
[Shift Activated.]
[Strength + Endurance → Agility]
Agility: 99,715Strength: 15,909
Endurance: 14,968
The new Shift was much more powerful than the previous version.
Not only could he shift the stats of two of his attributes to one, but even if he shifted all of the points from the two, half of it would still remain in those two.
Though after Shift is deactivated, he would get into a weakened state.
Vritra decided to test this skill now.
His speed increased explosively, and it was certainly as fast as someone at the 2nd legion rank.
Even though there is a large gap between each level, with his skills and the demon lord’s energy, he crossed that large gap.
Thaddeus, Silquor, and Morvik were startled when Vritra charged towards them at such a speed.
There was no way a normal human could grow at that rate, so they really wondered if it was their lord.

Sensing that familiar energy and the belt swinging in his hand, the three generals released a fearful whimper and rotated at the speed of lightning before making a run for their lives, since their traumatic memories were triggered.
And so began the chase.
The three demon generals were obviously faster than Vritra, but even here they didn’t seem to use their full strength, as if they were afraid of attracting the wrong attention towards them.
The trees swung and strong wind blew as the three demon generals ran in fear.
Their clothes were almost torn to shreds, and Thaddeus’s tongue was hanging out of his mouth—their only focus was on escaping.
WHOOSH WHOOSH WHOOSH
They didn’t even notice the wooden room on the ground or the people looking at them as they continued to flee, while Vritra enjoyed his new speed.
Shift would get even more awesome in the future.
"W-What?!!
Is that Vritra?!!" Faceless exclaimed on the ground.
Seeing the three generals being so afraid of Vritra filled him with dread as well.
Without a second thought, he fled with his underlings.
Of course, Vritra had already noticed them, but for now, he only focused on the three generals.
[Fourth Dimension Activated.]
Vritra disappeared suddenly.
After running for a bit longer, the three generals noticed that no one was chasing them.
If they weren’t so panicked, they could have easily sensed Vritra’s presence even if he was in a separate space.
The three panted heavily and looked around in fear, and in the next moment, Vritra appeared in front of them.
Startled, they were about to flee again.
{Sin Points Gained: Terrified +3}
"Stop.
I understand you have your doubts about me, and it makes sense since you are so incapable.
Anyway, if you really wish to confirm whether or not I am your lord, go back to the Dunshire Kingdom and see the labyrinth crumble as soon as my lingering energy fades away."
Vritra said as he put away the belt and closed Switch.
His horns disappeared via Intra Shuffle.
Though he kept Shift activated for now.
"W- We understand.
Although everything did indicate that you are our lord, think of us as incompetent.
So please forgive us for our rudeness," Silquor spoke.
If it really was their lord, then they really were being too rude.
"Yes, if it is as you said, then we will serve you with all our heart," Morvik said, trying to calm his heart.
"Okay, then go right ahead to the Dunshire Kingdom and see it for yourself.
I will wait for you in this kingdom," Vritra said as he crossed his arms in front of his chest.
The three demon generals bowed and were about to leave—they just wanted to escape from here for now.
"Wait, so your purpose for coming here was to meet the...
Nine Pacts, to try to find me, right?" Vritra asked.
"GULP...
Y- Yes, that’s correct," Thaddeus said, hiding his giant body behind Morvik.
"Hmm.
Did you obtain any important information from Faceless?" Vritra asked as he watched Faceless run out of the small forest along with the other five men.
Nothing much, but he did tell me that the Grieves are looking for some inheritance and they are planning something big in this and the White Kingdom," Silquor spoke after slight hesitation.
’Inheritance?
Could it be that they are looking for the same thing as me?
Do they know about the existence of the Misty Essence Mythic Halo in one of the inheritances here?’ Vritra pondered.

chapters.title: Chapter 213: Fraud Goddess
paragraphs: Vritra pondered for a moment. The Grieves really had been moving around too much; things might get really troublesome if their goals truly aligned.

It isn’t a good thing to become enemies with literally everything in the world, and little is known about the Grieves, so it was better to avoid them. But he also didn’t want to give up on the Mythic Halo.
"Anything else?" he asked after a few seconds.

"...Blunder ran off to the White Kingdom, and Nine Pacts is about to double down on their research. I heard Faceless say they are quite close to achieving their objective. He even wanted us to deliver him lots of humans, demons, and other creatures," Thaddeus spoke after thinking for a while.
"Hmm. Alright, you can leave now," Vritra finally said while shooing them away with his hand, as the three generals fled instantly.

’Very soon I will have three new slaves, very powerful ones at that. Before that, I need to increase Yasmine’s and Nihil-Anima’s strength, and for that, I need a lot of soul potions or some sort of soul treasure.’
Vritra pondered as he continued to scan his surroundings through his third eye and made sure that Vanessa and the others were fine.
"It is better to give up on the Mythic Halo than to be chased by the Grieves, especially at your current strength.

Those things could even kill beings stronger than them with their strange abilities and the help of Glyphs," Yasmine cautioned. She had previously had conflicts with the Grieves too — that’s why she knew how annoying they could be.

"Haa. I will decide based on the situation. If it really seems impossible, then I would rather give up on it than get Mom and the others involved," Vritra sighed. With his luck, he was sure their target would most probably be the same.

Dark Knight and the others were still continuously absorbing the Demon Lord’s energy. They had absorbed nearly half of the energy, and things were finally starting to get a bit tense. Their strength was increasing rapidly, but so was the danger.

Vritra just hoped the three soul wraiths could make it to the end, and by the time they completely removed any lingering traces of the Demon Lord Voromir Zuke, the labyrinth would collapse on its own and the three demon generals would finally believe him.

"Anyway, it is time to hunt. Nine Pacts shouldn’t be bothering me for now—or so I hope. The three demon generals and Blunder are also away, so all I have to deal with is the king for now." He thought and flew in a different direction, aiming for a new prey.
"Ah right, I forgot to turn off the Shift," Vritra remembered, and deactivated his OP ability.
Instantly, he felt as if more than 75% of his combat strength had suddenly disappeared; only less than a quarter remained, though it was not as bad as he had expected.
"Now I just need to wait and see how long this weakness lasts. This is the only bad side of the Shift, but I guess it is what it is," Vritra mumbled and began to fly.
After a short time, the weakness disappeared completely and his strength was restored to full. He calculated and found that the time taken was nearly as long as he had kept the ability activated.

"Not bad. So, how does it feel to have two sugar mommies? Mutamorphic and Divine Sin Wheel. Hehe, hubby, I guess I will be your third sugar mommy. Aren’t you lucky to get me?" she spoke in a mischievous tone.
"Yeah yeah, how lucky of me. I must have been a saint in my previous life and had done countless good deeds to get you as my wife," Vritra replied in a dramatic tone.
The two continued to talk playfully as Vritra hunted for more demons and fed whatever he killed to Bobby.

Ghost and Ghoul were protecting the three women while also going out one by one to hunt some strong demons and bring them back when they were barely alive. This whole act would give the three women experience in fighting but also increase their level rapidly.
Fiona held a magic staff that increased her firepower by several times. Vanessa held two knives and moved around agilely—she could easily make any demon light-headed with her special ability.

Diana chose a staff too, since she was afraid of getting dirty from the blood of the demons, and stabbing them with her own hand felt disgusting. So she was just supporting the team from behind, sending destruction energy balls at the right time.

Fiona realized that fighting in such an environment was much better than the training they had been receiving inside the Dunshire Kingdom. Even though there were still protectors to keep them safe, this whole thing seemed more real.
"Sigh. Fighting sure is tiring. My hands have become all red," Diana said as she sent another holy energy attack flying at the demon that Fiona and Vanessa were fighting closely.

Fiona didn’t want to fight like Diana. She was more of a direct combatant. One side of her staff had a sharp blade, so it was more like a spear. She used slashing, stabbing, and firepower perfectly just after some practice.

"We have barely fought for ten minutes and you are just standing in one position. How is it tiring for you?" Vanessa asked as the demon froze for a moment because of her ability, and she slashed at its chest right at that moment.
"A-Anyway, about Vritra... do you think he hates me?" Diana asked hesitantly, looking at the two women uncertainly.

"HATE?!!" Vanessa and Fiona both snapped at her. They were holding their anger against her since Vritra had said not to hurt her too much. She had tried to kill the person they loved the most, so how could they not be angry at this goddess?
In a fit of rage, both of them abandoned their opponent and sent attacks hurtling toward the goddess, who was taken aback and barely put up a defense to protect herself.
Thankfully, her level was still much higher than the two women, so she was able to protect herself.
Meanwhile, Ghoul stopped the demon just in time to prevent it from attacking Fiona and Vanessa from behind.
"I would have really cut you to pieces if you weren’t already my son’s slave. Do you think you will be forgiven for hurting my son?" Vanessa’s voice thundered as she sent several more attacks at her.
"You stupid useless fraud goddess. Weren’t you supposed to protect us all? Because of your greed, you even tried to kill my darling, and you still call yourself a goddess?
You are more of a demon than the demons themselves! Remove that barrier and let me hit you!" Fiona shouted, attacking the goddess again and again.
Diana really regretted asking that question—it was like she had awakened two sleeping lionesses.
The goddess knew that she was in the wrong, and she really regretted her decision at that time. So, while asking for their forgiveness, she received their attacks, looking on the verge of tears.
Ghost and Ghoul glanced at one another, wondering what was going on with these women. They didn’t understand why they had started fighting all of a sudden.

chapters.title: Chapter 214: The Royal Affair
paragraphs: [You have killed a Level 1240 Berserk Hound.]
[+EXP Earned.]
"Bobby, consume it." Vritra killed another 1st Legion rank demon and allowed Bobby to devour its soul. This was already the third demon he had killed in the Small Forest.

The number of demons at his level wasn’t too high, but there were many of them. No wonder this was called one of the most dangerous areas of the Blue Kingdom—though it was an easy hunting ground for him.

After walking around a little longer, Vritra suddenly felt that the air was becoming hot; it certainly wasn’t a natural change. Previously, because of the shade of the thick trees, the surrounding was rather cool, but suddenly the temperature was rising.

"What’s happening around here?" Vritra flew into the sky and observed the surroundings. A big part of the forest was suddenly becoming hot, but after a few more minutes, everything started to become normal.
"How strange, it certainly wasn’t a natural change. What could have caused it? I can’t sense anything in our surroundings," Yasmine spoke in confusion.

"Yeah, it feels like something started but ended before its completion. Whatever... I guess it is time to return," Vritra mumbled. It was time for the three women to rest. He had watched their entire fight and could only shake his head.

In less than a minute, he appeared close to their location. Vanessa, Fiona, and Diana were already resting after their long battle while Ghoul and Ghost were working hard—bringing one barely alive demon after another.

The three of them just needed to launch one light attack and they gained a large amount of experience points. They just sat on chairs and rested. Though there was still anger towards Diana, they had made some progress.
"So, how is the hunting going?" Vritra suddenly appeared beside them and asked, sitting on the empty chair.
"Everything is fine, right?" Vanessa asked, glancing at the goddess.
"Yes, everything is fine. It feels a little hot, isn’t it?" Diana replied, while fanning her face with an expensive-looking paper fan.
"Something feels off. I don’t know how to explain it, but it’s like this warmth is a bit familiar," Fiona spoke, looking at the surroundings with a puzzling look on her face.
"Hmm... Is it somehow related to your Phoenix bloodline?" Vritra pondered.
The four of them fell silent, and just as he was about to speak, Vritra’s brows shot up in surprise as he gestured for everyone to stay quiet.
From the direction of the city, he sensed dozens upon dozens of presences rushing in their direction—and all of them were really strong.
Vritra and Vanessa hastily formed several layers of barriers around them. Vritra even created a dust dome around them that didn’t stand out much because of the uneven surface.
All of them sat silently in the darkness as they soon heard the sound of wind whistling—clearly, lots of people were flying in the air.
[Nether Eye Activated.]

Vritra didn’t use his senses directly to probe. Instead, he opened the third eye and began to observe them. There were at least a hundred men in white clothes, all seeming as if they had just come out of a temple in a hurry. They were flying aimlessly in the Small Forest.
’The Grieves?!!’Vritra exclaimed in his mind, wondering what all of them were doing here all of a sudden.

The men in white ran all over the Small Forest, and after around forty or so minutes, it seemed they had failed to find whatever it was they were searching for. Finally, they flew back toward the city.
After waiting a little longer and sensing his surroundings, Vritra finally removed the dust dune and the barrier.
"What happened?" Vanessa asked, while Fiona and Diana had the same doubt. They too didn’t try to sense the outside after Vritra’s warning.
"It was those dangerous people from the temple. It seemed they were searching for something here," Vritra replied, while thinking of various possibilities.
’Could it be that they don’t know the location of the mythic halo yet? Or are they really looking for a different inheritance? Whatever may be the case, I have to be more careful of them.’
"Should we stay or..." Fiona asked. She was a little curious about those people from the temple.
"Ghoul, Ghost, have you hunted enough demons yet?" Vritra asked, and the two soul wraiths pointed toward a small mountain of demons who were barely breathing.

"Kill them all, and then we will return to the castle." He said, and the three women instantly got to work. Without any hesitation, they delivered final blows to the demons and killed them all within seconds.

They were surprised how easily the two soul wraiths had hunted such strong demons and even brought them all here without killing them. Ghost and Ghoul disappeared under Vritra’s feet. As they got ready to leave, he was extra careful with their surroundings.
Thankfully, all the Grieves had already left. They made their way to the carriage and began the journey back to the castle.
This time, it took a bit longer to return. The streets were full of people, and they all made way after seeing the royal carriage.
"Will we be going to hunt in the Small Forest in the future?" Diana asked. She had a really bad feeling about those people from the temple.

"... I will think about that. Anyway, let me tell you a bit about those people. They are called Grieves and they aren’t humans. Those creatures possess the ability to possess anyone. Little is known about them..." Vritra continued to explain along the way.

After a while, the carriage finally came to a halt. They had finally arrived at the castle. Getting out of the carriage, they passed through the door directly since the guards had already been informed about them.
"Go and rest in your rooms. I will meet with Shit—Sonia first." Vritra said, feeling that this name suited the monk better.
"Okay." The three women nodded and went towards their rooms. Their faces were already covered by the veils and their bodies covered by the barriers.
"Now, I wonder where my sister Sonia is." Vritra wondered. After walking towards the Crown Prince’s working chamber, he didn’t seem to be there.
"Do you know where the Crown Prince is?" Vritra stopped one of the guards and asked.

"Uh... Yeah, I did see him walking towards the back garden along with Lady Sonia," the guard replied. The budding affair between the Crown Prince and Sonia had already become a hot topic in the castle, and almost everyone knew about it.
The other princes wouldn’t waste such a chance. They added fuel to the fire and tried to make the Crown Prince look bad in the king’s eyes.

"Okay, thank you." Vritra had already seen almost every part of the castle. He started heading toward the back garden and could clearly hear most of the people talking about the Crown Prince’s affair.
’Things are going quite smoothly for now, it seems.’He thought.

And soon, Vritra arrived close to the back garden—and what he saw surprised him quite a lot. Monk Shitless was sitting in a comfortable position over a chair that was rocking back and forth, while the Crown Prince was sitting over her knees, feeding her fruits.

chapters.title: Chapter 215: Spoiled Prince
paragraphs: Vritra’s lips stretched into a thin line as he observed the two people from the distance. Monk Shitless had returned to his old evil ways, and the crown prince looked as if he was afraid of making even a tiny mistake.
Sonia said something and the two laughed, then the prince carefully put a piece of orange into her mouth.

She tasted it and then spat it out, making a face as if she had just eaten something disgusting. Then she turned to the crown prince and gave a ’playful’ slap on his face, though even Vritra clearly heard the sound from the distance.
Vritra: "..."
After getting slapped, the prince wasn’t even surprised. He almost lost his balance, but then he got to his knees and began to choose the fruit more carefully to feed her.

’Just what happened in a single day for things to have turned out this way?’ Vritra wondered as he started walking towards them, and after entering the garden he asked, "Prince, why are you on the ground? Did you drop something?"
The crown prince was startled. He accidentally dropped the fruit plate as he stood up in a hurry. He looked at Vritra in shame but pretended to be nonchalant.
"Cough. Yeah, I dropped something. Anyway, how did your hunt go? You didn’t encounter any problems, right?" the crown prince asked, again acting all high and mighty.
"Yes, everything was smooth. We hunted a few demons that weren’t too strong. Sonia, why are you sitting when the prince is standing?" Vritra said, his voice stern.
"I—It’s alright, Lady Sonia’s feet were hurting, so I asked her to sit down. Don’t worry about it. I am very strong," the crown prince said, giving a bright smile.

"If you say so. Oh right, Sonia, I heard the king was calling for you for some reason. You should go and meet him." Vritra said. The plan to sow discord between the father and son had already started.
"H-Huh? Why is Father calling for my—cough, I mean Sonia?" the crown prince asked in a flustered tone, his eyes wide with dread.
It had become his biggest nightmare to have his woman stolen by his own father. Just the imagination sent shivers down his spine.

"I don’t know, but based on the rumors surrounding King Henry, I think the answer is pretty obvious. Sigh. I am powerless against the king even if he wants to take my sister," Vritra said, shaking his head pitifully.

"Sigh. Brother, I really don’t want to end up with the king. Rather than being with that pig, I would spend the rest of my life with Henry Jr 1st. Sob. I don’t even know how I can protect myself against the mighty king.
Maybe it is my fate to end up becoming his plaything," Sonia said as she stood up suddenly and began to run. A single drop of tear rolled down her cheek and landed near the crown prince’s feet.
"S- Soniaaaaa..." the crown prince let out a hurt sound, extending a hand towards her but then pulling it back, remembering his powerlessness against his own father.
"Is everything alright, Prince?" Vritra asked, tapping his shoulder.
"Yes. Even if it is not, I will make everything right. So don’t worry, I will protect Sonia at any cost." A determined expression appeared on his face, his eyes looked bloodshot.
"Thank you, I can’t thank you enough." Vritra shook hands with him, but just as he was about to turn, he remembered something. "Do you know where J, K, and O are?"
"Alphabets?" the crown prince asked in confusion, his mind still filled with thoughts of protecting the woman of his dreams.
"...The men from the Golden Moon," Vritra said emotionlessly.

"Oh, they!! I heard they are staying in the Paradise Hotel, the most luxurious hotel in the Blue Kingdom. Well, they are staying there for free because our family owns that hotel, and that’s my father’s way of showing hospitality," the crown prince replied.
"Okay, be careful. There have been many fraud people going around nowadays. Don’t get scammed by someone.
You don’t know how devious people have become now. Sigh. We are in dark times..." Vritra shook his head as he walked away, leaving the prince with thoughts of his own.
One side was done. Now they needed to show the king’s interest in Monk Shitless, and once that is done, the rest would be easier based on Sonia’s capabilities of manipulating the crown prince.

Vritra was walking towards his room while thinking of various things, like killing the king, the Grieves, the inheritances, the demon generals, and so on. Several guards passed by him, most of whom were talking about the crown prince.
A young man whose age seemed to be around Vritra’s, in a flashy dress, was walking from the other side heading towards the garden. Upon seeing Vritra, a grin appeared on his face.
It was the youngest prince, who was around 19 years old and quite mischievous, though his little pranks were life-threatening for others.
It was Henry Jr 14th. The king loved him quite a lot since he was the son of his youngest and most beautiful wife, so even if he burned guards half to death, he wouldn’t even get scolded.
The little prince knew a bit about Vritra—not only that he had won one of the biggest competitions in their kingdom, but also that his oldest brother had fallen for Vritra’s sister.
Acting casual, he raised his right shoulder slightly and increased his speed as he rushed towards Vritra to trip him with his feet.
Vritra completely ignored the grown man acting like a spoiled child. When the prince placed his leg in front of him, Vritra simply stepped over it and kept walking.

"..." The young prince wasn’t surprised, but he wasn’t one to give up so easily. He ran forward and tried to entangle his feet into Vritra’s legs from behind to make him fall forward, finding his little prank very funny.
[Fourth Dimension Activated.]
The young prince’s feet passed through both of Vritra’s legs as if they were just made of air, startling the prince as he froze for a moment and stared at Vritra in bewilderment.
Finally getting frustrated and angry, he gritted his teeth and ran towards Vritra with his shoulder pointed forward.
BANG
And the prince finally succeeded in hitting Vritra, but the effect was the opposite of what he had expected.
Vritra didn’t budge an inch, while the prince himself staggered back and fell over his back, his shoulder hurting so bad as if he had just struck a metal wall.
"Oh, are you alright? Sorry, I didn’t notice you just now." Vritra finally decided to give some attention to this mad prince, but without waiting for a reply, he turned around and walked away.

’Sigh. Here comes another trouble. Is my luck deteriorating day by day? I was just walking. These shitty spoiled princes...’ Vritra cursed in his mind. From his clothes, it was obvious this man was a prince.
And from the look on the prince’s face, there was no way he would let it go easily. Though he hadn’t even reached the 1st Legion rank, so he would definitely try to get others’ help.
’Well, whatever. Killing his brother would be much easier than killing his father, right?’

chapters.title: Chapter 216: Makeup Glyph
paragraphs: ’Well, whatever. Killing his brother would be much easier than killing his father, right? One more name will be added to the kill list of the crown prince, I guess,’ Vritra thought.
He wasn’t worried that the young prince could try to harm any of his women—after all, Ghoul and Ghost were protecting them.

Throwing the matter with the prince to the back of his head, Vritra soon entered the castle and walked toward his room. Rather than dealing with the Grieves himself, he decided to push the Golden Moon against them.
Vanessa, Fiona, and Diana were all sitting in the same room talking about random things.
After their earlier fight, their relationship had gotten a bit better, though Diana would need a bit more time to truly be a part of the family.
Vritra opened the door and walked inside.
He walked over to one of the empty seats and sat beside Fiona, then leaning to the side, he rested his head on her shoulder, enjoying these short bits of peace in their life.
With how things were going, he was sure he had exhausted almost all his luck’s peace-time meter, and now chaos was about to enter—so he just wanted to relax for now.
"How are things going with Sonia?" Fiona asked, entangling her fingers with his and then holding his hand intimately.
"She is doing better than I expected. It won’t be long before the Blue Kingdom gets a new king.
Anyway, tomorrow we won’t be going out for hunting. You can rest here, or maybe go shopping or something if you want. I need to do something about the Grieves.

I feel uneasy when they are running all over the place like that," Vritra said, bringing her hand close to his face before kissing the back of her hand, pressing his lips against her soft, milky skin.
"Isn’t that dangerous?" Vanessa asked. She didn’t mind one bit the relationship between him and Fiona; she felt that Fiona was a good girl and suited Vritra.
"Not really. I won’t be fighting them on my own. I will just tell the news of their existence here to Golden Moon.
In any case, I’ll be careful, so don’t worry. And if you go shopping, don’t go too far from here—Ghost and Ghoul will be here with you," he replied.
Vritra was feeling a little hungry. After getting a taste of that strong demon, he was craving more of that delicious meat, and thankfully he had saved some for later.
Though that was one of the things he didn’t want to tell others, so he kept it a secret. And since the time in the labyrinth was too traumatic, others didn’t ask many questions about his time there.
"Ah, right. I met a young prince today. If he tries to annoy you tomorrow, just let Ghost take care of him.
He is such a spoiled rich brat, even though he doesn’t look younger than me. And also, avoid the king as much as possible for now," Vritra added.
They chatted for some more time and then went to eat dinner together. The crown prince was a little depressed today, so he didn’t join their group at the dinner table.
After eating dinner, Vritra and all four of the other women—Shitless included—began to walk around the castle.
Vritra planned to borrow the treasures of this kingdom as well, just like he did in the Dunshire Kingdom. Aside from him, Diana was also quite excited at the prospect of stealing all those treasures.

’A monk who loves chaos and a goddess who loves stealing... sigh, the world sure is going down the hill,’ Vritra shook his head as he saw the greed in the goddess’s eyes when they passed by the inventory.

Soon, all of them returned to their rooms. The moment Monk Shitless closed the door behind him, he appeared in his normal form as a glyph appeared in his hand. It was the thing that gave him the woman’s appearance.
Because of the barrier put around his room by Vritra, no spies could look inside, so he could finally appear in his real form.
After putting the glyph carefully onto the table, he lay back on the bed and missed his bull. The two of them had never stayed separated from one another for so long.
Vritra climbed onto his bed and slipped under the blanket as he hugged his mother’s body, and after a short talk, they soon drifted off to sleep. The next day was going to be anything but peaceful.
As the dawn broke, Monk Shitless took a bath and then used the glyph to transform into Sonia before walking out of his room. Then he headed straight to meet the crown prince.
Vritra first ate breakfast with Fiona, Vanessa, and Diana, and after saying goodbye to them, he too decided to see the crown prince once more—to push him slightly over the edge again.
After a few minutes’ walk, Vritra arrived at the back garden where the crown prince sat with a depressed expression, while Sonia seemed to be speaking in a depressed tone.
"Prince, are you alright? It seems you haven’t slept the entire night," Vritra asked.
"Haa, I am fine. I just had a lot to think about. Are you going out?" The crown prince had dark circles under his eyes as he replied.
"Yeah, I will be leaving my delicate sister in your care. Please look over her. She gets afraid too easily and hates violence the most," Vritra said as the crown prince nodded sincerely.
Then Vritra walked away. Just a few minutes later, the youngest prince, while acting coy, arrived beside his brother and asked in a childlike voice, "Big bruther, are you okay?"
The crown prince rolled his eyes and absent-mindedly replied, "Yes."
"Who was he and where is he going, big bruther?" the youngest prince questioned, tapping over his chin with his index finger.

"He is Jin Woo, Sonia’s brother. I think he should be going to Paradise Hotel..." the crown prince replied, while thinking of ways to get the tender and frightened Sonia away from his evil father’s clutches.
"Okay, thwank you, big bruther," the young prince said and finally walked away.
After getting into a carriage, Vritra headed straight toward the Paradise Hotel, but midway he decided to stop somewhere.
It was a makeup shop, similar to the one which transformed Monk Shitless into Sonia.
A man in his fifties was working on several types of appearances, adding them to the glyphs so that just by injecting a bit of energy, a person could instantly transform into someone else.
"Hello, sir. Can I help you?" The man paused his work and walked up to Vritra with a smile.
"Yeah, I need you to create a makeup glyph for me," Vritra said.
"Of course! Just show or explain the appearance to me and I will create the exact look," the man said confidently while patting his chest.
"This one. How long before it gets ready?" Vritra asked as he pulled out a piece of paper that was cut out of the newspaper.
{Sin Point Gained: Startled +1}
"OH!! Isn’t that the new demon lord Vritra? Are you sure you want that appearance?" the middle-aged man asked in surprise.

chapters.title: Chapter 217: Rat
paragraphs: "OH!! Are you sure you want that appearance?" the middle-aged man asked in surprise.
"Yeah, exactly that. Please create it for me right now. I will pay extra, so create it first," Vritra said as he sat down on one of the seats and waited.

After being surprised for a moment, the middle-aged man instantly got to work and began his task. It took a few hours, and finally the makeup glyph was ready. After paying for it, Vritra took the glyph and walked out of there.
"Oh right, forget I ever came here," Vritra turned around and spoke.
[Natural Hypnosis activated.]

The middle-aged man was dazed for a few moments, then he simply began working on his other projects. Because of Vritra’s high level, this skill was very effective, and the man had already forgotten all about Vritra.
’This will come in handy soon,’ Vritra thought, as he got into his carriage and continued with his journey. After some time, he finally arrived at his destination.
He got off the carriage and stepped into the crowded street. The buildings on both sides looked quite exquisite, and the building called the Paradise Hotel was even more majestic.

It was like a slightly smaller version of a castle; everything about it gave off a royal feeling. From decorations to servants, everything was top-notch, though the prices of this hotel were just as high.
Just as Vritra walked up to the entrance, one of the male servants walked up to him and with a flattering smile asked, "Sir, can I help you somehow?"
"Oh yes, I need to book—" Vritra was speaking when all of a sudden a fat man came running from inside the hotel, drenched in sweat and out of breath. While panting heavily, he called out:
"Wait!!"
Both Vritra and the servant looked at the fat man, whose fat was jiggling with each step he took. From his clothes, he didn’t seem to be some random servant.
"Manager, is something wrong?" the servant asked, as he forced a smile.

After wiping off his sweat and taking several long breaths, the fat manager finally spoke, "Our special guests staying on the top floor in rooms 1 to 4 need a few things. Go ahead and do it. Maybe you could get a special tip."
"Oh, but I am currently helping—" the servant pointed toward Vritra but was interrupted by the manager, who spoke in a heavy tone:
"Don’t worry, I will ask someone else to do it. That task is more important."

Finally, the servant apologized to Vritra before scurrying into the hotel. The fat man rubbed his palms together and passed a smile to Vritra before speaking, "Sorry for the inconvenience, sir. I will call someone else for you immediately."
"It’s alright," Vritra shrugged. He didn’t get angry just from this.
After looking back, the manager called out and asked for another servant to come. The new servant’s face looked like that of a rat—his two front teeth stood out the most on his face.
"Please help this sir with his accommodation," the fat manager said, then he walked inside.
"So sir, tell me, what can I help you with?" the rat man said with an ugly smile.

"I need to book a room. Can you help with the procedure and explain all the options available?" Vritra said as the two started walking into the building, which was just as luxurious inside as it appeared from the outside.
"Hehe yes, yes. Hmm, from your clothes, I would suggest you book a room on the lowest floor. The rooms there are the cheapest, and even you can afford them," the rat-faced man said.
’Should I smash his face into the wall?’ Vritra thought, but then decided against it. He just needed to finish one small task, so he didn’t want to create a big problem for no reason.

"Alright, how much is the price for the room?" Vritra asked as the rat-faced man brought him toward the rooms. Even though they were supposed to be the cheapest in the whole building, even those rooms appeared quite nice, so Vritra decided to just book one room.
"The price is one million gold for one night," the rat face said after thinking for a few moments.
Vritra: "..."

"Yeah right, then I will book it for a few hours. Here is a hundred gold coin advance, I will pay the rest later. Leave now." Vritra was finally getting annoyed; he could smell a conspiracy in the air.
"But sir, with just this much you can’t—" the rat-faced man tried to refuse rudely.
"Leave!!" Vritra said as a sliver of his aura burst out of his body, scaring the man. He ran away, then came running back and passed a key to him.
’Sigh, let’s just get the work done and leave. I am a peace loving person, haa it’s fine.’ Vritra thought as he entered his room, calming himself. He sat down on the bed and began to concentrate.

First, he observed the three demon wraiths. The process was now quite close to the end, and there was a high chance that they would be done in a few more hours. The three demon generals must have already arrived near the labyrinth, and now they must be observing it from outside.
’Keep on it, it will be done soon,’ Vritra encouraged them.
[Nether Eye activated.]
In the next moment, he began to observe the entire building and easily found the four special guests of the king in their respective rooms.
The silent man was sleeping, K was writing something in a notebook, J was singing loudly, while O sat cross-legged and was meditating.
’Nice, they are all here. Let’s start the plan,’ Vritra stood up. He took out a piece of paper from his inventory along with a pen and began to write something.
After he was done, he pulled out a few corpses of goblins from his inventory and, using dust, sent them flying out of the window. As they rose higher into the air, then...
"Explode!!"
BOOM BOOM BOOM BOOM...

Suddenly, a loud explosion sounded and all the people in the Paradise Hotel were startled. The whole place suddenly became chaotic as all the people rushed out of their rooms and began to run toward the exit.
Some even seemed as if they had just come out of the bath, running with towels wrapped around their bodies.

Hundreds of people staying in the hotel all rushed out. Even the three people from the Golden Moon couldn’t sit still, as they flew out of their rooms to inspect the surroundings, while the fourth man continued to sleep.
Vritra also walked out of the building amidst the chaos. He stood there calmly for a few minutes while gazing toward the sky, and soon his gaze met with K and the others.
The three men flew down and landed beside Vritra. K was the first to speak: "Oh, what a surprise to find you here, Jin Woo. Are you involved in this explosion?"
"Haha, please forgive my friend. Anyway, Jin Woo, do you know what happened just now?" J spoke, a wide smile on his face.
"No, I was in my room when I heard those explosions and then I ran outside along with the others," Vritra replied. The first part of his plan had succeeded.

chapters.title: Chapter 218: Framed
paragraphs: "Is that so? Did you see anyone suspicious?" O asked after observing him for a while.

"Not really, oh right— I did hear some face or something guy from the Nine Pacts was seen around this city. Maybe it is his work. You know how annoying the Nine Pacts could be," Vritra said with a shake of his head.

"..." The three men looked at one another. They had heard rumors about Faceless too. A few people saw him running into the city the previous day, but they were surprised that even Vritra knew about it.
"Hmm, that seems to be the case. Anyway, since when were you staying in this hotel?" O asked, while J and K were busy observing the surroundings.

"I arrived here not too long ago— wait, don’t tell me you suspect me of those explosions? Ha! What would I even gain? Would I do it just to call you out or something? Sigh... do you three have some sort of grudge against me? Even the last time you were suspecting me," Vritra said, shaking his head sadly.
"No, it’s nothing like that. We were just surprised to see you here. You are one of the king’s guests, so just enjoy your time here," J spoke, flashing a smile.
The three men turned around and began walking away while discussing the explosions. Vritra also turned and began to walk into the hotel building like many others.
In the sky, a stone wrapped in a paper was floating. With a thought from Vritra, it began to fall toward the men from the Golden Moon.
THUD
"Ow!!" J rubbed his head as the stone hit him. Of course, it didn’t cause him any pain, but he was surprised that he didn’t sense it in time.
"Oh my God!!"

Vritra heard J’s surprised voice from behind and heaved a sigh of relief that this part was also done rather easily. But then J spoke: "I can’t believe someone dares to hit me with a stone. Who is it?"
Vritra glanced back and saw J holding the stone, but the paper was on the ground.
"What?!! Someone really dares to hit you?" Vritra exclaimed as he walked back. Then, as if he had noticed something, he spoke in surprise: "Huh? There is something written on the paper."
The three men finally saw it. K quickly picked it up and began reading it, and a shocked expression appeared on his face. Then he showed it to the other two.
"What is written on it?" Vritra asked while trying to take a peek.
"Nothing, it is confidential." K put the paper away. Then, glancing at the other two, he walked away.
’And it is done. Now I just need to spend some time in the hotel to avoid any suspicion. I hope they can take care of the Grieves and even the Nine Pacts,’ Vritra thought.
He watched the three men fly away in the direction of the First City, where the temple was located.

People had started to calm down after the initial panic. They returned to their rooms and continued with their activities. When Vritra arrived near his room, he found the same rat-faced servant standing with a large tray in his hand.
There was a stench coming from the tray, its top covered by a cloth. Vritra tried to be calm as he stopped beside the servant and asked, "What are you doing here?"
{Sin Point Gained: Mocked +1}

"Sir, I have brought food for you. Don’t worry, it is free, but I would be happy if you could give me a small tip in return— nothing much, just 1 million gold coins." While speaking, he removed the cloth and revealed the contents of the tray.

There was a rotten fish that was half eaten, dirty water in a glass, and all the dishes were spoiled and looked really disgusting. Vritra’s brows knitted together as he barely managed to stop himself from cracking open the rat’s face. He spoke in a calm tone:
"Get this away right now."
{Sin Point Gained: Taunted +1}

"Why? Is it because you don’t want to give me my small tip? Ha! So shameless. Now that I have brought it here, you have to eat it." In the next moment, the rat-faced man threw the entire contents of the tray toward Vritra.

"..." Vritra easily sidestepped and dodged it all. It was as clear as day that the staff of the hotel was targeting him, and since this restaurant belonged to the royal family, it wasn’t hard to guess who must be behind it.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +12}
There were even people who were secretly looking at the two of them right now, so it was all staged.

Vritra could still control his anger because he didn’t want to start another round of trouble. But Yasmine got really pissed. She had tolerated him long enough, even though he had been disrespecting her husband— but now...
BOOM

A strong wave of energy was suddenly released as the rat-faced man was blasted away. He smashed against the wall and coughed blood; a couple of his bones might have broken, but the attack wasn’t strong enough to kill him.

’Sigh... now you’ve done it...’ Vritra shook his head. This was clearly the situation he was trying to avoid, and just as he had expected, the rat-faced man clutched his head and began to scream with all his might.

"Aaaaah! M- My head! Ugghhhh! I was just delivering food! Uwaaaah! Why did you attack me—sob sbo—suddenly? H-Help me! He is trying to—sob sob—kill me! Haa haa! When I asked him to pay his bills—aaaaah it hurts—sob sob!"
In the next second, the people that were secretly watching until now ran out into the open with exaggerated expressions. They looked at the bloodied rat and then accusingly at Vritra.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +35}
Within a minute, lots of people had gathered— the people staying in the hotel, the servants, the guards, and lots more.
The hallway outside the room was completely crowded. The fat manager pushed the crowd aside as he made his way to the center. Then, seeing the rat, he showed an angry expression.
"What happened here?" the manager asked.
{Sin Point Gained: Framed +1}

"S-Sir, I just came to deliver him—haa haa—some food, and when—ughh—I asked him to pay for his bills, he suddenly a-attacked me—sob sob—please help me! Aaah! He is a criminal..." the rat said before fainting.
Vritra already understood the entire situation. This was definitely a setup by the young prince— that spoiled rotten bastard.

There were many ways he could deal with such a situation. The easiest would obviously be with the use of Natural Hypnosis. But since the prince wanted to play like this, then he would get a hundredfold in return.
The youngest prince loved to play pranks? Then he would certainly love the pranks that would be coming his way.
{Sin Point Gained: Glared at +1}
"You!! Is that true?" the fat manager asked, his overly chubby face scrunched in rage. He was certainly putting up a great show.

"Of course not, he is lying," Vritra said, playing along. If he wasn’t wrong about this cliché prince situation, then very soon they would try to get him arrested, bring up lots of guards, lock him up— where they could probably even torture him.

chapters.title: Chapter 219: Scheme
paragraphs: "Tsk, tsk. If you can’t afford to stay here, why would you even come? Sigh, this is the problem with the poor..." The people that were watching the show earlier mixed in the crowd and began to say rude things.
"I can’t believe he attacked a servant. Why don’t you just go to some cheaper hotel if you can’t afford this? Heh, just lie down on the road if you’re so broke." Another person added.
Even the people staying in the hotel now began to discuss what was happening, and the way it was unfolding, all believed it was Vritra’s fault, so they took the fat manager’s side.
"I don’t care what you want to say, apologize to Rat and pay the money you owe us," the fatty said, pointing a finger at Vritra.
"S-Sir, he owe us 1 million...cough coughgold coins... ughhh I saw him... h-he stole a few things e-earlier... ughhh..." the unconscious Rat woke up for a moment before falling back.

"..." Even the fat manager fell silent for a moment at such an absurd amount. He had asked to name a big price but not this big. But after coughing, he said, "I won’t ask you to pay the entire money—just return what you stole and pay your bills. After you apologize to Rat, I will let you leave."
"But I didn’t steal anything," Vritra said, shrugging his shoulders. He could already sense a lot of presences surrounding the entire hotel—this thing was going to become very big.

"Haa, don’t make me use force. Just admit your mistake. This is the last time I am asking this nicely. As the biggest business in the entire kingdom, we have to maintain our reputation. I said we will just let you go, so do as I say," the fatty said, pretending to be enraged. His cheeks turned red.
"Well, I can’t do that. I have stolen nothing," Vritra replied with a shake of his head.

"Hmm, if you are so adamant about it, then why don’t you come with our guards and let them search you? If you have nothing to fear, then it shouldn’t be a big deal." Fatty gestured toward the entrance of the corridor, where lots of guards began to gather.
"Arrest me? But are you capable of doing that?" Vritra’s patience was running thin now. He had tolerated them long enough. He didn’t want to invite trouble for now, but it seemed that was impossible.

"Sigh... Guards, arrest this criminal since he refuses to cooperate. Detain him and bring him to the prison. We will properly interrogate him there." Fatty ordered, his thick voice reverberating across the corridor.

Instantly, the place was filled with the sound of footsteps as dozens upon dozens of guards charged towards Vritra. Carrying swords and shields, they all rushed at him. Instead of just arresting him, it seemed they first wanted to beat him up a little.

"Are you sure you want to do this? Haven’t you seen the show long enough? Why don’t you come out now?" Vritra said, looking at the far corner of the corridor where the prince was happily observing everything.
Even after being called out, the young prince didn’t respond and waited for the guards to beat him up. He had sent those goons dressed as guards to beat Vritra up.

He knew Vritra was very strong—otherwise, he wouldn’t have become the biggest competition of the kingdom. He knew Vritra could easily kill them all, and that’s exactly what the prince wanted him to do.
The moment Vritra resisted and killed the goons, he would call the strong guards of the king and get him arrested. Then his crime would be much higher.
’Hehe, you are completely trapped here. Now you will pay for disrespecting me.’ The prince grinned, gesturing at the guards he had brought along to be ready.
"If it’s what you want, then..." Vritra’s face became emotionless as he pulled out a sword from his inventory and held it lightly in his hand before muttering in a low voice:
"Anyone who comes close will die."
Vritra didn’t let out any of his aura, but upon hearing those words, the guards paused and looked uncertainly at the manager. For some reason, they felt an inexplicable fear toward Vritra.

"What are you waiting for? Go and arrest him! You are free to attack if he resists." The manager said haughtily. He knew about the prince’s plan—these thirty or so people were nothing more than cannon fodder.
"Surrender now, or you will get hurt." One of the men charged forward and shouted. Without even giving Vritra a chance to speak, he swung his blade at his abdomen, aiming to give a fatal blow.
SWISH
Vritra’s hand became a blur. The sound of air being torn was heard, and in the next moment, the guard at the front began to scream in terror as both his hands were cut off in one fluid motion.
"Aaaaaah, MY HANDSSSS!! Ughhhhh Umph—"
In the next moment, the sword was plunged into his mouth and came out from the back of his head. The guard’s eyes remained wide open as he took his last breath before falling limply to the floor.
There was pin-drop silence after the first death, and then...
STEP STEP
Vritra started walking forward, slowly. His hands left afterimages in the air, and the sword in his hand danced across the space. The sound of limbs and heads falling to the ground filled the air.
The spectators, who were just there for a good show, were terrified by the bloody scene. They turned around and fled, completely horrified by the brutal killing.
The screams of the goons reverberated amidst the faint sound of Vritra’s footsteps. He kept moving forward, his gaze only fixed on the young prince who was hiding.

The more than thirty goons were completely terrified as Vritra slaughtered more than fifteen of them within moments and effortlessly. They understood that they were nothing more than sacrifices in this battle.

They turned around and tried to flee, but now the prince—who was still grinning in the distance, watching his plan succeed—finally asked the guards to make a move. Most of the guards he had brought were in the 1st Legion rank, so there was no way Vritra would be able to defeat them all.
He knew that Vritra had also entered the Legion rank recently, but how high could his level have become in such a short time? And so, the fool made the devil his enemy.
"Oh no, that madman has started to slaughter innocent people now!! Someone call for the kingdom guards, we need to stop him from continuing his rampage! He has gone mad!"
The fat manager laughed while shouting. He too moved to the back and stood beside the prince, watching the scene with intrigue.
The fat manager was the brother of the youngest prince’s mother. That was how he got such a high position in Paradise Hotel.
The prince would promise him a few things, and the fatty would always help him. The opponent this time was slightly stronger, so they needed a plan.
The goons who were trying to escape met a wall of guards blocking the path, so they had no choice but to move toward the damned demon along with those guards.

"But I didn’t steal anything," Vritra said, shrugging his shoulders.
He could already sense a lot of presences surrounding the entire hotel—this thing was going to become very big.
"Haa, don’t make me use force.
Just admit your mistake.
This is the last time I am asking this nicely.
As the biggest business in the entire kingdom, we have to maintain our reputation.
I said we will just let you go, so do as I say," the fatty said, pretending to be enraged.
His cheeks turned red.
"Well, I can’t do that.
I have stolen nothing," Vritra replied with a shake of his head.
"Hmm, if you are so adamant about it, then why don’t you come with our guards and let them search you?
If you have nothing to fear, then it shouldn’t be a big deal." Fatty gestured toward the entrance of the corridor, where lots of guards began to gather.
"Arrest me?
But are you capable of doing that?" Vritra’s patience was running thin now.
He had tolerated them long enough.
He didn’t want to invite trouble for now, but it seemed that was impossible.
"Sigh...
Guards, arrest this criminal since he refuses to cooperate.
Detain him and bring him to the prison.
We will properly interrogate him there." Fatty ordered, his thick voice reverberating across the corridor.
Instantly, the place was filled with the sound of footsteps as dozens upon dozens of guards charged towards Vritra.
Carrying swords and shields, they all rushed at him.
Instead of just arresting him, it seemed they first wanted to beat him up a little.
"Are you sure you want to do this?
Haven’t you seen the show long enough?
Why don’t you come out now?" Vritra said, looking at the far corner of the corridor where the prince was happily observing everything.
Even after being called out, the young prince didn’t respond and waited for the guards to beat him up.
He had sent those goons dressed as guards to beat Vritra up.
He knew Vritra was very strong—otherwise, he wouldn’t have become the biggest competition of the kingdom.
He knew Vritra could easily kill them all, and that’s exactly what the prince wanted him to do.
The moment Vritra resisted and killed the goons, he would call the strong guards of the king and get him arrested.
Then his crime would be much higher.
’Hehe, you are completely trapped here.
Now you will pay for disrespecting me.’ The prince grinned, gesturing at the guards he had brought along to be ready.
"If it’s what you want, then..." Vritra’s face became emotionless as he pulled out a sword from his inventory and held it lightly in his hand before muttering in a low voice:
"Anyone who comes close will die."
Vritra didn’t let out any of his aura, but upon hearing those words, the guards paused and looked uncertainly at the manager.
For some reason, they felt an inexplicable fear toward Vritra.
"What are you waiting for?
Go and arrest him!
You are free to attack if he resists." The manager said haughtily.
He knew about the prince’s plan—these thirty or so people were nothing more than cannon fodder.
"Surrender now, or you will get hurt." One of the men charged forward and shouted.
Without even giving Vritra a chance to speak, he swung his blade at his abdomen, aiming to give a fatal blow.
SWISH
Vritra’s hand became a blur.
The sound of air being torn was heard, and in the next moment, the guard at the front began to scream in terror as both his hands were cut off in one fluid motion.
"Aaaaaah, MY HANDSSSS!!
Ughhhhh Umph—"
In the next moment, the sword was plunged into his mouth and came out from the back of his head.
The guard’s eyes remained wide open as he took his last breath before falling limply to the floor.
There was pin-drop silence after the first death, and then...
STEP STEP
Vritra started walking forward, slowly.
His hands left afterimages in the air, and the sword in his hand danced across the space.
The sound of limbs and heads falling to the ground filled the air.
The spectators, who were just there for a good show, were terrified by the bloody scene.
They turned around and fled, completely horrified by the brutal killing.
The screams of the goons reverberated amidst the faint sound of Vritra’s footsteps.
He kept moving forward, his gaze only fixed on the young prince who was hiding.
The more than thirty goons were completely terrified as Vritra slaughtered more than fifteen of them within moments and effortlessly.
They understood that they were nothing more than sacrifices in this battle.
They turned around and tried to flee, but now the prince—who was still grinning in the distance, watching his plan succeed—finally asked the guards to make a move.
Most of the guards he had brought were in the 1st Legion rank, so there was no way Vritra would be able to defeat them all.
He knew that Vritra had also entered the Legion rank recently, but how high could his level have become in such a short time?
And so, the fool made the devil his enemy.
"Oh no, that madman has started to slaughter innocent people now!!
Someone call for the kingdom guards, we need to stop him from continuing his rampage!
He has gone mad!"
The fat manager laughed while shouting.
He too moved to the back and stood beside the prince, watching the scene with intrigue.
The fat manager was the brother of the youngest prince’s mother.
That was how he got such a high position in Paradise Hotel.
The prince would promise him a few things, and the fatty would always help him.
The opponent this time was slightly stronger, so they needed a plan.
The goons who were trying to escape met a wall of guards blocking the path, so they had no choice but to move toward the damned demon along with those guards.

chapters.title: Chapter 220: Terror
paragraphs: Vritra didn’t care whether these people were just following orders or not. Since they were here to attack him, he wouldn’t hold back—and why would he refuse so many experience points?
Putting away the flashy sword, Vritra wielded two sharp swords formed by dust; each sword was around a meter long.
Taking a step forward, he raised his right hand high and then brought down the sword in a vertical slash. The sharp blade passed through one of the goon’s bodies very smoothly.

With a terrified look on his face, the man in the front was sliced in two. The ones behind watched in horror and disgust as his internal organs, blood, and bones began to slip out from the two halves of his body.
[You have killed a Level 216 Human.]
[You have killed a Level 232 Human.]
[+EXP Earned.]
The dark swords mercilessly cleaved through the bodies of the remaining goons. They could only scream in horror and try to escape before the sword flashed in their eyes and darkness swallowed them.
In less than a minute, the pieces of more than thirty men were lying all over the floor, while a shadow sneaked across the corridor and devoured all the souls.
Bobby barely held itself back from attacking the kingdom guards and consuming their souls.

"Surrender now. If you continue with this mindless killing, you will be declared an enemy of the entire kingdom. If you surrender, we will be lenient with your punishment. Just let us detain you," the commander of the guards warned, stopping a little away from Vritra.
"Go back. If any of you attack me, I will kill all of you," Vritra said, his blood-red eyes glowing.

The air became extremely tense, while the prince held his belly and laughed. He didn’t know Vritra would be so stupid. He should have just surrendered earlier. He would definitely die if he went against the entire kingdom.

"Hahahaha, this is too funny. I thought he was smarter than this—and look at him, sinking deeper and deeper into my plan because of his ego," the youngest prince laughed hard along with the fat manager, who was ready for the show with snacks.
He would be receiving a big favour from the prince for doing this job. He put out two chairs as the two sat down and enjoyed the snacks, waiting to see Vritra get cut to pieces by the guards.
"Don’t hold back—kill the intruder!" the commander shouted, pointing his sword forward as a wave of guards rushed towards Vritra, their killing intent expanding over the entire hotel.

The commander had received commands from the prince too, but he couldn’t have given the order to kill Vritra if he had cooperated. But Vritra had done just as they wanted—now they could just kill him without any trouble.
Vritra scanned the building and saw that there were at least a hundred guards, and more were gathering as they heard of the commotion.
The prince had even sent the news back to the castle that someone was trying to assassinate him, so the strongest protectors would soon be there as well.

"I am giving you one last chance. If you want to survive, then throw away your weapons and leave. But if you wish to sacrifice yourselves for the noble cause of becoming a plaything for a rotten prince, I will personally end your meaningless lives," Vritra said. With a light slash of his sword, a deep cut appeared on the floor.

The guards at the front knew that Vritra was extremely strong, and the first one to approach him would receive the brunt of his attack, so they hesitated. But the commander continued to push them forward.
Like a wave, the guards in armor filled the corridor and rushed at Vritra, pointing their weapons at him, ready to kill.

"..." Vritra released a long breath and closed his eyes for a moment, as the energy around him began to fluctuate. It was like a tsunami of blood was flowing across the hotel. The air was filled with a blood mist, and all felt suffocated under the unbearable pressure.
The moment Vritra released a little of his killing intent, even the 1st Legion-ranked men froze, feeling as if the very blood in their bodies was repulsing against taking one step forward.
They felt as if thousands of insects were crawling all over their bodies. Before he even made a move, most of them lost control of the energy they were gathering, and it exploded within their bodies.
Almost all the people staying in the hotel had already fainted under the pressure of the killing intent.
The manager and the prince’s faces suddenly paled. They hadn’t fainted because of the various treasures they were carrying, but the two were in no better shape.

Fatty even puked, while the prince felt as if his entire body was being squeezed between rocks. The two shivered as they fell off their chairs and understood that they had greatly underestimated Vritra.
The fat manager cursed his nephew in his mind for getting him involved in such a mess. He regretted agreeing to help this rotten bastard.
The two began dragging their bodies back while staring in terror at the figure standing in the storm of blood. The killing intent was so dense, it was as if he had slaughtered several cities.

"C-Call for father—ask for help! Hurrryyyy!!" the crown prince shouted, urging one of the guards to go, his own body refusing to move. The frozen guard didn’t waste this chance as he turned around and ran with all his might.
"O-Oh right, I need to leave. H-he’ll kill me... haa... haa... I have to get out of here." The prince only remembered this as he watched the guard run away.
Vritra didn’t speak further. He began moving forward once again, taking slow and deliberate steps, making everyone shiver as they heard those dreadful thumping sounds.
WHOOSH
SWISH
CLANG
Vritra’s gaze was fixed on the prince as he moved his hands at lightning speed. The frozen guards were cut along with their armor as the dust sword passed through their bodies.

He completely ignored the sin point and leveling up messages that kept popping up. He had done his best to ignore all the disrespect from the beginning, but it was as if his blood itself was enraged at the humiliation.
He possessed the bloodline of the Demon God and Dragon King, both of whom were extremely prideful beings. All the suppressed anger burst forward at once.
The rat, who was still pretending to be dead, rolled slowly to get to the back. Previously, he was really excited about his excellent performance.
He was sure that he was definitely going to get a promotion—but now he was so afraid that he leaked from both the back and front at once.
His body kept shivering on the ground uncontrollably, even as he tried to slip away silently.
Vritra looked at Rat in disgust. He didn’t halt to attack the terrified man. Instead, he moved his foot and placed it on top of Rat’s head, who finally opened his eyes with a terrified look.
A wave of pain shot through his head, as Vritra began to apply some force.
"Aaaaaaaaaah S- Spare meeeee"

chapters.title: Chapter 221: Do you want to die?
paragraphs: "Aaaaaaah S- Spare mesobI’m sorry the manager asked m- meahhhhhto do thissob ughhhspare meeeeee!"
Vritra slowly began to press as cracks began to form over his skull, and the rat screamed in pain, wriggling helplessly.
In the next moment, Vritra stomped over Rat’s head, making it explode in all directions, as pieces of his brain and skull flew all around.
The people watching this were terrified to see such an inhumane act, the most shocked was of course the fat manager since this rat man was the brother of his wife.
He had just joined the hotel which is why he started from the lowest position, but fatty was going to give him a promotion after this.
"Uh H- He... S- Save m-aaaaaah" the young prince screamed in horror. He wasn’t even able to form proper words; he had started to regret ever playing this prank on Vritra.
"S- Stop him!!" the commander shouted as he moved back and made the guards attack Vritra. The fearful guards couldn’t move back or forward, they were afraid of even getting close to that devil.
Vritra continued to move. Not a single drop of blood could be seen on his body— even his shoe was completely clean, even after smashing Rat’s head.

Right then, six men appeared in front of the guards out of nowhere and the sight of them gave the prince extreme confidence. These were the personal protectors of the king, few of the strongest members of the entire kingdom.
There was just no way Vritra, who had just entered legion rank, could take a single attack from them.
Their level was above 1900, even the king can’t face all of them at once, so they doubted a new legion-rank warrior could do anything in front of them.

"Yes yes, kill that bastard. H- He killed so many guards for no reason, he has gone mad. Kill him immediately before he could h- harm me, hahaha let me see how you get out of this, Jin Woo. Die, you bastard!!"
All of the prince’s fear transformed into rage as he shouted, waiting to see Vritra be brutally murdered.
One of the five stepped forward. After gazing around at all the corpses, he spoke to Vritra in a calm but arrogant tone.
"Stop right there and surrender, or we are going to kill you in the most gruesome way."
"But can you?" Vritra asked, his voice devoid of emotions as he started walking forward.
[Fourth Dimension Activated.]
Seeing Vritra charge without any fear, the six gave him one last warning, but it didn’t hinder Vritra so finally they decided to kill him right there and then.
Just one of the men took a step forward, confident that he alone would be enough to deal with Vritra.
Raising his hand, he pointed his fingers towards Vritra as his fingers began to transform into claws. Then he pounced forward, slashing at Vritra’s neck at an extreme speed.
SWISH

His claws tore through Vritra’s neck, but something was strange. He didn’t get that satisfying feeling of his claws tearing apart flesh; it was like Vritra had turned into air, and his deadly attack just passed straight through his body.
"How is this possible? What sort of ability is it?" the attacker exclaimed. The other five were just as shocked, but for the first attack, they wanted to believe that Vritra somehow got lucky.
He slashed again, then again and again...
But each time, his claws just passed right through.
Vritra’s body continued to move forward. Vritra’s control over the fourth dimension had already risen to a level where he could even make a small part of his body disappear for a split second.

The only part of his body that disappeared were the parts attacked by the claw—that’s why no one even noticed his body disappearing. The others were flabbergasted as they watched their friend helplessly use all sorts of attacks against Vritra, but nothing worked.
After looking at one another, they too decided to join, and all six of them began to attack him at once with all sorts of attacks—some physical, energy-based, and even mental.
Although mental attacks could still work on Vritra, his intelligence points were very high, and withShiftandRecoveringworking in the background, he wasn’t affected at all.
"W- What is happening? Is he made of air? Why aren’t they able to kill him? Aren’t they supposed to be the strongest in this kingdom?

How can he be so strong—didn’t he just reach the legion rank?" The prince was in despair once again, he was terrified as he watched Vritra walking forward even though the six men continued to try to hurt him.
"Huff huff, K- Keep trying, this must be some sort of high-level ability. Since it is so special, then it must need a large amount of energy—he will run out of energy sooner or later."
One of the men spoke, but then he froze as Vritra simply passed through him. It was really like he was a ghost. The six men felt helpless as they could only watch Vritra move forward.
Even though the young prince was useless and spoiled, it was their duty to protect the members of the royal family.
Vritra raised both his hands to either side of his body, as the dust swords extended and created a loud noise as they tore through the walls on both sides and continued to drag forward.

With a sudden movement, Vritra slashed with both the swords horizontally, making a semi-circle in the air, as all the guards who were cowering behind the six protectors were torn apart at the same time.
More than seventy men died in an instant, and finally, the prince and the fat manager had no one to hide behind.
They got on their knees and started to cry, beg, hit their heads on the floor as the fear of death finally crept into their hearts.
The dust swords disappeared. Vritra extended one hand forward as the invisible dust particles moved at extreme speed and pulled the fat manager suddenly towards him.

"Aaaaaaah S- Stop him someoneeeeee pleasesob sobI am sorry! It was that rotten prince’s fault, please I beg you, s- spare my life." Fatty cried as Vritra made a grabbing motion and the fatty was hung in the air. He really felt as if his throat was being strangled.
"What is going on here?" A hurried voice sounded from near the prince.
Vritra raised his eyes and glanced at the king, who had arrived there in a hurry along with lots of other people—even the crown prince was present.
"!!!" Henry was shocked to see so many of his dead men. The six protectors were still trying to kill Vritra, but to no avail.
And the fatty hung in the air. The king gritted his teeth as he tried to remain calm and spoke:
"Put him down first. I am sure this must be my son’s fault, so let’s talk it out."

Vritra’s gaze remained on the king. With a light squeeze of his hand, dust particles swirling around the fatty’s body suddenly charged towards him and violently tore his skin, creating a bloody mess of blood and flesh.
Then a deadly pressure descended, and it almost made the king kneel.
"Henry, do you want to die?"

The six protectors were still trying to kill Vritra, but to no avail.
And the fatty hung in the air.
The king gritted his teeth as he tried to remain calm and spoke:
"Put him down first.
I am sure this must be my son’s fault, so let’s talk it out."
Vritra’s gaze remained on the king.
With a light squeeze of his hand, dust particles swirling around the fatty’s body suddenly charged towards him and violently tore his skin, creating a bloody mess of blood and flesh.
Then a deadly pressure descended, and it almost made the king kneel.
"Henry, do you want to die?"

chapters.title: Chapter 222: Punishment
paragraphs: "Henry, do you want to die?" Vritra’s words froze everyone. They stared at him in shock. He was talking to the king of the kingdom — they couldn’t understand how he suddenly became so fearless.

On the other hand, Henry was the most shocked as he stared blankly at Vritra. Hearing such disrespectful and threatening words from a random boy, he should have gotten angry, he should have given him a death sentence instantly — it was blatant blasphemy.

But for some unknown reason, a fear rose from deep within the king; he felt that the boy in front of him might really deliver his threat. He stood there with his fists clenched and his heart beating wildly.

"I- It’s all our fault. I am sorry for showing you such poor hospitality. I will make sure nothing of this sort happens with our important guests. I am sorry. This won’t happen again, so please just spare my son." After a few seconds’ pause, Henry finally spoke, and his words shook everyone even more.
He is a prideful king after all. They expected him to kill Vritra right away after he said those words, but instead, it was the king who acted humble.

’I- Is the king afraid of him?’ everyone had this thought. Everyone stood silently — even the protectors had stopped their attempts to hurt Vritra. The whole space was frozen as they waited for Vritra to make a decision.
The prince lay on the ground, his clothes spoiled as he clung to his father’s feet, rubbing his snot and tears against his father’s clothes, shivering in fear.
He just wanted to leave. For the first time in his life, he had regretted his decision. He couldn’t understand why even his almighty father had lowered himself in front of Vritra.

"Aaaaaaaah B- Brother-in-law, uwaaaah h- help me pleaseeeee sob sob it hurtsssss agghhhhh," the fat man screamed. The dust particles had already torn all the skin on his body, and now his muscles and flesh were completely visible.
Even the slightest touch made him feel as if a burning iron rod was pressed against him. The fatty flailed his limbs helplessly in the air, feeling an extreme amount of pain.

"Uh C- Can you spare—" the king had just started to speak when suddenly, fatty’s arms and legs twisted backward, his tongue was pulled out, and his eyeballs gouged out of his eye sockets. His flesh was torn as the fatty lost consciousness.
THUD
Then he fell limply to the ground, barely breathing.
"Fine, since you asked, I will spare his life." Vritra said. The fatty might be breathing, but all four of his limbs were gone. Even if they fed him great potions, he probably wouldn’t survive.
"Now, for your son..." Vritra’s gaze now moved to the rotten prince who was hiding behind his father. King Henry’s heart clenched at the sight of the fat manager.
Every fibre and cell of his body was pushing away the idea of fighting Vritra, so the king hoped Vritra could spare the youngest prince.
"..." After thinking for a few seconds, he finally spoke:

"Fine, I will spare him since you asked so nicely. But this pig needs to be punished, and I will do it my way. And don’t worry, I won’t torture him like that fatass. His punishment will be very simple."

"O- Okay..." Henry agreed. He had always overlooked his youngest son’s mischievous crimes, but it seemed his jokes might have become way too cruel and evil, so a small punishment might not be a bad thing.
"B- But sob sob father, you need to k- kill him—" the young prince started crying and spoke in a pitiful tone.

"Shut up. This is your mess, so face it yourself." King Henry kicked the prince away, then turned and walked off. This prince might be his favourite, but he had many children, so he wouldn’t put his life in danger because of one or two.
"Now, are you ready for your punishment?" Vritra’s lips curled into an evil smile as he looked at the frightened prince, who shivered and fainted.
’B- Brother-in-law is a little too scary...’ the crown prince thought.

Vritra decided to give a punishment that no one would be able to forget for hundreds of years, and with this, he also planned to get some sin points; after all, who wouldn’t be interested in seeing a prince being punished publicly?

He called Monk Shitless, giving him a little bit of free time from his Sonia character. Vritra explained the punishment to Shitless, and he was instantly overjoyed. This strange monk truly loved chaos.
It was around three in the afternoon, right outside the castle.
The news of the punishment had already spread like wildfire all across the city, so a lot of people had gathered to see the punishment along the streets.
Vritra stood to the side while Monk Shitless held a thin and long green stick that seemed really elastic. He waved it in the air with a big grin on his face.
While the prince stood there with a terrified expression, he had heard what sort of punishment he was going to get, and he was ashamed and shocked at the same time.

How could someone treat a prince like that in his own kingdom? He couldn’t understand what his father was thinking to allow something like that — isn’t disrespecting the prince a direct slap to the king?
"Oye, what are you daydreaming about? Get started. We don’t have all day to waste." Monk Shitless acted even mightier against the meek prince.
"P- Please, can we just forget the p- punishment? I will give you whatever you want, so please..." the prince pleaded, tears streaming down his cheek.
"Sigh. Are you starting or do you want to get the same punishment as your uncle?" Vritra said emotionlessly. Fatty was already dead.
"... I will do it." The prince finally spoke. Then, after looking at his surroundings and seeing the gazes of everyone in the crowd, he really felt like dying.

But hardening his heart, he began to remove his clothes until he was only in his thong. To preserve a little bit of the dignity of the prince who was soon going to die, Vritra allowed him to at least wear a thong.
"Keke. Start already, you bastard." Monk Shitless said as he hit the ground with the stick, creating a loud noise that made the prince shiver.
After gulping his saliva, the prince sat on all fours like a dog.
SLAP
Monk Shitless hit the prince’s butt with the thin stick as he let out a loud scream and a deep red mark appeared on his skin.
"Get moving and speaking, you useless spoiled bastard." Shitless said. He really seemed to be enjoying this.
And so the prince began to drag his shivering body forward, walking like a dog in the streets of the city while constantly shouting one line in between his sobs and cries.
"I- I, Prince Henry Jr the 14th, am a man with ten fathers..." the prince spoke meekly, while walking slowly, feeling countless gazes on his body.
SLAP
"You pig, speak loudly." Monk Shitless hit his butt again with even more force.
"sob Uwaaaah I, PRINCE HENRY JR THE 14TH, AM A MAN WITH TEN FATHERS!!" the prince shouted.
Vritra walked calmly beside the two as he farmed sin points.
