chapters.title: Chapter 223: He do have balls
paragraphs: {Sin Points Gained: Watched +15,353}
{Sin Points Gained: Terrified +8,838}
{Sin Points Gained: Praised +10,194}
SMACK
"KIYAAAAAH~ Uiiiiiiii~ I- I AM A PIG!!" the young prince shouted. His butt was already as red as a monkey’s; Monk Shitless had even started to hit his back and legs.
"Is that really the youngest prince? I can’t believe someone could actually do this to a prince, but it’s so satisfying to see him like that," someone in the crowd muttered.
"Baldy, hit harder, this bastard is still smiling."

"Sob sob I, Prince Henry Jr the 14th, am a result of teamwork." The prince spoke while crawling across the streets of the city. He could clearly hear the mocking tone of the people, their laughter—he felt humiliated and ashamed.

Not to mention the pain—even more than Vritra, he kept cursing the Baldy in his mind. He had already been walking like this for more than thirty minutes; he had become a complete joke. How would he ever be able to step in front of anyone again?

Vritra just continued to walk along with the two, followed by a large crowd. He didn’t really care all that much about this punishment, but the Sin Points were worth it. He already planned to kill the prince to avoid any sort of future trouble.
The royal ride of the prince continued for several hours. His body was covered in bruises, and he was even bleeding. Monk Shitless was going all out when he hit the prince.

The evening had finally arrived, and by now, even the prince’s palms and knees were badly bruised. He was barely dragging himself forward and felt relieved that the whole nightmare was finally about to end.
He was definitely going to make Vritra and the Baldy pay for this in whatever way he could. By now, even the gazes and words of the public didn’t bother him all that much.
Monk Shitless cleared his throat, and since the whole activity was about to end, he decided to deliver the final blow with all his might as he shouted:
"You degenerate brat, shout louder, crawl faster, tell me how many fathers do you have?!! You spineless cowardly bastard, are you even a man? You got balls or just an empty rental space down there?"
WHOOSH

Then he pulled his hand back and brought it toward the prince’s ass with all his might, using every bit of his strength in this final attack. But unfortunately, when delivering such a powerful strike, his aim became a bit off.
SMAAACCCCKKKKKKK
"UWAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!"The young prince let out a heart-wrenching scream that was neither human nor bestial. The entire space froze at that loud, painful scream.

All of them felt a shiver as they watched the prince clutch his crotch while his body spasmed violently. Fog flew out of his mouth as he coughed, his eyeballs almost bulged out, and within moments, he fainted.
’Accidentally,’ the flexible and deadly stick had struck the prince’s balls. And as it seems, the space down there wasn’t empty.
’So the balls are still there... or they were...’ Monk Shitless froze as well. He hadn’t planned to turn the prince into a eunuch.
"H- He should still be fine, right?" clearing his throat, the monk asked, acting as if nothing was wrong.
"Yeah, I think so. The punishment is over. You did great, prince," Vritra said before turning around and walking away, looking at the beautiful clouds in the sky.

Monk Shitless threw the stick away and fled. After hiding in an alley, he transformed into a beautiful woman and calmly walked away. The crowd looked at the deflated and pitiful prince and scattered. They didn’t want to get punished by the king.

The guards that had been watching the entire show from behind and laughing were startled. They ran forward after everyone had started to scatter. One of them checked his condition, and thankfully, he was still alive.
"L- Let’s go, we need to bring the prince back immediately." Two guards carefully lifted the prince and started hurriedly walking back.
But the foot of one of the guards slipped over a stick that lay on the ground, and he slipped, throwing the prince headfirst onto the ground.
Now, there was a big injury over his head as well.
"I- It’s that Baldy’s fault. Let’s go back." The guard quickly got up after looking left and right. He picked up the prince, and the few guards ran back.
Vanessa, Fiona, and Diana were getting bored inside the castle, so just as Vritra had suggested, they decided to go out to the market and have some personal women time.

They wore veils, and with the barriers set by Vritra, they didn’t attract too much attention. Diana had a lot of money. The gold coins from the Dunshire Kingdom worked even in the Blue Kingdom, so they purchased all sorts of things they liked.
"Haa, why does it feel so hot?" Vanessa spoke, using her handkerchief to wipe her forehead.
"I swear it wasn’t so hot when he left. Why did it become hot so suddenly?" Diana mumbled, fanning her face with a paper fan.
"I wonder why the streets look so empty today. Where have all the people gone?" Fiona wondered. Just some time ago, all the people had started walking away.
The three women did hear something about the youngest prince.
They had just entered one of the shops to look at different clothes when Diana saw several people in white dresses walking across the street, looking around as if they were searching for something.

’The Grieves?’ the three women exclaimed. Only Diana could sense a dangerous energy lingering around their bodies. They acted perfectly normal and continued with their shopping, wondering why the Grieves were here again.
After those men left, the three of them decided to end their shopping a bit early and went back. They noticed that even the atmosphere at the castle was a bit strange.
The guards didn’t dare look straight at them, and even the servants were being too respectful toward them.
Seeing such behavior from everyone, they knew that it must be because of Vritra. They wondered what he could have done now.
"I guess we will be leaving this kingdom quite soon as well," Fiona said, while trying out her new dresses and showing them to the two women.
"Oh, that looks great on you. I am sure Vritra would love it too," Vanessa said. Then she pulled Fiona’s arm and made her sit beside her, asking in an excited tone:
"So, among you two, who was the first to confess? How far have you two gone?"
She was in the mood to gossip, and what could be better than gossiping about her son’s love life?
"Uh... We have only kissed so far, and I was the first to confess first if I remember correctly..." Fiona said, feeling a little shy.
"Hmm, still only at that stage, huh? You need to make more progress. Do you need some tips? He must be waiting for you to get comfortable with him.
You need to seduce him. Believe me, your relationship could only reach the next step once you cross that invisible line between sweet and sinful," Vanessa spoke.
"..." Fiona nodded, while thinking about Vritra’s relationship with the two women in front of her. She already had an idea, though.

chapters.title: Chapter 224: The Robbery
paragraphs: Inside the Paradise Hotel, in one of the rooms on the top floor, a man peacefully sleeping blinked his eyes and looked around, wondering where the noise was coming from.
It was one of the members of the Golden Moon. After yawning, he fell back asleep, not really caring about what was going on outside; his sleep was way more important, after all.

As the sky started to turn dark, Vritra returned to the castle. He went to his room and told the three women about a few of the events with the young prince. The three of them were shocked and understood why the market seemed so empty.
"Can we really stay in this kingdom? You have literally beaten the prince to such a bad state," Diana asked, wondering why trouble always revolved around Vritra.
"We will stay a bit longer. I’m still waiting for that inheritance to open; sigh, I wonder when it will open," Vritra said. He constantly checked that inheritance, but it had yet to open.
"Will the king arrest or attack us?" Fiona asked, while Vanessa’s words revolving in her mind, though she felt this wasn’t the time to show her womanly side to her man.

"He won’t, don’t worry about that. Even if he does, it won’t be hard to kill him," Vritra said. The labyrinth was going to break very soon. The three Soul Wraiths were quite close to finishing their absorption.
So he needed to hurry with his robbery—he needed a lot of soul potions and weapons too. They had already seen the inventories, and Vritra already had a plan to borrow everything.
"Why don’t we go and eat something?" Vritra asked after a while. A lot had happened today, and a lot more was going to happen soon.
"Yeah, let’s go." Vanessa smiled. She could only imagine that funny scene and regretted not watching the prince walking across the city.
The four made their way out of the room and met Sonia there, who was in a great mood. She had taken all her frustrations out today.
They went to eat dinner together but found the cook hadn’t made anything yet.
Vritra asked one of the cooks about the reason and found that it was because of the injury of the young prince—he had sustained serious injury on his lower body and ended up losing both marbles.
The atmosphere inside the castle was quite hectic, but probably because of his fear, he didn’t even come to confront Vritra.
"Please prepare some food for us," Vritra said, and the cook hesitatingly agreed. They began to prepare the food.
"Is this really okay? Shouldn’t we leave the castle?" Diana asked, looking around at the guards who were running across the corridors from time to time.
"It will be fine. The king is a cautious man. He won’t do anything recklessly," Vritra replied calmly.

Soon the food was served, and the group of five began to eat. After eating, they took a walk around the castle while Sonia went to meet the crown prince. She was also quite close to achieving her goal.

And finally, when it was getting late, they returned to their rooms. Fiona and Diana went to sleep with anticipation of the next day. Vanessa sat on the bed and watched as Vritra changed into completely black clothes and got ready to leave.
"Be careful, honey," she said, giving a peck on his lips.
"I will be back soon," Vritra said with a smile before disappearing. The security here was higher than the Dunshire Kingdom’s, but it still couldn’t beat his Fourth Dimension.

While Vritra was passing through the corridor, he saw the crown prince walking with a determined look on his face. It seemed Sonia had already done her work, and now he was going to meet his father and ask for some answers.
The king must already be furious right now, so their meeting was bound to end up in failure. The bottled-up anger because of the youngest prince’s condition would all explode at the crown prince.
’Looks like Henry doesn’t have long to live. What is he going to do with so much treasure anyway?’ Vritra thought as he flew towards the treasury.

None of the guards were able to notice him. As his strength continued to increase, even his skills were becoming stronger. Before, even Bob and Bobby were able to sense him, but now not even the strongest guard could.

After a few minutes, Vritra appeared in the potion treasury that was several times bigger than the one in the Dunshire Kingdom. If the Goddess were to see it, then she would just faint from happiness—she loved potions and treasure too much, after all.

Vritra deactivated the Fourth Dimension and appeared inside the treasury. This time, however, people were stationed even inside the treasury, so Vritra activated Shift and moved at full speed as he turned into a blur.
None of the guards even noticed any change before they were knocked unconscious—without even being able to make a noise.
Yasmine helped Vritra avoid several of the glyphs that were used as a sort of alarm, and finally, he was free to take whatever he wanted.

First, he stored the large stash of potions into his inventory. There were a lot of potions that weren’t even present in the Dunshire Kingdom. Without thinking too much, he just threw them into the inventory.
After a few minutes, only the soul potions remained on the shelves.

"Mmm, it is feast time, let’s go hubby!!" Yasmine cheered excitedly. She was feeling too weak. Her strength was even lower than 1st Legion Rank. Finally, with so many soul potions, a bit more of her strength would be restored.
And even the Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo would also grow stronger as it healed, though it could also heal as Vritra got stronger Soul Wraiths.
"Yeah, let’s dig in." Vritra’s smile widened as he picked one potion after another and gulped them all down, throwing the glass bottles away, then moving to the next.

Just as the soul potion entered his body, it would directly turn into energy and would be absorbed by Vritra, Yasmine, and Nihil-Anima. So despite drinking so many soul potions, Vritra wasn’t overwhelmed.
Within minutes, Vritra had drunk hundreds of soul potions. This kingdom was several times richer, and the number of soul potions was simply too high.

By the time Vritra had reached the last batch of the soul potions, he finally felt that it was enough for now. He stored the rest for emergencies. It could be used to restore Yasmine’s energy or heal her if her soul got injured in the future.
"Hmm, now let’s move to the next area. Let’s feed the Chaos Axes some weapons now," Vritra spoke, but just as he was about to activate the Fourth Dimension, he froze.
At the labyrinth, a big change was occurring. Dark Knight and Hellmancer were barely managing to hold on, but the Chimera seemed to have already reached its limit.
Cracks had started to appear over its body. It was no longer able to absorb any more Demon Lord’s energy.
’Stop! Stop! Get away!!’ Vritra ordered in his mind hastily, but the Chimera seemed to be glued to the broken core, and no matter how much it tried to separate, it wasn’t able to.
But suddenly...
BOOOOOM!!!

It was one of the members of the Golden Moon.
After yawning, he fell back asleep, not really caring about what was going on outside; his sleep was way more important, after all.
As the sky started to turn dark, Vritra returned to the castle.
He went to his room and told the three women about a few of the events with the young prince.
The three of them were shocked and understood why the market seemed so empty.
"Can we really stay in this kingdom?
You have literally beaten the prince to such a bad state," Diana asked, wondering why trouble always revolved around Vritra.
"We will stay a bit longer.
I’m still waiting for that inheritance to open; sigh, I wonder when it will open," Vritra said.
He constantly checked that inheritance, but it had yet to open.
"Will the king arrest or attack us?" Fiona asked, while Vanessa’s words revolving in her mind, though she felt this wasn’t the time to show her womanly side to her man.
"He won’t, don’t worry about that.
Even if he does, it won’t be hard to kill him," Vritra said.
The labyrinth was going to break very soon.

So he needed to hurry with his robbery—he needed a lot of soul potions and weapons too.
They had already seen the inventories, and Vritra already had a plan to borrow everything.
"Why don’t we go and eat something?" Vritra asked after a while.
A lot had happened today, and a lot more was going to happen soon.
"Yeah, let’s go." Vanessa smiled.
She could only imagine that funny scene and regretted not watching the prince walking across the city.
The four made their way out of the room and met Sonia there, who was in a great mood.

chapters.title: Chapter 225: Setbacks
paragraphs: BOOOOOM!!!
’NOOOOO!!’ All of a sudden, the chimera’s body exploded. Vritra could only clench his fists as he stood there silently for a few seconds. They were so close to success.
He had planned to keep that soul wraith for a long time, and seeing it explode felt really bad. After a brief silence, Vritra sighed and ordered: ’Dark Knight, Hellmancer... Absorb it.’
Inside the labyrinth, Dark Knight and Hellmancer had already expected this outcome at the last minute.
Upon receiving Vritra’s order, Hellmancer chanted a spell with great difficulty, without pausing the absorption of the demon lord’s energy.
Then all the energy from the Chimera’s body was squeezed back into a tiny core that hovered beside the demon lord’s core, and the two continued to absorb more energy.
’Damnit, that was a good soul wraith and now I am in such a bad mood. Why can’t anything ever go according to plans?’ Vritra cursed internally.

"It’s alright hubby, we are bound to face a few setbacks on our journey. Look at me, I am nothing more than a weak soul now, so there is nothing wrong with losing. We are together, and together we can fight anything." Yasmine spoke, her sweet voice soothing.

’Hmm... Thanks. Though I was aware of the dangers of trying it, seeing the chimera die just made me feel frustrated. I am fine now.’ Vritra said, as he took control of his emotion, his mind becoming calm within moments.

"It is perfectly normal. Why don’t we continue with our plundering to get you in a better mood? We have already taken everything from here, now let’s move on to the next treasury." Yasmine spoke, trying to cheer him up.
His behaviour had great effects on her; she only wanted him to be happy at all times.
Taking a deep breath, Vritra glanced around and saw the whole thing had become empty without even a single potion left.
’Yeah let’s move. For now, rest and absorb all that soul energy and be careful...’ Vritra said softly.
"Mmm." Yasmine smiled and nodded.
[Fourth Dimension Activated.]
Vritra disappeared from the treasury. All the guards inside were still sleeping, while the ones outside had not noticed anything. They were just chatting about the incident with the youngest prince.

Both the king and queen were furious, but the king didn’t take any action against Vritra and even stopped the enraged queen from attacking him, even though the youngest prince had literally lost both his marbles.
After drinking several high-grade potions he had healed completely, but that injury couldn’t be healed so easily. It is near impossible to heal that in the Blue Kingdom.
But the youngest prince had locked himself inside his room because of the trauma and all the humiliation. He seemed to be completely broken and only continued to mutter words likekillanddeath.
Vritra paused for a minute to listen to their conversation before moving on to the next treasury. It was filled with gold, diamonds and all sorts of expensive things.
He landed on the floor and looked around at the large amount of money. The sight was really blinding.

’Since I will be moving to the next kingdom soon, I will be needing more money. Hmm, let’s take some from here.’ Vritra thought. He didn’t plan to take all since he didn’t want the entire kingdom to die because of hunger.
The lives of lots of people depend on this money, but taking half should be fine. The people should be fine eating one time less after all.
And so Vritra began to throw the diamonds and gold into his inventory. He controlled large dust trays that brought the money up to him, and he just needed to move them into the inventory.
He didn’t even need to completely deactivate the Fourth Dimension, and thankfully there were no guards inside this treasury.
After a few short minutes, Vritra was done with borrowing around half of the entire money.

’There, it should still be enough to run this kingdom. And I believe the crown prince has capable people working under him.’ Vritra thought as he decided to go into the final and biggest treasury where weapons, treasures, and much more lay.

He flew out of the 2nd treasury and heard the guards outside talk about the young prince. This time he didn’t wait to hear and directly entered the 3rd inventory, and this time it was even more spectacular.

"Oh, so many weapons! And there are even a couple of 2nd legion-ranked weapons, not bad. Adding all these to the axes should bring them close to the 3rd legion rank, though it might be difficult to make that big jump and enter that rank." Vritra mumbled as he counted the number of guards inside the room.

There were more than twenty guards scattered across the large space. They were silently observing the treasury. But their levels were a lot lower than Vritra’s, so it was quite easy to knock all of them out one by one.

In less than a minute, all of the guards were unconscious. The security here was even higher. The number of glyphs placed around the large hall made it quite difficult to move around, but Yasmine could easily see through all sorts of traps.
"Now, let’s start the merging of the weapons..." Vritra mumbled as he took out the axes and picked one weapon from the shelf, and the process of merging started.
One by one, he began to add all those weapons to his axes. He could have just taken them and merged later, but Vritra had all the time in the world, so he just decided to finish it.

Inside the king’s chamber, the lights were off and there was complete silence. Henry sat over his majestic chair, leaning backward as he stared at the ceiling, countless thoughts running through his mind.

He was just as enraged as his wife about what happened with his youngest son. Not only was he humiliated in front of all his people and even made to say those shameful things, in the end, he was injured to that extent.
The king just wanted to kill Vritra and his family with all his might, but the feeling of that deep-rooted fear made him consider it again.

Vritra was certainly not ordinary. No ordinary person could withstand so many strong people right after entering the legion rank. Even the king himself, who is very close to the 2nd legion rank, felt fear just by his gaze.
KNOCK KNOCK
"...Enter." Upon hearing the knocks, King Henry observed the person coming to meet him so late and sighed upon seeing that it was the crown prince.
He had also heard about the prince’s relation with Sonia. Henry was still not sure if she was a succubus or not, but the fact that she was related to Vritra made her very dangerous.
"Father, I need to talk to you about something." The crown prince said respectfully.
"Sit down..." the king said as he leaned forward and tiredly looked at his son’s face and continued, "Is it about that girl, Sonia?"
"...Yes. Do you plan to take her too?" Taking a nervous breath, the crown prince clenched his fists and decided to get to the point.
"STAY AWAY FROM HER. FROM NOW ON, YOU ARE NOT ALLOWED TO EVER MEET HER." Henry ordered in a higher tone.

chapters.title: Chapter 226: Luck Blast
paragraphs: "STAY AWAY FROM HER. FROM NOW ON, YOU ARE NOT ALLOWED TO EVER MEET HER," Henry ordered in a higher tone.

"But why, Father? I’m sure you already know I love her. Don’t tell me... you’ve taken a liking to her as well—" The crown prince raised his voice in front of his father for the first time. Henry was truly speechless for a few seconds.

"Whatever may be the case, it will be better for you if you stay away from her. Don’t go near her if you want to stay alive," Henry said while massaging his temples. Vritra was too dangerous, and getting involved with him might bring unknown dangers to his family.
Henry only wanted to protect them.
’I-Is Father threatening me? He will kill me for a woman?!’ Though the crown prince took those words the wrong way, he was shocked by Henry’s tone.

’I have always listened to him and did everything in my power to become the son he could be proud of. I even married that fat old woman because he told me to, and this is all I amount to in his eyes?’
The crown prince had a dead look in his eyes. He knew talking further was meaningless; his father was probably going to get Sonia soon.

"Sigh, go back to your room and rest a little. Or maybe meet your youngest brother—he hasn’t come out of his room even once. And just forget about that woman. That is the best for everyone," Henry said as he watched his son leave the chamber in silence.

’How did it all come to this? Why has it come to this? Right after Jin Woo came here, all of this has started. But why would he hate me?’ Henry believed that it was all related to Vritra, but he couldn’t understand the motive.
’I’m sure I haven’t made him my enemy or anything, but then why...?’ he was left wondering, as he sat in the darkness.
Vritra had emptied almost the entire weapons treasury after around thirty or so minutes. It was almost like he could sense the joy of his weapons as they devoured so many high-level weapons.
Looking at the lowest level weapons that weren’t even legion ranked, Vritra just stored them in his inventory; in case the axes got slightly wrecked, then he could use them to heal a bit.
Vritra looked around the room and saw that he had taken everything, but just to be extra careful, he used the third eye.
[Nether Eye Activated.]

Vritra started scanning the entire treasury. He scanned the potion and gold ones again and didn’t find anything out of the ordinary. The guards still hadn’t noticed anything. Then he scanned the weapons treasury, and he actually found something hidden in the wall.
"There is something hidden behind that wall!!" Vritra exclaimed, and Yasmine scanned it too and sensed the secret treasures the king had hidden.
"Yeah, I can sense that there are multiple items hidden in that secret space. Let’s take it!!" Yasmine said, already scanning it.
"Hmm... Henry has set up various layers of barriers and even used many glyphs to protect them. Looks like the real treasure is hiding there," she added.
"Can you break the security?" Vritra asked. If Yasmine couldn’t do it, then he would simply use brute force and take it all.
"Yes, I can. Give me a minute," Yasmine said and flew out in her small form, looking like a cute white snake.
She hadn’t completely absorbed all that soul energy just yet, but her strength seemed to have already grown quite a bit.
She observed the traps for a bit longer and then began to work on the glyphs first. Her knowledge of these items wasn’t too deep, but it was more than enough to deactivate these low-level ones.
Vritra couldn’t understand how she was doing it, but one by one Yasmine began to remove the glyph traps.
Finally, all the glyphs had been rendered useless, and she just needed to remove the barriers—which was an even easier thing to do.
After just a few seconds, she had removed all the barriers, and finally, a black safe appeared in front of them with physical locks.
"Heh, this was a piece of cake," Yasmine chuckled as she used her energy, and soon, with a click, the lock opened. The most secure safe of the king had been breached.
"Shall we take a look at this?" she asked excitedly, wondering what sort of treasure Henry would hide with so much effort.
"...No, wait a second," Vritra said before opening his status window.
{Sin Points: 13,570,290}
"Oh, nice!!" Vritra said before looking at the luck stat that was stuck at 60.

"Now, how much should I invest in luck? Should I go all out?" Vritra wondered and decided to push all the points into luck. He could easily earn more in the future anyway, and his luck had truly been a bit bad lately.
[1 LUCK POINT: 30,000]
Without wasting a moment, Vritra instantly purchased luck points with all the Sin Points, and in the end, this was all he was left with:
{Sin Points: 10,290}
But in return, he got a lot of luck points. Taking a deep breath to calm himself, Vritra looked at his status window again.
Stats:
Intelligence: 32,481 (+1,000)
Luck: 512
[Allocation Points: 0]

"Damn!!" Vritra exclaimed. He didn’t know how great this luck was compared to others, but it was definitely a huge leap. Vritra could already feel a lucky air rising around him, as if the air had suddenly become flowery.
"Oh, now that looks great. But I wonder if this much luck would be enough to keep the trouble away from us, hehe..." Yasmine laughed, feeling even more excited now.
"Hoo, let’s see what is hidden inside now," Vritra smiled and finally decided to check the locker. It would show how great his luck had become.
Krrrrr...
With a low sound, the door of the lock opened, and several things instantly came into view.
Vritra began to inspect them one by one. First, he pulled out a small pouch that seemed to be full of some sort of stones.
"..." After pulling it out, he opened it and saw around a dozen familiar stones.
Empty Stones.
It was the 1st Legion Rank Empty Stone. It was the same thing for which Vritra had participated in that competition, and there were so many of them here.

"The king must have gathered them here for his kids, maybe... Anyway, I was wondering where to get Legion Stones for Mom, Diana, and Fiona—and now the problem is completely solved." Vritra’s smile widened as he stuffed the pouch into his inventory, already happy with the use of those Sin Points on his luck.
Then he picked another pouch, which seemed much lighter and smaller than the previous one.
Bringing it closer, Vritra opened it and glanced inside. This time it was Yasmine who spoke in an excited tone:
"2nd Legion Rank Empty Stone!! Haha! Your luck has truly started to shine now."
It was probably the stone that the king was saving for himself—but now, he was never going to use it.
Then Vritra saw a strange grey glyph.

’I have always listened to him and did everything in my power to become the son he could be proud of.
I even married that fat old woman because he told me to, and this is all I amount to in his eyes?’
The crown prince had a dead look in his eyes.
He knew talking further was meaningless; his father was probably going to get Sonia soon.
"Sigh, go back to your room and rest a little.
Or maybe meet your youngest brother—he hasn’t come out of his room even once.
And just forget about that woman.
That is the best for everyone," Henry said as he watched his son leave the chamber in silence.
’How did it all come to this?
Why has it come to this?
Right after Jin Woo came here, all of this has started.
But why would he hate me?’ Henry believed that it was all related to Vritra, but he couldn’t understand the motive.
’I’m sure I haven’t made him my enemy or anything, but then why...?’ he was left wondering, as he sat in the darkness.
Vritra had emptied almost the entire weapons treasury after around thirty or so minutes.
It was almost like he could sense the joy of his weapons as they devoured so many high-level weapons.
Looking at the lowest level weapons that weren’t even legion ranked, Vritra just stored them in his inventory; in case the axes got slightly wrecked, then he could use them to heal a bit.
Vritra looked around the room and saw that he had taken everything, but just to be extra careful, he used the third eye.
[Nether Eye Activated.]
Vritra started scanning the entire treasury.
He scanned the potion and gold ones again and didn’t find anything out of the ordinary.
The guards still hadn’t noticed anything.
Then he scanned the weapons treasury, and he actually found something hidden in the wall.
"There is something hidden behind that wall!!" Vritra exclaimed, and Yasmine scanned it too and sensed the secret treasures the king had hidden.
"Yeah, I can sense that there are multiple items hidden in that secret space.
Let’s take it!!" Yasmine said, already scanning it.
"Hmm...
Henry has set up various layers of barriers and even used many glyphs to protect them.
Looks like the real treasure is hiding there," she added.
"Can you break the security?" Vritra asked.
If Yasmine couldn’t do it, then he would simply use brute force and take it all.
"Yes, I can.
Give me a minute," Yasmine said and flew out in her small form, looking like a cute white snake.
She hadn’t completely absorbed all that soul energy just yet, but her strength seemed to have already grown quite a bit.
She observed the traps for a bit longer and then began to work on the glyphs first.
Her knowledge of these items wasn’t too deep, but it was more than enough to deactivate these low-level ones.
Vritra couldn’t understand how she was doing it, but one by one Yasmine began to remove the glyph traps.
Finally, all the glyphs had been rendered useless, and she just needed to remove the barriers—which was an even easier thing to do.
After just a few seconds, she had removed all the barriers, and finally, a black safe appeared in front of them with physical locks.
"Heh, this was a piece of cake," Yasmine chuckled as she used her energy, and soon, with a click, the lock opened.
The most secure safe of the king had been breached.
"Shall we take a look at this?" she asked excitedly, wondering what sort of treasure Henry would hide with so much effort.
"...No, wait a second," Vritra said before opening his status window.
{Sin Points: 13,570,290}
"Oh, nice!!" Vritra said before looking at the luck stat that was stuck at 60.
"Now, how much should I invest in luck?
Should I go all out?" Vritra wondered and decided to push all the points into luck.
He could easily earn more in the future anyway, and his luck had truly been a bit bad lately.
[1 LUCK POINT: 30,000]
Without wasting a moment, Vritra instantly purchased luck points with all the Sin Points, and in the end, this was all he was left with:
{Sin Points: 10,290}
But in return, he got a lot of luck points.
Taking a deep breath to calm himself, Vritra looked at his status window again.
Stats:
Intelligence: 32,481 (+1,000)
Luck: 512
[Allocation Points: 0]
"Damn!!" Vritra exclaimed.
He didn’t know how great this luck was compared to others, but it was definitely a huge leap.
Vritra could already feel a lucky air rising around him, as if the air had suddenly become flowery.
"Oh, now that looks great.
But I wonder if this much luck would be enough to keep the trouble away from us, hehe..." Yasmine laughed, feeling even more excited now.
"Hoo, let’s see what is hidden inside now," Vritra smiled and finally decided to check the locker.
It would show how great his luck had become.
Krrrrr...
With a low sound, the door of the lock opened, and several things instantly came into view.
Vritra began to inspect them one by one.
First, he pulled out a small pouch that seemed to be full of some sort of stones.
"..." After pulling it out, he opened it and saw around a dozen familiar stones.
Empty Stones.
It was the 1st Legion Rank Empty Stone.
It was the same thing for which Vritra had participated in that competition, and there were so many of them here.
"The king must have gathered them here for his kids, maybe...

Anyway, I was wondering where to get Legion Stones for Mom, Diana, and Fiona—and now the problem is completely solved." Vritra’s smile widened as he stuffed the pouch into his inventory, already happy with the use of those Sin Points on his luck.
Then he picked another pouch, which seemed much lighter and smaller than the previous one.
Bringing it closer, Vritra opened it and glanced inside.
This time it was Yasmine who spoke in an excited tone:
"2nd Legion Rank Empty Stone!!
Haha!
Your luck has truly started to shine now."
It was probably the stone that the king was saving for himself—but now, he was never going to use it.
Then Vritra saw a strange grey glyph.

chapters.title: Chapter 227: Negative Effect
paragraphs: "Now now, what do we have here?" Vritra picked up the grey cube and inspected it, then he used the appraisal skill on it.
[Negate Glyph]
[Description]: It allows you to negate the negative effect of any skill once a month.
The description was small and easy to understand, and it seemed Vritra’s higher luck was still shining just as brightly.
"Oh, so it could negate the negative effects like the ones in Shift?" Vritra held the glyph and mumbled, the negative effect being his strength weakening when 100% stats were shifted.

Though this negative effect was too problematic, at least for now. In case of emergency, this glyph would be a great help, or maybe in the future he might gain a new skill with a worse negative effect, so this glyph would be even more useful at that time.

"A negate-type glyph... how strange. It is quite rare and shouldn’t exist in such a place. I guess the king made some sort of deal with the Grieves and received this treasure. First the Bone Blood Cult and now the king of the Blue Kingdom, just what are the Grieves planning?" Yasmine wondered.
Vritra put away the glyph for now and found it all quite suspicious as well. The Grieves seemed to be doing too much while staying in the background. After a moment, he asked:
"Wifey, what do you think is the main goal of the Grieves? World domination? Getting possession of every living person?"
"... I am not sure completely. I had only heard, so it could only be considered a rumor, but the Grieves’ biggest goal is to kill Rodrick Mech." Yasmine replied vaguely.

"Wait, the one who created the Glyphs? The once-in-a-lifetime genius— is he still alive? But from what I heard, the Grieves took possession of his body and that’s how they became proficient at the creation of Glyphs." Vritra asked, feeling even more confused.

"Well, there are all sorts of stories going around and no one knows which among them might be true, if there is any. As for whether he is alive or not is still a mystery, though the Grieves believe he is.
Also, the Bone Blood Cult, Nine Cults, and many other organizations are a lot more evil compared to them.

The bad things done by the Grieves are few. But they have such a negative and fearful image, even worse than any evil organization, because of the Golden Moon, who is their arch enemy." Yasmine explained.
"Haa, I just want to stay away from all this drama. I wish my luck can now keep the trouble away for some time." Vritra thought and got ready to leave.
He disappeared completely and flew out of the treasury. The guards outside were still calmly protecting the empty halls.
The crown prince was in a terrible mood after his meeting with the king. All sorts of thoughts were coming to his mind, but he was trying his best to push away the dangerous ones.
Just then, a beautiful girl jumped in front of him with a worried look, asking:
"P- Prince, how did it go? The king won’t make me his plaything, right? I trust you with my life, I am sure you aren’t evil like your father."
"..." The crown prince bit his lip as he stared at Sonia in frustration. He didn’t know how to tell her about his father’s decision. After a long pause, he touched her head and spoke:
"Yeah, don’t worry. I will take care of it all. It’s getting late, so go back to your room and sleep."
"Thank you, prince. I love you, you are the best." Sonia said excitedly as she smiled before turning around and walking back towards her room in a great mood.
"Sigh, I will protect her at any cost..." the crown prince mumbled to himself as he watched his dream woman walking away.
Since she believed so much in him, how could he let her suffer? He needed to choose between that beautiful, sweet, and trusting girl, and the hateful, lustful father, who had abandoned him.
’Is that the only way?’ The crown prince could only imagine one method, but it was hard for him to do that. His father might be heartless, but he wasn’t like that.
But he wondered if Vritra wouldn’t be able to help his own sister. Earlier in the day, he had made the king freeze with just his gaze.

’Is he really that powerful, or did father let him be for some other reason? Was it because he is the competition winner, or did he hold any of father’s secrets?’ the prince wondered while walking towards his own room.
"..." Floating above the prince, Vritra observed the entire exchange and knew they were getting close. Just a little push, and the crown prince would finally become the new king.

’Because of the incident at the Paradise Hotel, the plans had become a little messy. Getting him to kill the king now had become a bit more difficult. I wonder how we can give him that final push.’ Vritra thought, but for now, he needed to take care of something else.
He flew away towards the room of the youngest prince, ready to play the final prank on the broken prince.
"Hehe I wonder how this is going to play out." Yasmine chuckled. They could just kill the prince directly but doing it in such a manner is more fun and safe.

Henry Jr the 14th lay on his bed with a dead look on his face. In just a single day he felt as if he had lost everything— his reputation, his family jewels, and much more. He had become a complete laughing stock across the entire kingdom.
And now he wouldn’t even be able to ever become a father. Even his life as a prince was in jeopardy now.

The youngest prince was afraid that his father would just throw him into one of the corners of the kingdom to remove the disgrace he caused. All the hate was delivered towards Vritra... and that Baldy bastard.
He couldn’t sleep, nor did he want to stay awake. Not a single day in his entire life had been so depressing. The prince even felt maybe dying directly would have been better.

Just while he was drowning in his thoughts of rage and regret, the window of his room opened suddenly with a loud bang. The young prince was startled as he sat up and almost peed his pants. The traumatizing scene from earlier replayed in his mind.

He was afraid that Vritra might have really come there to kill him. Fresh air hit his face but there was no one around. He jumped behind the bed and looked around carefully, but there was no attacker in sight.

After a few minutes, he noticed that something was lying on his bed. He carefully looked at it and found a glyph and a letter. Calming himself, he first closed the window and then cautiously picked up the two objects.
The young prince instantly recognized the makeup glyph. After all, he had used these things many times in the past to play pranks on people. Then he opened the letter and read it.
-Do you wish to kill Jin Woo?-
"..." The youngest prince’s brows shot up in surprise

chapters.title: Chapter 228: Murderer of Thousands!!
paragraphs: "If you wish to kill Jin Woo, then use the makeup glyph and arrive at the given venue. A fellow enemy of that demon. By- X."
And under this line, an address and time were given. The place wasn’t really too far from the castle. The young prince instantly became excited.

The young prince didn’t know who the letter was from or if it was some sort of joke, but after reading that one single line, a surge of excitement and the feeling of revenge surged in his heart. He would even make a deal with the devil if he could kill that hateful bastard.
’But what is the need for changing my appearance?’ the young prince wondered since nothing about it was mentioned in the letter.
Soon, he came to the conclusion that the X person was probably going to make him meet some dangerous assassins, so revealing one’s identity might be dangerous.

’I guess he has connections but lacks the money to finish the task. I will pay, no matter how much money is needed to kill that bastard.’ The youngest prince thought with determination as he got off the bed.
This was exactly what Vritra aimed to do, and it was why he hadn’t explained anything in that letter. When a person finds reason behind something himself, he most probably won’t suspect things.
But if Vritra had written the same thing, the prince would have been suspicious and doubtful of the motives.
The prince held the makeup glyph in his hand and activated it. In the next instant, his clothes and appearance changed completely. Even his height and weight seemed different.

Walking in front of a mirror, the prince was surprised by his current appearance. He looked too handsome with such a perfect body. And that face felt a bit familiar, though he couldn’t remember where exactly he had seen it.
’Isn’t this even more eye-catching?’ the prince wondered. Then he took a black cloth and wrapped it around himself, read the address once again, and walked out of his room.
At the gate, he showed his emblem to the guards without showing his face and passed through.
"Sigh, I feel just a little pity for the youngest prince, just a little bit. He can’t even show his face anywhere.
Pfftt... that sight of him walking like a dog was truly magnificent..." one of the guards at the entrance laughed as he watched the prince walk away.
"I wonder where he is going this late at night. Do you think we should inform the king about it?" another guard asked.
"...Yeah, that would be for the better. Otherwise, if something goes wrong outside, we might be the ones to receive punishment for that rascal prince," said the first guard.
And so, one of the guards went to inform the king about the first prince’s departure.

Walking through the dark streets, the young prince’s anger was slowly getting replaced by fear. He hadn’t even brought any guards with him, and now he was wondering if this was the right choice or not.
But because of his hatred, he continued to walk. After entering a rather shady area, he walked to the end and halted in front of the biggest house, as instructed in the letter.
’How long do I have to wait here now?’ the young prince wondered while looking left and right.
Right behind him on the large wall, a few lines were written in blood in clear big letters, but because of the darkness, the prince didn’t notice anything.
Soon, however, he smelled the scent of blood. With a frown, the prince looked around in confusion and finally his gaze landed on the wall behind him. With narrowed eyes, he began to read the lines.
"Today, the emerging demon lord Vritra, the killer of your family members, will be here at night. He has greatly weakened. If you wish to avenge your loved ones, then kill him however you want."
The prince wondered who could have written it. It didn’t seem like some kid’s game, but he shrugged his shoulders and continued to wait.
’Demon lord Vritra, Vritra...’ the young prince repeated the name in his mind a few times, and suddenly something clicked in his mind.
"Right, my current appearance looks exactly like the demon lord Vritra. Wait—don’t tell me!!" the prince felt a shiver run through his body as he realized this was all a trap.
’F- Fuck, I have to get out of here.’ He exclaimed inwardly and was about to remove the makeup glyph, but right at that moment...
BANG!!
A heavy object fell from the top of the building and hit him right on the head. As blood spewed out and the prince’s sight darkened, he fell to the ground.
His mind became foggy, and once again, he regretted just the thought of going against that devil. This was definitely his plan.
’S- Save me... someone, I am not Vritra...’ the prince could only try to speak, but he was barely hanging onto his consciousness.
Soon, the doors of all the houses opened and lots of angry people walked out. Many were crying and many were shouting and cursing, for they had finally found the murderer of their family members.
Vritra had done his research about this rumor, the one which said he had killed thousands of innocent people.
Well, that was complete bullshit. But some of the people from the Nine Pacts and Bone Blood Cult lived dual lives.

Those scums used their ordinary identity to do various sorts of tasks openly in society. This gave them freedom, and they didn’t really care about these families. But for all these people, they had lost innocent loved ones, so their anger against Vritra was unprecedented.
But in reality, it was better that those scums died otherwise all these people would have just become living stocks for them.
"H- He really came here!! How come he is so weak? I heard he could even kill 2nd legion rank warriors. L- Let’s check his appearance first," someone exclaimed.
Several men carrying weapons came forward and pulled away the black cloth, and it really was Vritra who appeared in front of them, his face half covered in blood.

"It is really him. Maybe he got injured in some fight. I heard the Golden Moon is chasing him after all. Whatever might be the case, we finally have the bastard who took away my brother from me. Let’s kill him before the Golden Moon or the guards arrive and arrest him."

"Sob... Why did you kill my husband? He wasn’t even a warrior... why did you kill him? He was innocent and only went there to earn more for our children. You beast, how could you... sob..." a woman cried, shouting at the dazed prince.

’W- What’s going on? I am innocent, I am the prince. I am not Vritra!! Somebody help me, I am being framed.’ The prince screamed in his mind, as he felt several men dragging him towards an altar. They tied his hands and feet to the wooden bamboos placed there in advance.
"Now, everyone!! This is the criminal who destroyed our families. We can’t just give him to others for justice. We have to serve justice by our own hands.

I am not Vritra!!
Somebody help me, I am being framed.’ The prince screamed in his mind, as he felt several men dragging him towards an altar.
They tied his hands and feet to the wooden bamboos placed there in advance.
"Now, everyone!!
This is the criminal who destroyed our families.
We can’t just give him to others for justice.
We have to serve justice by our own hands.

chapters.title: Chapter 229: Calm before Storm
paragraphs: "We have to kill him, making him feel as much terror and pain as our families felt. Only then could our loved ones’ souls be able to rest in peace." One of the men shouted as he threw kerosene oil on the prince.
Hundreds of people looked at the prince with bloodshot eyes, holding all sorts of weapons, ready to give him a death worthy of his crimes.
Right after hearing about the youngest prince’s departure, the king left the castle.
He was shaken and had a really bad feeling about this. He regretted not just tying him down and keeping the youngest prince close, but why would he leave the castle with no guards whatsoever?

The prince was still wearing his rings, and Henry could vaguely sense his presence through one of those rings. With all his might he flew towards his son, each passing second making him feel as if the youngest prince was going farther away from him.
He came close to the dark alley and was shocked to see the large group of people gathered there, and then he heard the screaming sound.
Although it sounded completely different from his son, for some reason Henry felt his heart stop for a moment.
Gritting his teeth, he flew towards the altar at full speed and landed with a resounding explosion, throwing off the people that were busy torturing the young prince.
"F- Fath..." The person tied to the bamboo, who had countless injuries all over his body and was barely alive, called out before falling unconscious.

All the people that had been busy throwing all sorts of things at the prince and cutting his body suddenly froze. They wondered if the king wanted to take away the demon lord Vritra, but they couldn’t speak in front of him.
"..." Without saying anything, Henry approached his son, feeling the weight of each step. With trembling hands, he touched his shoulder and examined him.
Then he removed the makeup glyph as the prince reverted back to his original appearance. Everyone watching this was shocked, and they felt terror.
And it finally clicked— all this time they had been torturing none other than the youngest prince.
"Noooooo, open your eyes, son!!" Henry called out in desperation as he pulled him off the bamboo and began to feed him the highest-grade healing potions in his possession.

His injuries were too severe, and he was so close to death. The king was filled with endless rage. He glared at the people who had done all that, and with a wave of his hand, all of them were thrown backwards.
He really wanted to slaughter them all, but he already knew it was someone’s ploy, and these were the people of his own kingdom. So in the end, he took the youngest prince and flew away.
The people there were left in disheveled states, but they still couldn’t believe that all of them had just committed such a crime.
They looked at one another and shivered; the king just now had every right to kill them all.

’So he survived, I guess it is what it is.’ Vritra watched everything happen through the Nether Eye. One thing was for sure—even if the prince survived this, he would be traumatized for the rest of his life and could never be like before.

After all the tasks for the night were done, Vritra returned to his room. He changed into comfortable clothes and climbed onto the bed where Vanessa lay awake. Getting into the covers, he hugged his mother and the two chatted for a while.
"Haven’t that inheritance of yours opened yet?" Vanessa asked, feeling his lips against her soft breasts.
"No, but it shouldn’t be long before it opens." He replied, hugging her soft body tightly.
"Where will we be going next? The White Kingdom? I heard that it is several times bigger than even the Blue Kingdom and a whole lot richer.
Even the power levels of people there are much higher." She spoke, rubbing her fingers through his hair.

"Yeah, White Kingdom is the only place through which we can leave this continent. We will leave this place right after I get the mythic halo. Oh right, I have something for you." Vritra said as he pulled his face back a bit and took out the empty stone.
"Oh, I saw it before. Is this the stone you received after winning that competition? The one we need to reach the Legion rank?" She asked, looking at the small gem-like stone.
"Yes, keep it with yourself for now. You will be needing it very soon." Vritra passed the stone to her and decided to give one to Fiona and Diana later.
"The youngest prince almost died. Is it really okay for us to stay here? The king must be enraged, and I am sure he knows you are the one to do it.
Why don’t we wait for that inheritance somewhere else?" Vanessa questioned as Vritra once again buried his face into her fragrant bosom.

"Hmm. Alright, let’s leave tomorrow then." Vritra said. It was better to not take any risks after all. He could survive in most situations, but he didn’t want to put any of the three women in danger. Then he added:
"But for now you should just focus on your training. Leveling up isn’t an issue for you with me here, but with a high level you also need the ability to properly use all that power.
Anyway, you will be reaching the Legion rank very soon, probably in a couple of days, so congrats in advance, mom." Vritra said.
After ten or so minutes the two fell asleep, completely unaware of the danger approaching.
The next day was rather calm. Vritra was ready for any sort of sudden attack, but the king still didn’t make any move. At least he was more tactful and patient than Vritra had expected.
After getting ready, Vanessa and Vritra walked out of their room and headed straight towards the dining table, where Fiona and Diana were already waiting for them.
"So much happened last night, did you hear?" One of the maids serving the food talked with the other maid.

"Yes, all the potions and weapons were stolen and a lot of gold was gone, yet not a single guard has any idea who could have done this." The second maid replied as they stood to the side after bringing the dishes.
"Not only that, I heard the youngest prince almost died when he went out in the middle of the night. He is still getting treatment in his room right now." The first maid added.
The four, who had started eating their breakfast, heard the conversation. Diana looked at Vritra and asked hesitantly: "Is that all done by you?"
"Yes." Vritra replied simply. After a moment he paused and took out two empty stones from his inventory, giving one to Diana and the other to Fiona.

"Use this once you are ready to become Legion ranked. By the way, do the two of you have any field?" Vritra asked. All three women were leveling up too fast, so they probably didn’t have any time to work on it—just like him.
"Yes, my holy energy." Diana.
"Yes, my phoenix flames." Fiona.
"Yes, my charms." Vanessa.
Vritra: "..."

chapters.title: Chapter 230: Fellow Demons
paragraphs: After the breakfast, Vritra decided to go out hunting. He was quite close to reaching the next level, and there wasn’t much to do in the castle anyway — the atmosphere there was quite eerie.
He told the crown prince about it, who arranged the carriage. Sonia planned to go out to the market today, so the prince decided to accompany her.

Soon, Vritra and the three women were seated inside the carriage. Because the chimera had exploded, the Dark Knight and Hellmancer needed even more time to finish their absorption since they had to absorb much more energy now.
It wasn’t long before they arrived in the ’Small’ forest. The carriage driver parked it there and went ahead to rest in one of the nearby hotels, while Vritra and the others entered the forest.
"Are we gonna follow the same routine as before?" Fiona asked.
"Yeah, just be careful while fighting. I will be close by and I’ll watch if the Grieves or anyone else is present around here." Vritra said as they walked a bit deeper into the forest.

Soon the two groups split. Vanessa, Fiona, Diana, Ghost, and Ghoul were hunting in one area of the forest, while Vritra went even deeper. Since he had already obtained the 2nd Legion rank stone, he was trying to find some way of gaining a lot of experience points.

"You know, when I was younger, I used to go hunting with my father, and he was so protective that once a demon hit me and I only got a scratch on my body, yet he burned down the entire nest of demons in rage." Yasmine spoke, remembering a time that had been lost forever.

"Yeah, I saw him in your memories, and he was indeed very powerful. But there is one thing that’s bugging me. Though I didn’t want to talk about it before since it might make you remember those memories." Vritra said while flying across the forest at a normal pace.

"It is fine, tell me. Between us, you don’t ever need to hesitate about speaking anything. I want to be the first person you share any of your secrets with." Yasmine replied, her voice sweet as honey, making Vritra smile.
"Sigh... how far is the Dragon Kingdom from here? I just wish I could go there right away." Vritra said, his teasing wife could be so sweet sometimes.
"It isn’t too far. After leaving the White Kingdom, we can easily reach the Dragon Kingdom through the teleportation portals, but the journey there will be very dangerous, so take your time.

I love our time together like this as well. But after I get my body back, we won’t always be together like this... sigh." Yasmine said. Because of him, she had started to enjoy her time even in her current state.

"Anyway, as I was saying before, the incidents of your father’s death, your mother’s disappearance — they were all too strange. And then even that attack on you. It feels like something big is going on among the dragons. And the demons started targeting the dragons after that ceremony, right?" Vritra asked.
"Yes." Yasmine nodded. Of course, she had thought of all this too, but everything was still a mystery to her.
When dragons’ children reach the age of adulthood, the entire kingdom orchestrates a big event in which all the dragon children awaken their field and can finally reach the 1st Legion rank.
"You were awakened with the fire attribute, right?" Vritra asked.

"Yeah, that’s what appeared at the time of awakening. Do you think all the chaos the demons caused was somehow related to my awakening?" Yasmine questioned. It really did seem the demons had started to target the dragon race, especially after the awakening ritual.
"Maybe. I just want to say, we can’t trust any of the dragons, even if they were close to you like family before." Vritra replied, releasing a long sigh.

"... Yeah, I understand. I had my doubts too. I trust you, and that’s enough. I don’t need that kingdom or those people. I have done my best as their queen for all those years, and now I just wish to live my life however I want." She said in a firm tone.
"And we will do just that. After you get your body back we will—" Vritra was speaking but suddenly he paused as he heard someone speaking in the distance.

"Man, hunting humans these days has become so difficult. It’s been a month since I last tasted a human. They are growing strong too fast and have all sorts of hidden weapons — those cheating bastards." The first person spoke in a rough tone.

"Haa, just don’t mention human meat to me. You’re making me hungry. Have you heard of that viral news? The Human Empress has been chasing one of the demon lords. I think something important was stolen by that demon lord." The second person said.
Vritra observed the two from a distance and was a little surprised to find that they were demons.
’Huh, they are speaking the same language as me— oh wait, I can understand any language.’ Vritra thought. Both of the demons were at the middle stages of 1st Legion rank.
Before killing the two, he decided to get a bit more information out of them.
"Oh, and where is the damned Human Empress right now?" a third voice sounded from beside the two demons.

"The last I heard, she was in the other continent. But the chase is still going on, so the demon lord and the Human Empress are seen at several places, even inside this continent." The first demon answered casually.

"Hmm, but I don’t understand one thing. Why is the number of demons around here so low? Shouldn’t we demons be wreaking havoc everywhere? But I haven’t seen any incidents happening in a long while." The third voice asked again.
While observing the surroundings, the second demon answered: "Of course, all of us have been too quiet for a long time now.
Don’t tell me you forgot about Plan White? We need all of our power to take down the White Kingdom, so we are just laying low for now to make a great comeback."
"Ah, right, of course I remember that. But my memory has been too bad lately. Sigh, I even forgot the location back to our base. Can you tell me?" the third voice sounded.

"What? How can you even forget that? You should eat more human brains. Haa, such a good thing, and they are really good for your brain. Anyway, come back with us, we will—" While answering the question, the first demon finally felt that something was amiss.

Weren’t there just the two of them? Then where had the third voice been coming from? The two looked at one another with terrified expressions before looking to their left — where Vritra was calmly standing.
{Sin Points Gained: Baffled +2}
{Sin Points Gained: Confused +2}
"A HUMAN?!!" the two demons exclaimed in shock as they jumped back and stared at Vritra in bewilderment. They hadn’t sensed him at all just now.
"Hello there, don’t mind me and continue with your discussion, fellow demons." Vritra said, a big smile spreading across his face.
The two demons stared at him for a little longer and they did sense a sort of demonic presence around his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 231: Pleading
paragraphs: "W- Who are you?" The first demon asked, ready to attack him at any moment.
"So about what you were saying, where is your base?" Vritra asked, looking nonchalant.
"Let’s kill him." The second demon said aggressively, pouncing forward as his fist turned dark.
Vritra clicked his tongue. He pointed his hand towards the two demons as a flood of dust swallowed the two instantly.
The two of them screamed in pain, they couldn’t move and were shocked by the difference in power.
This person was a whole lot stronger than they had expected. In Legion rank, each level could make a big difference, while Vritra’s level was much higher than theirs.
The two stood absolutely no chance.
Within moments their bodies were twisted and torn. Before killing them, Vritra asked: "So, are you going to tell me the location of your base?"
"Ughhh... cough... N- No, we will never... ahhhhhh!"
"Aghhhhh... Y- You, who are y- you? Ughhh... Y- You won’t get... cough... anything out of u- us... aaaaaah!"
The two demons didn’t answer, so Vritra decided to just end their lives.
In the next moment, the dust twisted their bodies, and all signs of vitality soon disappeared.
[Nether Eye Activated.]
Then he destroyed their souls and consciousness, completely killing the two.
"Bobby, devour them," he said, and read the messages that appeared in front of him.
[You have killed level 1,488 Blue Demon.]
[You have killed level 1,490 Blue Demon.]
[+Exp]
[You have levelled up!!]
[All stats increase by 10.]
[You have obtained 10 allocation points.]
"Sigh, if Yennefer met me again, she will surely kill me." Vritra mumbled and sighed. He could only hope the two of them did not meet just yet.

"So the demons are planning to take down the White Kingdom. That kingdom alone represents this entire continent, so if they succeed then the whole continent will be under their control," Yasmine said.
"Well, whatever. We should leave this continent before that." Vritra mumbled as Bobby devoured the two’s souls. Its level had also increased after devouring many souls.

Then he continued with his hunting while also keeping an eye on Vanessa, Fiona, and Diana. The three were getting really better at fighting. Just as those two demons had said, since they were busy preparing for the war, the number of strong demons was relatively low even in the Small Forest.

"Hoo, let’s take a rest now, oof my arms are hurting so much." Fiona spoke as she put away the spear-like staff into the storage glyph and then sat down on a chair after killing a demon above level 600.

"Haa... Yeah, fighting is so tiring. The support... haa... haa... role suits me the best. I can’t fight in the front row like today... huff." Diana said, her bosom heaving up and down in exhaustion as beads of sweat rolled down her milky skin.

"The stamina of you two is too low. How are you going to survive in the future like that? My honey could continue fighting for hours and wouldn’t even break a sweat. You need to work harder." Vanessa said with a naughty touch in her tone.

"Doesn’t it feel a bit too hot suddenly? It has been happening too much recently. Yesterday when we went to the market and the day before yesterday in this forest, the surroundings felt so hot suddenly." Diana said as she took out the paper fan.
"Yeah, it is strange. Fiona, don’t you feel hot?" Vanessa asked, looking at the redhead that was in much better condition than the goddess.

"Hmm, maybe because of my bloodline, but this heat isn’t affecting me at all. But Diana, are you really a goddess? How come you are so weak? Are the requirements for becoming a goddess so low?" Fiona asked, looking at the goddess curiously.
"Hmph, I am not useless. My speciality isn’t fighting. And I was chosen by the god, so of course I am qualified to be a goddess." Diana said, pouting.
With the faint sound of wind, Vritra appeared beside them. When the two women looked to the side, he was sitting beside them on one of the chairs.
"Yeah, I really wonder what the requirements for selecting a goddess are that they selected you." He said with a smile, making the goddess pout again.
"Did you find any strong demons?" Vanessa asked, gently wiping away a drop of blood from his cheek.
"Yeah, I did find a few, and even got a little information out of them." Vritra answered before explaining the information he got from them.

They soon started eating, while talking about their future plans and the sudden changes that they had sensed. After lunch, Vritra decided to hunt for a little longer while Diana and the others continued with their training.

Ghost and Ghoul brought many barely alive demons for the three women, and just like that, another day of training passed. By the time the sun had started to set, they left the forest and arrived at the carriage where the coachman was waiting for them.
Then they made their way back into the castle. After getting out of the carriage, the four of them were a little surprised to see Henry waiting there for them with a solemn look on his face.
"Jin Woo, can I talk to you for a minute?" the king asked, his voice seemed to hide many emotions.
"Hmm, okay. You go back to your rooms first." Vritra nodded and said to the three women.

"Be careful." Vanessa, Diana, and Fiona all said before they walked away, wondering if the king was finally planning to exact his revenge. They were a little worried about him but knew that Ghoul, Ghost, and Vritra himself were much stronger than the king.
"So where do you want to talk?" Vritra said. He too wondered if he would have to kill the king with his own hand.
"Let’s go to my chamber, it isn’t too far." After speaking, he began walking while Vritra followed behind him.
The two walked in silence and all the guards bowed in front of the king as they passed by. Within minutes, they arrived in front of the majestic chamber of the king.

It was brightly lit, but there wasn’t even a single guard around it. The king opened the door and then walked inside. Vritra followed Henry inside and closed the door behind him. Then they stood facing one another with a couple of meters gap between them.
The atmosphere was tense. The king was emotionlessly staring at Vritra, his fists clenched as if he was going to do something big.
Meanwhile, Vritra was ready to receive any sort of attack. He was sure that with the use of Switch he could easily kill the king.
The silence continued for a minute before Vritra finally decided to speak.
"So what do you want to talk about?"
"..." The king still didn’t say anything.
THUD!!

But suddenly he moved. His body seemed to fall forward, and then with a loud thud, the king fell to his knees. He pressed his palms against the floor and hit his head hard enough to form cracks in the floor.
{Sin Point Gained: Pleaded +1}
"I don’t know how I have offended you in the past, but please... please forgive me, I beg of you. It is all my fault, so please... sob..."

chapters.title: Chapter 232: Prank
paragraphs: "It is all my fault, so please... sob I will never try to retaliate against you for anything that you have already done, p- please I will be a good person and won’t even marry any more women... sob"
Henry struck his head against the floor several times while Vritra just stood there staring at him with a surprised expression.
{Sin Point Gained: Pleaded +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Pleaded +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Pleaded +1}
This was certainly not what he was expecting. He was ready to even kill the king in here as silently as possible but now he wondered how he should proceed with the current development.

"Haha, quite the way to send off the guests. I have never seen anyone beg so miserably to make their guest leave. Is this what they call overstaying one’s welcome?" Yasmine chuckled, she was just as surprised as him.

This was the king of an entire kingdom, everyone in the kingdom feared and respected him. His ego and self-respect could not be questioned. Yet here he was kneeling in front of Vritra, begging miserably.

Henry wasn’t the type who would just kneel in front of anyone who was stronger. Even in front of those men from the Golden Moon he was respectful but was not an ass-licker, this is exactly why they were even more surprised.
Vritra: "..."
"Whether i- it was my son’s fault or mine, I am begging you, I will do whatever you ask so please spare us." Right after speaking, Henry took out a sword all of a sudden.
’Hah, so he is finally going to show his true colors, what a great actor—’ Vritra finally felt more comfortable seeing the king act in the way he had expected.
Vritra was actually relieved that it was all an act, but in the next second Henry cut off his own right arm from a little above the elbow and spoke through gritted teeth:
"I- I will ughh pay for my haa haa crimes myself, cough y- you can cut off all my l- limbs b- but please ahhh—"
"Sigh, stop it." Vritra said while massaging his temples. He glanced at the system window and there were only messages about pleading, not deceiving.
So this really wasn’t an act. The king had made the most suitable choice for himself, his family, and the kingdom. He certainly wasn’t a stupid or greedy king like Aldric.
"H- Have you haa haa forgiven me...? Should I c- cut ughh my other arm too?" Henry asked, his face covered in sweat, barely stopping himself from screaming.
"..." Vritra stared at the king for a minute before sighing and nodding.

"Yeah, I forgive you, but if I find you try anything—even trying to spy on me or my family—I will obliterate your entire bloodline. And all your Henry-named kids will be killed right in front of you." Vritra threatened, a deadly aura spreading in the chamber.
"Y- Yes, I understand haa. I would never ever try anything..." Henry said with his head lowered. He sat in the position for a long time as blood continued to flow out of the serious wound.
"You are still too soft. Well, here it is fine since the king is weak and his offence isn’t too big, but in the future never go easy on any opponent." Yasmine spoke, she understood Vritra perfectly.
Even though that experience in the labyrinth had changed him a lot, a small part of his humanity was still alive. Although it was not a bad thing, it could bring trouble sometimes.
’Yeah I know, but I believe he has been punished for more than he did already. Let’s just leave it at that for now.’ Vritra replied, sometimes forgiveness could be the key.
Walking out of the chamber, Vritra headed towards his room while talking with Yasmine. Just when he was midway through he saw Sonia heading towards the crown prince’s room.
And right now she looked a little shaken, her hair a mess just like her clothes, and it seemed she was truly depressed and had been through a fight.
"What’s wrong?" Vritra questioned, stopping the determined fiery Sonia in her tracks.

After looking left and right carefully, Sonia took a step forward and whispered: "I just saw the crown prince with a bottle of very strong poison. He has already made up his mind to kill the king. Now I am going to strike the final nail in the coffin. After seeing me in this state and hearing me cry, he will be mad with rage and would kill the king immediately. Muahahaha."
Vritra: "..."
"Hehehe." Yasmine laughed hard, before asking: "Isn’t he taking all this too seriously? Are you sure Henry was your enemy and not his? He looks more determined than you."
"There is no need for you to do that now. The issue with the king has been resolved so we don’t need to kill him." Vritra said, sighing.
"WHAT?!!" Monk Shitless froze on his spot, as if the world was about to be destroyed.
{Sin Point Gained: Frozen +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Disappointed +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Disappointed +1}
Vritra read the lines of messages and his lips stretched in a thin line. Shaking his head, he added: "Yes, cancel the mission, just tell the truth to the crown prince."
"...F- Fine, but we really can’t kill the king? It won’t hurt to try. Let’s just leave it to the crown prince and—" Monk Shitless asked hopefully.
"Just go." Vritra said in a stern tone, and finally Sonia walked away in a truly depressed mood.
Vritra decided to observe them. He wondered how one of the biggest simps would act. Jack, the Crown Prince, and Han Gratt—three of the biggest simps of this universe.
Monk Shitless soon arrived outside the crown prince’s room. Instead of knocking he just pushed the door open and saw the prince sitting on a chair and staring at a glass bottle.
"Sonia?!! What’s wrong with you? What happened to you? Was it my father?" The prince was shocked as he stood up and took her hands, asking in worry.
"No, it isn’t like that. Do you love me? Do you want to spend your life with me?" Sonia asked in a solemn tone.

"Of course I do. I love you more than anything in this world. I could sacrifice anything and everything for you. It isn’t just your body that I have fallen for. I feel like our connection goes far beyond everything, I never want to be separated from you." The crown prince said seriously.
"Then shall we get married?" Sonia asked, making the prince sit on the bed.

"W- What? M- Marriage?!! I would love that!! Yes, let’s get married as soon as possible. I was planning to ask you to marry me after killing my fath—cough anyway, yes let’s get married." The crown prince almost jumped in joy upon hearing that.
"But before that you need to know something." Sonia suddenly became serious as she spoke.
"Just tell me what it is. I am ready to accept anything if it means we can be together." The crown prince said.
"Actually I am not Sonia..." Suddenly he removed the makeup glyph and Monk Shitless’s true appearance came into view.
"Hahaha, I am Shitless. All of this was just a prank, there is the camera."
