chapters.title: Chapter 233: The door
paragraphs: "Hahaha, I am Shitless. All of this was just a prank, there is the camera." Monk Shitless laughed hard as he watched the shocked expression of the crown prince.
The monk gave his best evil laugh while watching the prince just stand there frozen, it wasn’t as good as if they had completed their plan but the reaction was still pretty good.
After staying silent for several minutes, the prince took a deep breath and took a step towards Monk, he placed one arm over Monk’s shoulder before speaking in an affectionate tone:
"As I said our relation goes far beyond bodies, I have fallen in love with your soul so no matter however you look I will accept you.
And maybe this is for the better, now my father would have no interest in you, so Sonia let’s truly become one."
This time Monk Shitless was the one who was terrified, the wide grin froze on his face and an instinctive fear rose from within him.
"No no no no wait wait wait wait, Helllpppppppp Uwaaaaaaaah This is scarryyyyyyy" without wasting a moment, Monk Shitless fled from the room as the crown prince tried to embrace him.
After escaping from the room, Monk Shitless ran out like a mad bull and stopped upon seeing Vritra: "P- Pitiful one, help me, the prince has gone crazy!!"

"Congratulations, now you have finally found true love in your true form. Always be happy, and live as the future queen of the Blue Kingdom, goodbye Sir Shitless." Vritra said and then he disappeared.
"Noooooo Young masterrrrrr Please don’t abandon meeeeee" Monk Shitless screamed in terror, feeling a sense of déjà vu as he ran out of the castle and soon found his Bullo.

After separating from the monk, Vritra headed towards his room. It was getting dark and it was time for them to eat dinner, the days had been rather peaceful and they were gradually progressing though it seemed Vritra could only grow when stuck in trouble.
The relationship between the three women had already become quite better, they were more like friends. Diana was the oldest in the group but Vanessa was the mature one.

’I wonder if the men from the Golden Moon took care of those Grieves and Nine Pacts.’ Vritra thought. He had been patiently waiting for Dark Knight and the Hellmancer to finish the absorption of the demon lord’s energy, after that he would get several new and stronger slaves.
Opening the door to his room, Vritra found the three women chatting.
"Shall we head to the dinner?" he asked and the four of them headed towards the dining table, he explained everything to them and all three of them felt a lot more relaxed.
And just like that another day passed in peace.
Returning to his room, Vritra trained a couple of rounds with his mother and then the two slept comfortably in each other’s room.
Early in the morning the next day, they followed the same schedule.
After eating breakfast, they headed to the Small Forest for hunting but this day was going to be anything but peaceful.
"It was fine just a few minutes earlier but doesn’t it feel a little hot all of a sudden?" Diana asked as she took out the paper fan.
"Yeah it does, Fiona do you feel strange about this heat?" Vritra asked, caressing her palms gently.
"Not strange or anything, but it has the same feeling as the heat energy I can generate... just like the phoenix’s." she answered, feeling unsure about it herself.
"Hmmm it does sound unusual, maybe some sort of big change is about to happen." Yasmine added.

"The heat today is higher than the previous times we have felt it, this is not normal, the weather should be getting colder instead of hot." Vanessa said, lazily leaning her head over Vritra’s shoulder.

Diana glanced at the two women and felt jealous, she had been trying to get close to him especially after that last incident; it was like she was left hungry and with each passing day she craved him more and more.
Soon the carriage arrived at their destination, as usual they headed into the Small Forest while the coachman went to a nearby hotel after parking the carriage and feeding the horses.

"Start your training, I will be hunting demons nearby." Vritra said after they had walked a bit deep into the forest, then he flew away while the three women began finding demons along with the two soul wraiths.
Today their levels will certainly rise high enough that they might be able to enter the Legion rank.
After hours of hunting, Vritra sensed the presence of another demon and he decided to kill one more before heading back, he had already killed five 1st Legion ranked demons.
On the other hand, Vanessa, Diana and Fiona defeated another demon over level 800 and finally decided to rest.
They sat on the chair and began discussing their battle strategies and mistakes but then they sensed some sort of change around them.
Everything was getting too hot, few of the trees had even started to burn. The three women stood up in shock and stared at their surroundings in bewilderment.
"W- What’s going on? It feels too hot all of a sudden." Diana muttered, her breathing getting faster and her clothes already drenched in sweat.
"I don’t think we should stay here any longer, let’s just leave. It might be something dangerous." Vanessa said, as she glanced at the two soul wraiths who just stood there in confusion.
In the next moment, Vritra appeared beside them. He abandoned the idea of killing that final demon and upon sensing the change decided to return to his family.
"Honey, do you know what’s happening?" Vanessa asked as the three women turned to him.
"No, let’s just leave for now—" Vritra had just started to speak when suddenly a big explosion rang out in the sky and everything seemed to be covered by a layer of red.
The sky, land, everything looked as if they were burning in the most intense flames.
The four of them closed their eyes momentarily as the blinding light hit them and when they looked at their surroundings they were shocked to see a majestic door hovering in the air.
The door seemed to be made entirely of flames, it was so big in size and looked as if it could burn the world, and Phoenix made of the same flames were flying around it.
"An Inheritance!!" Vritra and Yasmine exclaimed at the same time upon seeing that door, and all the changes finally made sense.
"So it was a Phoenix inheritance, no wonder Fiona felt like that." Vritra understood, after thinking for a moment he decided to check it out.
"Let’s go." He nodded at others and started flying towards the door bringing them along with the help of dust.
"This is not just any inheritance, it will bring great benefits for Fiona. She should definitely enter it." Yasmine said, a faint excitement in her voice.
Vritra nodded, he touched the entrance of the opened door and felt as if some sort of barrier was present there, despite applying some force he couldn’t get in.
"Hmm looks like only the ones with Phoenix bloodline could enter it..." Vritra concluded, this thing has been following Fiona and finally opened right at her location.

It was getting dark and it was time for them to eat dinner, the days had been rather peaceful and they were gradually progressing though it seemed Vritra could only grow when stuck in trouble.
The relationship between the three women had already become quite better, they were more like friends.
Diana was the oldest in the group but Vanessa was the mature one.
’I wonder if the men from the Golden Moon took care of those Grieves and Nine Pacts.’ Vritra thought.
He had been patiently waiting for Dark Knight and the Hellmancer to finish the absorption of the demon lord’s energy, after that he would get several new and stronger slaves.
Opening the door to his room, Vritra found the three women chatting.
"Shall we head to the dinner?" he asked and the four of them headed towards the dining table, he explained everything to them and all three of them felt a lot more relaxed.
And just like that another day passed in peace.
Returning to his room, Vritra trained a couple of rounds with his mother and then the two slept comfortably in each other’s room.
Early in the morning the next day, they followed the same schedule.
After eating breakfast, they headed to the Small Forest for hunting but this day was going to be anything but peaceful.
"It was fine just a few minutes earlier but doesn’t it feel a little hot all of a sudden?" Diana asked as she took out the paper fan.
"Yeah it does, Fiona do you feel strange about this heat?" Vritra asked, caressing her palms gently.
"Not strange or anything, but it has the same feeling as the heat energy I can generate... just like the phoenix’s." she answered, feeling unsure about it herself.
"Hmmm it does sound unusual, maybe some sort of big change is about to happen." Yasmine added.

"The heat today is higher than the previous times we have felt it, this is not normal, the weather should be getting colder instead of hot." Vanessa said, lazily leaning her head over Vritra’s shoulder.

Diana glanced at the two women and felt jealous, she had been trying to get close to him especially after that last incident; it was like she was left hungry and with each passing day she craved him more and more.
Soon the carriage arrived at their destination, as usual they headed into the Small Forest while the coachman went to a nearby hotel after parking the carriage and feeding the horses.

"Start your training, I will be hunting demons nearby." Vritra said after they had walked a bit deep into the forest, then he flew away while the three women began finding demons along with the two soul wraiths.
Today their levels will certainly rise high enough that they might be able to enter the Legion rank.
After hours of hunting, Vritra sensed the presence of another demon and he decided to kill one more before heading back, he had already killed five 1st Legion ranked demons.
On the other hand, Vanessa, Diana and Fiona defeated another demon over level 800 and finally decided to rest.
They sat on the chair and began discussing their battle strategies and mistakes but then they sensed some sort of change around them.
Everything was getting too hot, few of the trees had even started to burn.
The three women stood up in shock and stared at their surroundings in bewilderment.
"W- What’s going on?
It feels too hot all of a sudden." Diana muttered, her breathing getting faster and her clothes already drenched in sweat.
"I don’t think we should stay here any longer, let’s just leave.
It might be something dangerous." Vanessa said, as she glanced at the two soul wraiths who just stood there in confusion.
In the next moment, Vritra appeared beside them.
He abandoned the idea of killing that final demon and upon sensing the change decided to return to his family.
"Honey, do you know what’s happening?" Vanessa asked as the three women turned to him.
"No, let’s just leave for now—" Vritra had just started to speak when suddenly a big explosion rang out in the sky and everything seemed to be covered by a layer of red.
The sky, land, everything looked as if they were burning in the most intense flames.
The four of them closed their eyes momentarily as the blinding light hit them and when they looked at their surroundings they were shocked to see a majestic door hovering in the air.
The door seemed to be made entirely of flames, it was so big in size and looked as if it could burn the world, and Phoenix made of the same flames were flying around it.
"An Inheritance!!" Vritra and Yasmine exclaimed at the same time upon seeing that door, and all the changes finally made sense.
"So it was a Phoenix inheritance, no wonder Fiona felt like that." Vritra understood, after thinking for a moment he decided to check it out.
"Let’s go." He nodded at others and started flying towards the door bringing them along with the help of dust.
"This is not just any inheritance, it will bring great benefits for Fiona.
She should definitely enter it." Yasmine said, a faint excitement in her voice.
Vritra nodded, he touched the entrance of the opened door and felt as if some sort of barrier was present there, despite applying some force he couldn’t get in.
"Hmm looks like only the ones with Phoenix bloodline could enter it..." Vritra concluded, this thing has been following Fiona and finally opened right at her location.

chapters.title: Chapter 234: Lingering Danger
paragraphs: "Try it," Vritra said, gesturing towards Fiona.

She nodded and moved closer to the door. Before even touching it, she could feel a force pulling her towards it, and as her finger came in contact with it—unlike Vritra’s case—she was easily able to pass through the barrier.
"I was right," he said. After thinking for a moment, he looked at Diana and Vanessa and spoke:
"You two should return to the castle for now with Bobby."
Right as he spoke, a shadow flew from under his feet and transformed into a three-meter-high sphere. Since Bobby could also fly, going back with it would be a lot faster.
"Alright, take care of yourself and Fiona," Vanessa said, and jumped onto Bobby.
"Be careful..." Diana said before following Vanessa. As the two women stood on top of Bobby, Vritra formed a sort of barrier with dust on top of Bobby so it would be easier for them to travel.
"Yeah, I will be careful. Ghost, go with them," Vritra said, as another shadow flew away and disappeared into the darkness under Bobby.
In the next moment, Bobby flew away at high speed, bringing the two women along. Finally, Vritra turned to Fiona. He cupped her tender cheeks gently and looked into her eyes.

"Do you want to go inside? Unknown dangers hide inside, and unfortunately, I can’t enter with you, so you will only be able to depend on yourself." He wasn’t going to stop her just because it was dangerous—such great opportunities won’t pop up every day.
"... Yeah, I will enter, and don’t worry, I will do my best to return to you safe and sound," Fiona nodded with a determined look.

"Okay, go inside. I will wait here until you come out. Don’t try to be stubborn if it gets too difficult, and if you really are in danger, then I will just break down this door and come to you," Vritra added in a serious tone.
"I know, I won’t throw my life away just because of some stupid inheritance. I am going to spend my entire life with you. So I will exit the moment I can’t proceed," Fiona replied with a sweet smile.
Vritra pressed his lips against her soft, moist lips, giving her a kiss full of love.
"Go ahead, I am sure you can do it," Vritra said as he embraced her tightly before moving back.
"Mmm." She nodded and turned to enter.
"Wait," Vritra called out, and Fiona looked back in confusion, waiting for him.
"Ghoul, try to enter," he said, as the soul wraith materialized beside him and extended one of its hands towards the large fiery door. Ghoul’s hand actually just passed through the barrier.
"I guess he can’t be counted as a living being, so the barrier can’t work against him," Yasmine mumbled to herself.

"This is great, now you will be safe. Ghoul, go along with her and help her if she is in danger or asks for your help. Otherwise, just let her continue," Vritra commanded as the soul wraith transformed into a shadow and followed Fiona.
"I will be going now," Fiona smiled and said. She didn’t reject, and with Ghoul following her, she felt more confident.

She wasn’t the type of person who would feel inferior getting her man’s help to get stronger; instead, she just loved his caring side so much, and now one of her biggest reasons to get stronger was him.

"Okay." Vritra watched as Fiona disappeared into the large door. Few inheritances had opened in the Blue Kingdom recently after the Scarlet Inheritance was obtained, and people would flood there to get their hands on the inheritance.

So Vritra had to stay there and keep anyone from entering. He was only left with Bob now; all the other soul wraiths were busy elsewhere. After all, previously Bob was with Monk Shitless, but now there was no need for it.
"Wifey, how long do you think she would need to get that inheritance?" Vritra asked, as he hovered in front of the large fiery door.
"Based on the difficulty, I would say at least three to four days, or it might be more," Yasmine answered.
"Hmmm. Mom and Diana should be fine with Ghost protecting them, and I have enough food to be full for long enough. Though if I could get a high-level demon, it would be even better," Vritra mumbled.
He called out Bob and made it increase its size so that from the front it covered the entire fiery door. He sat on top of Bob and asked: "Have you already absorbed all that soul potion?"
"Yes. What about you, hubby?" she asked, while carefully observing the surroundings.

"Yeah, I have already absorbed it all too, and my soul seems stronger than before. I can just feel it somehow. Anyway, how much of your strength do you think you have recovered?" he questioned. While he needed to protect the entrance, talking with his sweet and naughty wife was the best activity he could do.

"My strength has already entered the 2nd Legion Rank. It should be above 2,100 for now. Nihil-Anima is also getting stronger, so my healing will also become faster," she answered. Lately, they hadn’t had such private moments, where there was no one but just the two of them.
"Even this Phoenix Inheritance has opened... sigh, when will the Misty Essence come out?" Vritra muttered. That was the only reason why he was staying in this kingdom despite the danger.
"Oh, someone is approaching." Vritra sensed the presence of two demons that had probably sensed the presence of the inheritance door. They were rapidly running in his direction.
"Bob, wait here for a moment," Vritra spoke and disappeared, shooting in the direction of the demons. They were mindless demons who just sensed a treasure.
Maybe this was for the better. Many people might be attracted to the inheritance, and this way he could gain a lot of experience points.

The three men from the Golden Moon— J, K, and O, had left for the First City to investigate the presence of the Grieves, because of the letter they had received. They arrived at the temple but couldn’t find anything strange. The three knew it was almost impossible to uncover the Grieves if they were trying to hide.

So after their long investigation, even a thorough search across the entire city, the three members weren’t able to find anything. Though the Grieves became even more cautious now, they were surprised that people were getting aware of their presence so soon. But they were close to achieving their goal, so they just needed to hide for some more time.
On this day, the Grieves were waiting just as usual, and suddenly they sensed a big change from a similar position as before, and it seemed this time that particular inheritance had finally opened.
Leading a large group of white-clothed men, the pope of the temple flew towards the Small Forest at high speed, bringing almost all the members along.
The strength of most of them was above the 1st Legion Rank and close to the 2nd Legion, or even above. Since the time had finally come, they were going all out.
Within a minute, they arrived in the Small Forest and soon found the inheritance door. There was a large metallic ball present in front of it.

chapters.title: Chapter 235: Inevitable
paragraphs: The pope led the big group of white‐clothed men towards the Phoenix inheritance. After entering the Small Forest, they soon arrived in front of the large fiery door and saw a large metallic ball blocking the entrance.
"Sir Pope, that is certainly the Phoenix inheritance that we were trying to find for so long." One of the men with a star symbol over his chest flew forward and spoke to the pope.

There were ten Stars directly under the Pope and more than three hundred other men who were all being controlled by the Grieves. They observed the surroundings and made sure that aside from the metallic ball, no one was around.
"Yes, we have to take the inheritance. That is our only way to enter the Phoenix race and control all the members without actually taking control of each of them," the pope said.
They weren’t exactly sure what this inheritance held, but one thing was certain—the one to obtain the inheritance would become the ruler of the Phoenix race.

The previous king of that race had died a long time ago, and since then the Phoenix clan could only hide while waiting for their next ruler. If the Grieves could take the inheritance, then they could move the Phoenixes as they wished.
"Take care of it," the pope ordered two of the Stars, as they charged towards the surprised Bob.

The soul wraith was startled to see so many men appearing all of a sudden, but it reacted quickly upon sensing the two approaching men. Bob raised its defense and increased its size until it covered the entire door.
The speed of most of them was a lot faster than Bob’s, so it could only hold on until Vritra returned.
BOOOOOOOOM!
Two explosive punches landed on Bob’s surface at the same time. Its surface cracked instantly, destructive energy rushed into the large metallic ball, and within moments, it crumbled.
"I wonder what that thing was. After its death, it didn’t even leave a body behind," one of the two Stars mumbled, as they looked back at their leader for further orders.
"Try going inside," the pope said, his face expressionless. It had been more than a month since this Grieve took control of the pope. Since then, they had secretly taken control over the temple.
"Yes, Pope." The same Star nodded and extended his hand towards the door. As expected, he was stopped by the barrier. Before he could turn back, the pope’s voice rang again.
"Now use our newly created glyph, the Phoenix Inheritance Glyph," the pope said.
"Sir Bishop, that name sounds bad. Why don’t we change it to something else?" one of the members among the hundreds spoke out.
"It is going to be a one‐time use item anyway, so just focus on work," the pope said in a harsh tone.
The Star nodded as he took out a fiery small cube and inserted his energy into it. The orb turned into flames and created a thin layer of barrier around his body.
Then, taking a deep breath, he extended his hand towards the door again, and this time it actually passed without any sort of hindrance.
"Pope, we have succeeded. Let’s all enter the inheritance and take the—" the Star was speaking in excitement as he looked back at the pope, but suddenly...
BOOOOOOM!!
A shadow flashed in the air. A few of the members among the white‐clothed noticed it at the last moment.
Vritra had just killed two of the demons without much difficulty. He kept the two in his storage, deciding to let Bob eat one and keep one for himself.
But just then, he sensed the approaching presence, and only a few seconds later Bob’s body was destroyed. Without wasting a moment, he rushed back.
To his surprise, one of the members was actually able to pass through the barrier with the use of some strange glyph.
’No wonder, the Grieves are said to be the best at the creation of glyphs,’ Vritra thought as he activated Shift and shifted 50% of his stat from Strength and Defense to Agility.

His speed increased exponentially all of a sudden, and right before the moment of clash, he shifted all those points to Strength. Using the dust ability, Vritra transformed his feet into an extremely sharp weapon.
And then he struck the head of the Star with his feet, exerting all his strength.
BOOOOOOOM!!
{Sin Point Gained: Shocked +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +309}
{Sin Point Gained: Intrigued +309}
The Star was thrown away as the explosive kick landed on his head. The other Grieves weren’t as shocked; they watched Vritra with interest.
The other Star that was close to the door moved back and floated beside his pope.

With a resounding explosion, the first Star created a big crater in the ground as he let out a loud, painful scream. All the gazes shifted towards the crater as they watched in utter silence. After a few seconds, the Star walked out of the hole. More than half of his head was blown, and even his brain was badly damaged.
"Fuck!! You rat, you dared to sneak an attack at me?!!" The first Star flew up. He shattered a white‐colored glyph in his hand, and his injuries began to heal rapidly.
"How surprising, showing so much power at that level. Hmm, hmm, you pass!!" the pope said, as he looked back at all the men and added:
"Don’t kill him. I want to use him for my experiment. I can smell the creation of a great glyph if I can pull his body apart. He is special."
"But—But he hit me. Just let me kill him and you can use his corpse—" the first Star said in dissatisfaction.
"Silence!!" The pope just looked at him, and the first Star fell silent. Then he looked at Vritra with a calm smile and asked:
"It doesn’t seem to be the first time we are meeting, am I right?"
"Sorry, my memory has an auto‐delete function for people with ugly faces, so I don’t remember you," Vritra taunted. He wanted to see who among them would be angered by such a simple sentence.
"POPE, I AM GOING TO KILL HIM!! How dare a puny human disrespect you, the great—" Almost the entire group of the Grieves was enraged. It seemed they were humans’ arch‐enemies.
"Haha, do you know about Grieves?" the pope asked.

Vritra was surprised that they were chatting so casually instead of hurrying inside, which only meant they had already covered a large part of the Small Forest, and no one from the outside would be able to see anything that was happening here.
So no people would be coming for the Phoenix inheritance.
"How can I know of your Grieves? And if you want to know my grievances, then I don’t think this is the right place or time for it," Vritra shrugged his shoulders.
’Sigh. Fuck my luck. I knew it—I would end up facing them one way or another. And with Fiona being inside, I have no choice but to stop any single one of them from entering,’ he thought.
"Hahaha, a funny one, aren’t you?" the pope laughed.
Vritra took a deep breath as he took out his Axes of Chaos and got ready for the brutal battle that was about to start.

And with Fiona being inside, I have no choice but to stop any single one of them from entering,’ he thought.
"Hahaha, a funny one, aren’t you?" the pope laughed.
Vritra took a deep breath as he took out his Axes of Chaos and got ready for the brutal battle that was about to start.

chapters.title: Chapter 236: First Attack!!
paragraphs: [Nether Eye Activated.]
Vritra held his axes in both hands as the third eye appeared on his forehead. He carefully observed all the white-clothed men and knew that the most dangerous were the ten stars and the pope.

The rest of the members were all under the 2nd Legion rank, but there was another terrifying thing about the Grieves, and that was... Glyphs. Over the years, they had created glyphs that most couldn’t even imagine.
"Hubby, the Grieves in most cases choose hosts that are weaker than them. And that seems to be the case with almost everyone present here.
They have already taken the consciousness of the humans they are possessing, so it is nothing more than a shell.
But even if you were to destroy their bodies, the Grieves would just appear in their original form, even stronger than before." Yasmine warned. They were stuck in the worst possible situation.
Vritra couldn’t move away from the door, and the Grieves would without a doubt take advantage of this fact. Not to mention, they already seemed to have set up various glyphs across the place.
’Heh, that just means double the experience points for me. Anyway, I guess I can’t afford to hold back at such a moment...’ Vritra thought as he released a long breath.
[Switch Activated.]
[Switch: Demonification (1%)]
Horns appeared over his head, and a destructive bluish energy flooded the surroundings. The group of Grieves were surprised yet again as they sensed the jump in Vritra’s power.

"Oh, I can sense Demon Lord’s energy coming from your body, but you are still too weak to actually be a Demon Lord. Hmm, so you are Vritra." The pope soon concluded. It was pretty obvious if one joined the puzzle.
THUMP THUMP
THUMP THUMP
"..." Vritra’s heart had started to beat wildly, pumping the energy throughout his body as his veins started looking blue.

He didn’t go all out with Shift since he planned to rapidly shift his stats based on the situation. As for Fourth Dimension, it could only be used to surprise the other side. Once they had seen it, the Fourth Dimension would most probably be useless afterward.
[Suck! Suck! Suck! Activated.]
"Bob, hold the door!!" Vritra muttered as the large metallic ball once again covered the entrance of the large door.
While observing the surroundings, he sensed something strange, as if countless invisible threads were spread throughout the space, but he couldn’t actually see or touch them.
Partial Dragon Transformation!!

Scales started to appear over Vritra’s body as his strength increased even further. Just like the dragon transformation that came with his dragon physique and bloodlines, there was a strange transformation that Vritra had yet to try—the one he obtained because of his Demon God’s bloodline and physique.
"Capture him." The pope said, gesturing at the ten stars. He didn’t underestimate Vritra, which was exactly why he sent all ten of the stars forward for the battle.
"Be careful, I will join you in the battle soon." Yasmine said. If she revealed herself too fast, it would take away the surprise factor.

Vritra flew a bit away from the door and Bob; he didn’t want his soul wraith to suffer for no reason. The ten stars surrounded Vritra, curiously observing his transformation. All of them were holding different sorts of glyphs in their hands.
BOOOOM

With a thundering sound, all of them charged forward as they initiated their attacks. The ten stars were looking down on Vritra; despite his transformation, he had yet to even reach the 2nd Legion rank after all.
’Forbid: Sight!!’ Vritra rapidly used the Forbidden skill as all ten of the stars lost their sight for a tenth of a second.
[Forbidden Activated.]
[Forbidden Activated.]
[Forbidden Activated.]

Then he took in a deep breath, pulling the mana out from their bodies and disrupting their attacks as the glyphs in their hands shattered. Vritra decided to use one of his strongest attacks right from the start.
[Shift Activated.]
[Shift: Defence + Agility → Strength]
[Switch: Demonification (3%)]
[Body of Dust Activated!!]
Evil-Veyll God Essence!!

Purplish energy burst out of his body along with blue energy—extreme, converged, and destructive dust particles—as the hearts in his chest started to beat even faster, rapidly increasing strength and energy.

While Suck! Suck! Suck! was pushed to the limits as Vritra devoured more and more energy, almost making the surroundings devoid of any mana, his body held so much destructive power that he was really about to explode.
Finally, Vritra channelled all that energy into his axes, the weapons whose strength had been raised to above the middle of 2nd Legion rank.
The Axes of Chaos increased the destructive power behind the attack even further.
All of this happened in less than a second. The ten stars didn’t even have the time to reorganise after their attack failed as utter destruction swallowed them.

The moment Vritra swung the two axes, both his arms exploded into a bloody mess, and then he disappeared into the Fourth Dimension. Cracks formed over the surface of the two axes as they failed to hold that much power.

The Demon Lord’s power at 3% was already destructive enough, but the Evil-Veyll God Essence had also become a lot stronger compared to before, as it continued to devour more and more of the demonic energy.
Finally, the result of the attack swallowed the ten stars. For a moment, there was utter silence before chaos broke out.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!
A deafening sound rang out. The pope smiled and just moved away as he watched everything with interest. Vritra’s plan wasn’t just to take out the ten stars but as many men from the group as he could.
After swallowing the ten men, the destructive energy continued to rage towards the group of hundreds of men as they hastily put up their barriers.
They were just going to enjoy a good show, as the respected ten stars would easily and thoroughly destroy that guy.
But who could have thought that he could use such a devastating attack—and would use it at the start of the battle.
The cries of the ten stars rang out as their bodies were twisted and torn to bits. Their human shells were completely destroyed within moments.

More than seventy men from the large group were also swallowed, and their bodies were destroyed just like those ten Grieves. They screamed in pain as the human shell was completely crushed and not even a drop of blood remained.
Messages quickly flooded in front of Vritra.
[You have killed a Level 2,149 Human.]
[You have killed a Level 2,225 Human.]
[You have killed a Level 2,078 Human.]
[You have killed a Level 2,109 Human.]
[+EXP Earned.]
[You have Levelled Up!]
[You have Levelled Up!]
[You have Levelled Up!]
[All Stats Increased by 10.]
[All Stats Increased by 10.]
[All Stats Increased by 10.]
[You have gained 10 Allocation Points.]
[You have gained 10 Allocation Points.]
[You have gained 10 Allocation Points.]
Vritra didn’t even need to consume any healing potion. He just reduced the Switch back to 1%, and with the help of his dual heart, his injuries had completely disappeared in a couple of seconds.
Except for the energy in his body he was back to peak shape.

chapters.title: Chapter 237: Peak!!
paragraphs: Vritra carefully observed the damage he had caused, the Evil-Veyll God Essence had truly become a lot stronger, but now he could only use it one more time before it is full again.
"That removed their human bodies but the Grieves would be even stronger now, and they won’t fall for the same tricks again." Vritra mumbled as he came out of the fourth dimension.
After the Shift was deactivated, his body entered a state of weakness but it only lasted a few seconds since he had used it for just a moment.
Ignoring the pope for now, he gazed at the large group of people who had barely managed to protect themselves against the storm of wild energy that could destroy their bodies within moments.
"How interesting, what else are you hiding?" the pope spoke. He still didn’t take Vritra seriously.
Wiping the blood from the corner of his lips, Vritra clutched the axes and flashed behind the group of Grieves who were still fending off the raging energy storm.
Releasing a thunderous roar, he charged into the group of Grieves and swung the axes around with all his might, again pouring all his stat points into strength with Shift.

His primary goal was to gain as many levels as he could and reach the peak of 1st Legion rank, and that goal wasn’t too far. It was like he was back in that labyrinth, surrounded by large hordes of Grieves, tearing their bodies apart with the axes.
BAANNNGGGGG!!
WHOOOSH
The blade of the axe cut off the top of one man as his brain was split in half, then Vritra poured the demon lord’s energy into his body, destroying it to pieces.
Without stopping for a second, he moved at extreme speed as his hands turned into a blur and the large axes felt as if they had become a part of his body. Vritra was already covered in red blood.
But just after he had killed a dozen or so of them, they started to notice Vritra. And the ones who were getting killed were reverting back to their original form, out of the human shell.
"Extract!!"
Vritra shouted as he took in a deep breath and the invisible flames spread all across the sky as they devoured every person killed by Vritra, even if their bodies were turned into minced meat.

The ten stars had already reverted to their original form; they were grey fog-like figures with a silhouette quite similar to humans, except for their height, which was around seven feet or slightly above.
Their bodies weren’t made of smoke even if they looked like it, they possessed a solid body just like most other living forms.
Even the human bodies these ten stars had left behind were raised into Soul Wraiths along with more than a hundred members from the large group.
Vritra had to pour a vast amount of energy to raise so many strong soul wraiths at once.

Even withSuck! Suck! Suck!, Superior Mana Recovery Boost, andShiftworking in the background, Vritra was exhausted and felt his head spin for a moment. But he quickly took out the best mana regeneration potions from his inventory and took several long breaths as his energy soon began to recover.

Vritra directly made the newly raised Soul Wraiths attack the group of humans while he retreated to the back. He watched as the soul wraiths started attacking the humans; those ten rings’ soul wraiths were especially powerful, easily killing any human they came across.
"Oh, is that... Nihil-Anima? How can he possess such a Mythic halo? Just who is he exactly to possess so many secrets and powers at such a level?" the pope mumbled.
He didn’t really care even if Vritra destroyed all the human shells; they could always get new ones, and their work here was almost done anyway.
Instead, he was getting to see such incredible abilities, so it was worth it. But the pope still couldn’t understand if Vritra was a human, a dragon, or a demon.
The sight was extremely bloody; limbs, organs, and flesh were scattered all over the place, and an air of death lingered across the battlefield.

As more and more humans were dying, they were reverting back to their true form and their strength was rising rapidly. It wasn’t long before, except for the pope, all the others had reverted to their true forms.
Vritra panted slightly while a large army of more than three hundred Soul Wraiths floated around him. He had raised them all to Soul Wraiths and had used way too much energy.
In front of him was the pope along with more than three hundred Grieves who were at their full power. His plan had succeeded initially, but the danger now had increased exponentially. But...
Name: Vritra Arclis
Level: 1,999 (1st Legion rank) (Paused)
Class: Dust Lord (Rank: A) [SSS+(?)]
Title: The Cursed Hunter [Level 10]
Race: Demon (Origin), Dragon
Vitality: 100%
Stats:
Intelligence: 34,511 (+1,000)
Luck: 512
[Allocation points: 2,030]

’I don’t think they would be kind enough to give me a little time so I can enter the 2nd Legion rank.’ Vritra thought. Although the Grieves’ expressions seemed strange, he could tell they were extremely angry.
He had tortured them all, even if it wasn’t enough to kill or seriously injure them.
"Let me buy some time for you, we would have a better chance at winning or holding on until Fiona comes out." Yasmine suggested. The fight going forward was going to be extremely dangerous.
’Wait a little longer.’ Vritra said. He glanced back at his dead soldiers and knew that in their current state they wouldn’t be of much help, so the best bet was to let them devour one another.
’Ghoul, hurry up.’ Vritra sent a mental message while the soul wraiths behind him started to devour one another. Vritra floated forward and stopped in front of the pope.
"Why don’t you go back to your original form? This looks too ugly on you." Vritra said, while forming various kinds of scenarios in his mind.
But right now his greatest weakness was the fact that he barely knew anything about them, and this put him at a big disadvantage.

"You truly are interesting, but playtime is over. If we weren’t in a hurry to get that inheritance, I would have loved to entertain you a little longer. But now we will have to cut our fun show short." The pope spoke as he raised his hand above his head, and a glyph formed in front of his palm.

Vritra couldn’t understand what he was going to do, but in the next moment a blinding light engulfed everything, and then both of his arms and legs were tightly wrapped around by countless invisible threads.
It all happened so suddenly that Vritra had no time to move or dodge, his body was completely frozen.

"Now, please just wait there a little for me. I need to get something from inside. Hmmm... it seems someone has entered ahead of us. So there was actually a Phoenix in the Blue Kingdom... no wonder it opened in such a place."
The Pope spoke as his gaze shifted between Vritra and the large door, a big smile spreading across his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 238: Demonic Dragon
paragraphs: "So, you are trying to stop us because of the person that had gone inside? Don’t you worry though, we will destroy their soul and take control of their body, this is the perfect outcome." The pope laughed as he gestured for everyone to follow him into the inheritance ground.

He didn’t think for a moment that Vritra would be capable of breaking those restraints. With his current strength in the human body, the pope himself might not succeed in breaking those threads, let alone Vritra.

Treating Vritra as a neutralized threat, the pope shifted his attention to the large fiery door. Gesturing towards it, the large group headed towards the door as most of the grey figures shot deadly glares towards the frozen Vritra.
He didn’t go mad at the taunt from the pope, doing that would instead make him an easier target.
Vritra was going to protect Fiona at any cost.
’These threads... I can’t break them.’ Vritra exerted all his strength and even used the Shift but he still couldn’t break them. His skin started to tear, but those countless threads wouldn’t budge.
[Fourth Dimension Activated.]

All the Grieves activated the Phoenix Inheritance Glyph as their bodies got covered by a thin fiery barrier. They were ready to destroy Bob again and enter when suddenly a deafening sound shook the space.

All the Grieves turned back as they saw the place where Vritra had been was now empty. Even the pope was surprised. He had seen Vritra disappear once before, but that wasn’t enough for him to understand that skill completely.
ROOOAAAAARRRRRRRRRRRRR
When Vritra appeared, his body twisted as dragon scales rapidly appeared all over his body, and the size of his body started to increase.
Complete Dragon Transformation!!
Within moments, Vritra’s body increased in size to hundreds of meters as he transformed into an enormous black dragon, looking equally terrifying and strong.

Raising his head, he let out another roar. The grey figures, even with sizes above seven feet, looked tiny in front of him. Blue and purple energies were wrapped around his body, looking as if the air itself was being destroyed.
Before the shock of the appearance of a dragon could subside, another roar reverberated as a slightly illusory white dragon appeared out of nowhere.
After so many years, Yasmine made her appearance in front of someone other than Vritra for the first time.
Her presence alone made the Grieves shiver. She might not have recovered all her strength yet, but her aura was still that of the Dragon Queen.

"Oh, that doesn’t seem like one of his summons. That’s a soul, and although it is not too strong right now, that’s no ordinary dragon..." the pope muttered with a slight frown and wondered if this might possibly be the Dragon Queen that had been dead for many years.
’Stay close to the entrance, let me attack first.’ Vritra said, and Yasmine hummed in agreement.

The two moved at an extremely fast pace despite their large sizes. Yasmine looked slightly bigger than Vritra. If she looked like a beautiful angel with those beautiful white scales, then Vritra was like the devil with black scales and two horns on his head.

"Sigh, looks like going inside won’t be as easy as we had expected. Let’s take care of them first, but remember no one is allowed to kill them. Get ready for the battle." The pope said, as he moved to the back of the group and allowed the other grey figures to charge at the two dragons.
Yasmine’s role was to support Vritra. With countless years of experience in fighting against all sorts of creatures, she could assess the situation and future attacks better than Vritra.
She gazed at the ten stars and could tell those were the most trouble among the group of hundreds of charging Grieves. After a moment, she spoke to him mentally.
’Their biggest advantage are the Glyphs, and those things are activated by injecting energy or by crushing them. That’s how it has been so far.’
She didn’t explain any further, but Vritra knew exactly what she meant.
’Do you know how to kill them, since it doesn’t seem they would die like the others I had killed so far?’ he asked.
"I had killed many in the past with just brute force. I don’t know of any other way. They are one of the hardest creatures to kill."
Before the Grieves could activate any sort of trap again, Vritra rushed forward as countless dust spears, rotating at extreme speed and burning hot, shot at the approaching Grieves.
[Switch: Demonification (2%)]
THUMP THUMP THUMP
THUMP THUMP THUMP

In his current state, he could still handle that level of power. Vritra’s strength had long surpassed the beginning levels of the 2nd Legion rank, though the difference between each level here seemed even bigger.

Finally, the two sides clashed. The spears shot into the bodies of all the Grieves. Many pierced while most were blocked. Vritra swung his long tail, striking the approaching Grieves and blowing them away.

By this transformation, his strength had increased significantly. But seeing the damage done to the dozens of Grieves after such a powerful attack, Vritra was even more unsure of how he could kill them.
’Blood Lock could work, but there are too many enemies. Guess I could just hold on until Fiona is out.’ Vritra thought before going back into action.
Several of the Grieves even rushed towards Yasmine. Despite her weakened state, she hovered in front of Bob and met their attacks as she released a sea of flames from her mouth.
The over twenty Grieves heading towards her felt as if their soul itself was being burnt, but it couldn’t deliver a critical injury as they continued to attack despite the pain.
ROOOAAAAAARRRRRRRRRRRRR
Letting out a roar, Yasmine started fighting with all her might, even though she was at a disadvantage against so many strong opponents.

She did her best to disrupt their flow whenever they tried to use the glyphs, but it was impossible to defend against them all. Releasing a blast of energy, she blew them away, finding it difficult to fight so many with her current strength.
"Take the white dragon down first, she can’t hold on for too long." One of the Grieves muttered as a couple dozen of them charged towards Yasmine.
Just then, a black human-like figure appeared in front of Yasmine. Releasing a loud cry, it pounced at the approaching Grieves.
’The Soul Wraith!!’ Yasmine exclaimed. This was the wraith that was created from more than three hundred human corpses; its strength was reaching close to the 3rd Legion rank.
Seeing that Yasmine and the Soul Wraith could handle those Grieves, Vritra focused his gaze on the stars and the remaining hundreds of Grieves.

’Forbid: Flight!!’ Vritra thought as he charged forward at full speed. One of the stars was suddenly unable to fly. He was surprised and lost his balance for a moment. Vritra used that moment as he opened his mouth wide and bit down at his body.
"Arrrggghhh, fuck!!" the star let out a painful groan as Vritra’s teeth tore through his skin and went deeper into his flesh, almost ripping away his right shoulder.
[Blood Lock Activated.]
[Target Locked. Time Until Death: 3 hours 19 minutes 59 seconds.]

sentences.text: "So, you are trying to stop us because of the person that had gone inside?

Don’t you worry though, we will destroy their soul and take control of their body, this is the perfect outcome." The pope laughed as he gestured for everyone to follow him into the inheritance ground.

With his current strength in the human body, the pope himself might not succeed in breaking those threads, let alone Vritra.
Treating Vritra as a neutralized threat, the pope shifted his attention to the large fiery door.
Gesturing towards it, the large group headed towards the door as most of the grey figures shot deadly glares towards the frozen Vritra.
He didn’t go mad at the taunt from the pope, doing that would instead make him an easier target.
Vritra was going to protect Fiona at any cost.
’These threads...
I can’t break them.’ Vritra exerted all his strength and even used the Shift but he still couldn’t break them.
His skin started to tear, but those countless threads wouldn’t budge.

All the Grieves activated the Phoenix Inheritance Glyph as their bodies got covered by a thin fiery barrier.
They were ready to destroy Bob again and enter when suddenly a deafening sound shook the space.
All the Grieves turned back as they saw the place where Vritra had been was now empty.
Even the pope was surprised.
He had seen Vritra disappear once before, but that wasn’t enough for him to understand that skill completely.
ROOOAAAAARRRRRRRRRRRRR
When Vritra appeared, his body twisted as dragon scales rapidly appeared all over his body, and the size of his body started to increase.
Complete Dragon Transformation!!
Within moments, Vritra’s body increased in size to hundreds of meters as he transformed into an enormous black dragon, looking equally terrifying and strong.
Raising his head, he let out another roar.
The grey figures, even with sizes above seven feet, looked tiny in front of him.
Blue and purple energies were wrapped around his body, looking as if the air itself was being destroyed.
Before the shock of the appearance of a dragon could subside, another roar reverberated as a slightly illusory white dragon appeared out of nowhere.
After so many years, Yasmine made her appearance in front of someone other than Vritra for the first time.
Her presence alone made the Grieves shiver.
She might not have recovered all her strength yet, but her aura was still that of the Dragon Queen.
"Oh, that doesn’t seem like one of his summons.

That’s a soul, and although it is not too strong right now, that’s no ordinary dragon..." the pope muttered with a slight frown and wondered if this might possibly be the Dragon Queen that had been dead for many years.

The two moved at an extremely fast pace despite their large sizes.
Yasmine looked slightly bigger than Vritra.
If she looked like a beautiful angel with those beautiful white scales, then Vritra was like the devil with black scales and two horns on his head.
"Sigh, looks like going inside won’t be as easy as we had expected.
Let’s take care of them first, but remember no one is allowed to kill them.
Get ready for the battle." The pope said, as he moved to the back of the group and allowed the other grey figures to charge at the two dragons.

chapters.title: Chapter 239: Dragon Queen’s Peril
paragraphs: [Blood Lock Activated.]
[Target Locked. Time Until Death: 3 hours 19 minutes 59 seconds.]
He channeled the energy of the demon lord into the body of the Star at the same time while swinging his body to hit the other Grieves.
Then, throwing away the Star, Vritra focused on the other Grieves as he used the destructive power of the bluish demon lord’s energy.
But more than a physical fight, the Grieves depended on Glyphs and mental attacks; they could easily possess anyone.
Vritra usedSuck! Suck! Suck! to stop them from injecting their mana into the glyphs while using the dust to stop them from crushing them. He struck them again and again with the demon lord’s energy.
But no matter how many times they were hit, the Grieves did receive a few injuries, but they would heal back quickly. It was as if they were truly immortal.

He launched a mental attack at one of the Grieves through the Nether Eye, but it had absolutely no effect on them. Hundreds of sharp blades lunged into his body as one of the Stars finally succeeded in using his Glyph.
The black lustrous scales cracked and many blades pierced through Vritra’s flesh, limiting his movement. The more he moved the severe his injuries became.
This attack disrupted Vritra’s momentum, and like a chain reaction, hundreds of glyphs were used in the next moment.
ROOOAAAAAARRRRRRRRRRRR
Letting out a painful roar, Vritra received the attacks on his body. Although he didn’t feel much pain, such attacks were weakening him, and all he could do was hold on.
[Switch: Demonification (3%)]
Even more destructive energy erupted out of his body, appearing almost as if he was burning in blue flames.
With his increased level, Vritra could barely hold on as so much energy poured out of the demon lord’s core. He shook off all the blades and restraints and struck the Grieves even more violently.
BAAANNNNNGGGGGGG!!
The Stars were especially hard to handle. The ten of them surrounded Vritra and didn’t waste a single chance to launch attacks at him.
Even though the Grieves had the upper hand, it was extremely difficult to truly defeat Vritra. He had all sorts of tricks and made most of their attacks useless.
Vritra didn’t focus on the Star on which the Blood Lock was activated; otherwise, the Star would soon realize the changes and might just pull out some Glyph to negate its effect.
His body twisted in the sky, receiving attacks while striking out with all his strength.
At 3% energy, the demon lord’s energy was starting to hurt him, though his strength had also increased greatly, allowing him to face so many strong opponents.
’Since we can’t kill him, let’s just restrain him. Follow my lead and use the threads of space to keep him still. I have already understood how his disappearing ability works.’
One of the Stars said mentally as he moved back from the battle for a few minutes and made some changes to the restraining Glyph.
Then he told his plans to the others, and they all made the changes. Vritra was observing every small change around him through the third eye, but he couldn’t stop them from continuing.
On the other hand, the pope observed Vritra with interest for a while. Finally, it seemed he had already displayed all his tricks. He was indeed a great subject.
’We can’t delay this for too long. Although the Golden Moon or others can’t sense this area, it is better to finish our business faster and leave.
Of course, along with the inheritance, I found such a great test subject.’ The pope thought as he moved his gaze away from Vritra to Yasmine.

The white dragon and the soul wraith were still fighting against several Grieves, and both sides seemed to be at a stalemate. The Grieves would most probably win eventually, but it would take too long, so he finally decided to intervene.
The pope flew towards Yasmine. He simply extended his right hand forward and gathered energy into his palm.
This one strike would be enough to greatly weaken her soul. If she was really the former Dragon Queen, then the Grieves might have just hit the jackpot.
Yasmine didn’t even notice the pope until he was just behind her, while his fist was descending towards her.
Inside the inheritance ground.

Upon entering, Fiona found herself standing in an enormous cave where the walls, ceiling, and the ground all seemed as if they were made solely of lava. But strangely, they didn’t hurt Fiona, not even burning her clothes.
If anyone other than a phoenix had entered, they might have just burned to death. Remembering the presence of Ghoul, she glanced down and wondered if this soul wraith would be fine.
"..." Ghoul’s body actually seemed to be burning from the flames, but it didn’t seem to bother it at all, and the damage was minimal.
Taking a deep breath, she started to observe her surroundings. Ahead of her was a sea of lava, and nothing else was present around her.
"Am I supposed to enter this sea? There is no other way, but this looks dangerous." Fiona mumbled. She took out an empty box from the storage glyph and threw it towards the sea of flames.
It was a metallic box, but before even coming into contact with the sea, the box melted and soon disappeared.
"..." She pondered for a few seconds and, taking a deep breath, decided to test it herself. Carefully taking a few steps ahead, Fiona extended her hand forward to see if it would hurt her.
SPLISH

As her fingers came into contact with the surface of the sea, she wasn’t burnt at all. Instead, it seemed as if it was just warm water. Fiona didn’t waste any time as she started walking forward. As she entered the sea, she finally relaxed when the lava felt like ordinary water.
"But now where am I supposed to go?" She looked around and could only see endless lava. Just then Ghoul spoke:
"Move thirty degrees to your right."
Fiona nodded and started following. She was moving as fast as she could, but inside the lava her ability to move was limited. Even Ghoul was restrained to some extent.
After swimming for a few minutes, Fiona finally saw some sort of door in the distance. Finding a target, she sped up and headed towards it, but right then Ghoul spoke in its emotionless tone:
"Several hundred Grieves have arrived outside the inheritance door. Master has ordered me to tell you to hurry up a bit."

"What?!! G- Grieves?" Fiona was shocked. Vritra had told her about the Grieves and how dangerous they were. He always did his best to stay away from those creatures, but now he alone was facing so many of them.

"Let’s just leave. I don’t care about this inheritance. I don’t want anything to happen to my Darling—" Fiona was terrified to even think that Vritra alone would have to face those dangerous creatures. His safety was the priority for her.
"No, let’s get the inheritance first. We can’t waste any time." Ghoul interrupted her, Vritra knew what she would say after hearing about Grieves so he had given extra instructions.

chapters.title: Chapter 240: I am sorry, hubby...
paragraphs: "No, let’s continue." Ghoul interrupted her.
"..." Fiona knew Vritra must have ordered Ghoul to make her continue, but her heart ached thinking Vritra getting injured while holding all of them back.

She gritted her teeth and sped forward even faster, just as she was close to the door. Bubbles began to appear over the surface of the lava sea, Fiona halted for a moment as countless strange creatures rose out of the lava.
Their body structures were like that of dogs but more than ten feet high. Fiona wasted no time as she continued to charge forward and said: "Ghoul, kill them all."
Normally she would have done this on her own but now she couldn’t waste even a second.
The soul wraith reacted instantly as a blurry shadow flew around Fiona like a protective barrier, killing any and every creature that came close to her.
The two hurriedly approached the door and continued on their way to get the Phoenix inheritance.
Vritra’s body froze for a moment as he saw the pope suddenly appearing behind Yasmine, his speed was quite fast and now he was about to launch a devastating attack.
THUMP THUMP THUMP THUMP
His heartbeat increased even further, veins bulging as each cell in his body exploded with blue and purple energy. Leaving behind a large dust clone, Vritra shot towards the pope.
At this moment it was as if everyone in the world had disappeared, Vritra’s eyes were fixed only on the attack that was heading towards his wife. How could he let his Yasmine get hurt...
[Switch: Demonification (4%)]
[Shift Activated.]
[Shift: Strength + Endurance → Agility]

A vast amount of Chaotic energy burst out of his body, as Vritra even pulled out every last bit of energy from the Evil-Veyll God Essence Core and combined it with any and every sort of energy present in his body.
BOOOOM BOOOOOM

Even his dragon body couldn’t handle that level of power, as several explosions happened inside his body making his scales and flesh burst, but Vritra just used the momentum to increase his speed to the extreme.
When the pope’s fist was about to touch Yasmine’s back, Vritra collided with him as he let out all that devastating energy, much more chaotic than his first attack on the pope.
"Hah, as expected, so she is indeed your weakness." A wide grin spread across the pope’s wrinkled face, at the last moment he changed his target from Yasmine to Vritra as the two collided.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!
Just by the aftershock of the colliding force, Yasmine was thrown away and even Bob was pushed, but thankfully it had the door as support, while most of the other Grieves weren’t faring any better.

Another storm of destructive energy rose, Vritra’s body was riddled with large holes and critical injuries by the mere impact, but just as he was about to activate the fourth dimension, the pope pressed a glyph against his body.
Vritra was unable to move into the disappearing state as the storm of destructive energy swallowed them both. Many of the other Grieves were also caught in the storm.
Their bodies were badly beaten but it was still not enough to make them completely vanish.

Yasmine froze when she saw Vritra being swallowed by the energy storm. Without a second thought she let out a thundering roar and rushed into the storm while the new shadow wraith prevented the Grieves from attacking her.
ROOOAAAAAAAAARRRRRRRRRR!!
WHOOOSSSSSSHHHHHHHHHH
She endured the extreme pain as her body was being destroyed by the violent mix of energies.
It was really difficult to locate Vritra in such a chaotic storm but because of their connection, Yasmine saw Vritra being reverted back to his original form as his body got severely injured.
Plunging forward, Yasmine got a hold of Vritra as she decreased her size slightly and wrapped herself around him, using all her strength to pull him out of the utter destruction.
Under the constant attacks, her body became even fainter as her soul’s vitality reduced to less than ten percent.
But Yasmine had succeeded in bringing him out of the raging storm that was yet to stop. She rushed towards Bob and gently lay him on top of the large metallic ball.
She looked at him gently, her heart aching more for the pain he was going through rather than her own injuries.
Vritra’s injuries had started to heal, although slowly, but on the other hand, Yasmine’s injuries were getting worse since she got struck with both the Demon lord’s energy and Evil-Veyll God Essence.
"It seems I haa... can’t fight along with you anymore. I am sorry, hubby..." Yasmine muttered before she fell unconscious and returned to Vritra’s body.
The soul wraith was quickly destroyed by the combined effort of the ten Stars, and soon the energy storm came to an end.
Even the few dozens of the Grieves that were caught in the storm began healing, though for them the process of healing was extremely slow.
All the Grieves gazed at the seemingly unconscious Vritra. They wanted to kill him so badly but seeing his current state they were afraid that a light tap might be enough to kill him.
But because of the pope’s order they couldn’t kill him. Despite their anger, all the Grieves agreed that this strange creature was far from ordinary.
They had heard about Vritra and the fact that he had been in this world for such a short period of time yet possessed such a level of strength was already terrifying.
If they could really uncover a few of his secrets and use that to create even more powerful glyphs, then that would truly be a great evolution.
Then their gazes shifted towards the pope who had just come out of the storm. More than half of his body was destroyed.
It was such an ugly sight, half of his body was still that of a human while the other half was greyish, while his organs were barely hanging on.
The destructive energy clung to his body and continued to destroy it. A twisted smile appeared over the pope’s face as he gazed at his future test subject.
He was thoroughly satisfied and felt that Vritra’s importance wasn’t any less significant than the Phoenix inheritance.
Kssshhhhh...
He ripped away the remaining human part from his body and finally appeared in his true form, the strength of the pope instantly rising by a lot.
"Splendid!! You really are great, Vritra. Now, why don’t you wait a little there while we head inside?" As the pope spoke, those invisible threads wrapped around Vritra’s body once again.

Vritra was barely conscious, his vision was blurry and his blood seemed to have gotten into his eyes too. All four of his limbs and torso were in critical condition as his health declined to a very low level.
Soon several messages flashed before his eyes but he could barely take notice of them.
[You have killed a Level 2716 Human.]
[+EXP Earned.]
[+EXP Earned.]

Vritra sensed Yasmine’s current condition and watched as the Grieves rushed into the inheritance ground, passing through the door without any sort of restriction. His mind was buzzing so badly that he could barely make sense of his surroundings.
BANNGGGG

At this moment it was as if everyone in the world had disappeared, Vritra’s eyes were fixed only on the attack that was heading towards his wife.
How could he let his Yasmine get hurt...
[Switch: Demonification (4%)]
[Shift Activated.]
[Shift: Strength + Endurance → Agility]

A vast amount of Chaotic energy burst out of his body, as Vritra even pulled out every last bit of energy from the Evil-Veyll God Essence Core and combined it with any and every sort of energy present in his body.
BOOOOM BOOOOOM

Even his dragon body couldn’t handle that level of power, as several explosions happened inside his body making his scales and flesh burst, but Vritra just used the momentum to increase his speed to the extreme.
When the pope’s fist was about to touch Yasmine’s back, Vritra collided with him as he let out all that devastating energy, much more chaotic than his first attack on the pope.
"Hah, as expected, so she is indeed your weakness." A wide grin spread across the pope’s wrinkled face, at the last moment he changed his target from Yasmine to Vritra as the two collided.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!
Just by the aftershock of the colliding force, Yasmine was thrown away and even Bob was pushed, but thankfully it had the door as support, while most of the other Grieves weren’t faring any better.

Another storm of destructive energy rose, Vritra’s body was riddled with large holes and critical injuries by the mere impact, but just as he was about to activate the fourth dimension, the pope pressed a glyph against his body.
Vritra was unable to move into the disappearing state as the storm of destructive energy swallowed them both.
Many of the other Grieves were also caught in the storm.
Their bodies were badly beaten but it was still not enough to make them completely vanish.
Yasmine froze when she saw Vritra being swallowed by the energy storm.
Without a second thought she let out a thundering roar and rushed into the storm while the new shadow wraith prevented the Grieves from attacking her.
ROOOAAAAAAAAARRRRRRRRRR!!
WHOOOSSSSSSHHHHHHHHHH
She endured the extreme pain as her body was being destroyed by the violent mix of energies.
It was really difficult to locate Vritra in such a chaotic storm but because of their connection, Yasmine saw Vritra being reverted back to his original form as his body got severely injured.
Plunging forward, Yasmine got a hold of Vritra as she decreased her size slightly and wrapped herself around him, using all her strength to pull him out of the utter destruction.
Under the constant attacks, her body became even fainter as her soul’s vitality reduced to less than ten percent.
But Yasmine had succeeded in bringing him out of the raging storm that was yet to stop.
She rushed towards Bob and gently lay him on top of the large metallic ball.
She looked at him gently, her heart aching more for the pain he was going through rather than her own injuries.
Vritra’s injuries had started to heal, although slowly, but on the other hand, Yasmine’s injuries were getting worse since she got struck with both the Demon lord’s energy and Evil-Veyll God Essence.
"It seems I haa... can’t fight along with you anymore.
I am sorry, hubby..." Yasmine muttered before she fell unconscious and returned to Vritra’s body.
The soul wraith was quickly destroyed by the combined effort of the ten Stars, and soon the energy storm came to an end.
Even the few dozens of the Grieves that were caught in the storm began healing, though for them the process of healing was extremely slow.
All the Grieves gazed at the seemingly unconscious Vritra.
They wanted to kill him so badly but seeing his current state they were afraid that a light tap might be enough to kill him.
But because of the pope’s order they couldn’t kill him.
Despite their anger, all the Grieves agreed that this strange creature was far from ordinary.
They had heard about Vritra and the fact that he had been in this world for such a short period of time yet possessed such a level of strength was already terrifying.
If they could really uncover a few of his secrets and use that to create even more powerful glyphs, then that would truly be a great evolution.
Then their gazes shifted towards the pope who had just come out of the storm.
More than half of his body was destroyed.
It was such an ugly sight, half of his body was still that of a human while the other half was greyish, while his organs were barely hanging on.
The destructive energy clung to his body and continued to destroy it.
A twisted smile appeared over the pope’s face as he gazed at his future test subject.
He was thoroughly satisfied and felt that Vritra’s importance wasn’t any less significant than the Phoenix inheritance.
Kssshhhhh...
He ripped away the remaining human part from his body and finally appeared in his true form, the strength of the pope instantly rising by a lot.
"Splendid!!
You really are great, Vritra.
Now, why don’t you wait a little there while we head inside?" As the pope spoke, those invisible threads wrapped around Vritra’s body once again.
Vritra was barely conscious, his vision was blurry and his blood seemed to have gotten into his eyes too.
All four of his limbs and torso were in critical condition as his health declined to a very low level.
Soon several messages flashed before his eyes but he could barely take notice of them.
[You have killed a Level 2716 Human.]
[+EXP Earned.]
[+EXP Earned.]
Vritra sensed Yasmine’s current condition and watched as the Grieves rushed into the inheritance ground, passing through the door without any sort of restriction.
His mind was buzzing so badly that he could barely make sense of his surroundings.
BANNGGGG

chapters.title: Chapter 241: Doomed
paragraphs: BANNGGGG
With a single punch, the Pope destroyed Bob while Vritra’s body remained frozen in the air. The path to the inheritance was finally clear.

Almost all of the Grieves entered the inheritance ground while a few remained outside to keep an eye on Vritra, though it was now almost impossible for him to get out of the restraints even with the fourth dimension.

"Tch. We finally got him under control, I can’t believe he was able to struggle for so long against all of us despite not even being 2nd Legion rank. He will certainly turn into really dangerous Glyphs." One of the few Grieves muttered as they gazed down at Vritra.
"Should we just kill this bastard and say he died on his own?" one of them suggested, looking at Vritra with hate.

"Haa, I wish we could do that but he is pretty much dead now. Making him go through all those experiments would be a lot more cruel than a simple death right now." Another replied, as they floated close to him.
’No... F- Fiona... Yasmine...’ Vritra could barely think straight, his consciousness was on the verge of collapsing and his health was extremely low.
Suddenly, his pupils started to turn white and Elegy Parasite was about to take control of his body, but Vritra forcefully took control of his mind as he gasped for breath, keeping himself awake.
The Elegy Parasite’s sole motivation and motive was to stay alive, and for that, it could go to any length.
Right now, it might just choose to escape, leaving Fiona behind. So, Vritra couldn’t give control of his body to that thing.
Gritting his teeth, he resorted to the last option.
[Null Activated.]

In the next instant, Vritra was pulled into a strange space. A stream of time was flowing on one side while on the other side countless veins pulsed and continued for eternity. He wasn’t sure what this place exactly was or how he could control Null, but right now this was his only bet.
If something went wrong, then he might really lose everything.

His head started hurting so bad as if he was being electrocuted constantly by very high-voltage electricity. His existence itself seemed to be on the verge of collapsing as he found his consciousness fading away slowly.
Feeling desperate, Vritra just did anything he could.
[Nether Eye Activated.]

The next moment, a third eye opened on his forehead. Vritra’s complete focus was on the stream. As the all-seeing eye opened, his mind was filled with countless images which almost made his head explode.
But he soon discarded it all, and the Nether Eye brought his mind to a particular point of the stream as a vision of himself fighting against the Grieves appeared.
[Forbid: Flow]
[Forbidden Activated.]
All of a sudden, the flow of the stream slowed down. Time itself started to move slowly over the entire universe and further.
But the relative time of everything had slowed down so not many were able to notice anything. Almost all the beings continued normally, while a very few noticed the anomaly.
Yennefer was one of them.

The stream seemed to be struggling as Vritra’s mental strength was drained extremely fast and tiny drops of the substance that made up the entire stream splattered around, which seemed to be creating a lot of space and time rifts across the universes.
[Suck! Suck! Suck! Activated.]
This was the last straw as the stream finally erupted in a chaotic onslaught. A vast amount of this strange energy or substance rushed towards Vritra and entered his body.
This thing was enough to make him explode hundreds of thousands of times, but before he could actually explode, almost the entire energy was sucked away to keep Forbidden activated.

A strange cycle was thus automatically created. The stream was in complete chaos while the veins on the sides twisted and intertwined and seemed to be on the verge of collapsing, but kept resisting the sudden changes.
The endless amount of the strange form of energy from the stream continued to flow out, while its speed was slowed down to some extent with the Forbidden.
[Fourth Dimension Activated.]
Vritra’s body disappeared from existence in that dark space. It was like he never existed there, but the abnormal cycle continued without any changes.
[Mutamorphis Activated!!]
[Analysing the surrounding environment.]
[Analysis complete, extreme danger detected.]
[Searching for the best possible solution.]
[Search complete!!]
[You have obtained the Space-Time Barrier!!]
Finally, this was the last step as Vritra truly became a separate entity, and the flow of the stream or the changes occurring stopped having any effect on him.
Not only had everything slowed down, but lots of space-time rifts were opening randomly across the universe, while Vritra had become a separate existence who observed everything as an outsider.
With all his skills activated and the Space-Time Barrier, his body soon started to heal back and even his mind was reverted back to his peak form.
Finally, as all the pain disappeared, Vritra’s mind cleared up and he was shocked to see the mess he had created. He couldn’t understand what exactly was going on or how he could stop it.
When he felt hopeless, he just randomly activated all his skills, but he seemed to have triggered something that he couldn’t really control.
Just then, Vritra closed his eyes and completely focused his senses on the vision of the Nether Eye.
In the stream of time, he saw the moment where Yasmine had just pulled him out of the destructive storm. But despite finding it, he didn’t know what he should do.
He wondered if he just deactivated his skills, everything would go back to normal.

Yet just returning like that wasn’t what he wanted. Gritting his teeth, he decided to try a rather dangerous idea. He wasn’t sure if it would work or not, and honestly, there wasn’t much chance either.
Vritra wanted to control the flow of the stream of that particular part.

He made a part of himself visible while keeping the fourth dimension activated, and then used Suck! Suck! Suck! and focused on the stream as he tried to slightly change its flow in that particular part.

A big change happened across the small forest. Time actually began to flow back. All the demons, humans, and other creatures present in the small forest, and even the wraiths, felt as if they were watching everything play in reverse.
They were aware of the changes as their bodies moved back and soon all of them were at the same position they had been a few minutes prior.
Even Yasmine appeared outside as all her injuries disappeared. She looked around in confusion just like the Grieves, who seemed even more baffled.
Just moments ago, they had entered into the inheritance, but they were suddenly pulled back. It didn’t make any sense.
While Vritra was in his disappearing state, for him all of them seemed very slow — which was most probably because of the Forbidden that was affecting the Flow of the stream itself.
The time difference seemed to be a bit more than 4.5 times slower, but it was the case only while Vritra was in his disappearing state.
