chapters.title: Chapter 242: Battle Reversal
paragraphs: Finally, when they all had appeared in their original position just before the Pope had launched the attack on Vritra, he finally stopped moving the stream flow backwards.
But strangely, the Pope had appeared in his true form, though he was still a human before attacking Vritra. Maybe since he had already received the experience points, this thing wasn’t reverted.
Vritra wasn’t sure how this was all working out, but it was a golden rule even among programmers — if it works, do not touch it.
Vritra kept all his skills activated. For now, the only biggest change was the deceleration of time, but that was only for Vritra, while for everyone else it seemed perfectly normal.
Even the beings who were strong enough to sense the changes, like the Gods, Demon Gods, and others, couldn’t really tamper with the time. But they understood that the Cursed ability had returned.
Either the Scarlet couple was back, or they had passed that ability to someone even more crazy.

Vritra kept most of his body in the disappearing state and only brought out his hands. To him, it all felt like something far from reality. He didn’t know if it was a dream or something else, but he was going to take advantage of this unique change.

The Star affected by the Blood Lock suddenly jolted. He had been sensing the weakening of his body earlier, but now the changes were too extreme. With the slowness of time, the skill that received the biggest boost was the Blood Lock.
In less than fifty minutes, it could now kill any being.
Vritra flew towards Yasmine and said just one word:’Return!!’
He was in his human-like form right now, two horns above his head and the face of Jin Woo.
She couldn’t understand anything — after all, she should still be injured and unconscious — but she didn’t waste a moment and returned to Vritra’s body.
"W-What is happening?" the Pope and all the Grieves exclaimed. It was almost like they had just seen a part of the future. More than three hundred Grieves were completely baffled by the changes.

"D-Didn’t we just enter the inheritance? And that strange demon was just injured by—wait, where did he go?" one of the Grieves exclaimed, and all of them remembered that there was something even more serious than wondering about this confusing event.
Even the Pope couldn’t sense his presence at this moment. It was as if he had really disappeared from existence — or never really existed.

"Cough... Cough... W-What is happening to me?" one of the Stars exclaimed in shock as he coughed and felt weak. His health, healing, battle prowess — everything had reduced by more than fifty percent.
Two percent of his health was going down every minute, and he didn’t know how to stop it. The Pope frowned as he flashed beside the weakened Star and observed his condition carefully.

"This must be Vritra’s ability... Hmm, I think he used it on you when he took your blood." The Pope quickly analyzed. After sensing the situation of his follower, he felt confused about how to deactivate it.
But seeing the Star whose body was slowly turning dark, he frowned and began to create a Glyph to stop the effect of Blood Lock somehow.

Vritra used this chance to restore himself to his peak condition. Right now, he couldn’t use most of his skills since they were already activated, but his energy cores had soon returned to their peak.
Summoning Bob and the human Soul Wraith back, Vritra stationed them in front of the inheritance door and then rushed in the direction of the Pope.

Almost all of the Grieves were still frozen from the shock. There had never been anyone who could control time or have it as their Field, but what they experienced just now couldn’t be explained any other way.
The Pope had put all his concentration on the creation of the curing Glyph. All these greyish creatures shared a strong bond, and they wouldn’t let anyone from their group die.
It was like an unsolvable puzzle. The Pope couldn’t understand what sort of skill this was — the deeper he delved, the more complicated it became.
WHOOSH
BANG

At an even faster speed, Vritra appeared behind the Pope and, using all of his strength, delivered a kick on his back. Caught off guard, the Pope wasn’t able to defend himself as the Glyph he was working on shattered, and he was thrown away like a meteor.

Right now, Vritra could only use the Shift skill, but along with the time dilation he was not slower than even the Pope. Not to mention, he could see into the stream of time with the Nether Eye and glimpse a few seconds ahead into the future.
"WHAT HAVE YOU DONE TO ME?!!" the weakened Star roared as he rushed towards Vritra, whose body was in a disappearing state and only his hands were visible.
Partial Dragon Form.
[Switch: Demonification (2%)]

Vritra pumped all his energy into destructive raw strength. He clashed with the Star head-on as their fists collided, and Vritra only felt slight tremors run through his arm while the Star was blasted away, his hand exploding violently.
’It is working!!’ Vritra finally saw hope of defeating them all, though there could still be unknown variables but it seemed a bit doable now.
To him, all of the Grieves seemed as if they were moving in slow motion — especially with the Shift: Agility activated. Plus, the future vision made it easy for him to evade all sorts of attacks.

After he blasted away the Pope and weakened Star, the others finally came to their senses and understood that they first needed to neutralize this threat. All of them pounced at Vritra while launching countless attacks.

Since he couldn’t useSuck! Suck! Suck! right now, Vritra was unable to disrupt their energy flow. This seemingly strange-sounding skill was really too OP; with the passage of time, it seemed more and more useful — it could even affect the stream of time.
"Let’s trap him! Damnit, are we still not allowed to kill him?" one of the Grieves muttered in rage after seeing the Pope and the weak Star.
"Yes. Fuck, we have to capture him alive," another Star said through gritted teeth. They couldn’t go against the Pope’s orders.

They also had the option to take possession of his body, but in that case, his consciousness would be erased — and that was exactly what they wished to avoid. That was also why they weren’t just using his corpse for the experiments.
In the next moment, all sorts of attacks were launched towards Vritra. Most were aimed to injure him, while the remaining were for capturing him.
It was almost as if he was teleporting between the space, flashing away just before getting struck or caught. Almost as if he had entered Ultra Instinct.
Vritra saw countless possibilities every moment. Each step he took would lead to a different future. He had to make the decision immediately as he avoided all the attacks.
The whole process was tiring and tough — but manageable.
The Pope rushed out of the crater that he had just created on the ground. He was full of rage upon seeing the worsening condition of the Star.

He was full of rage upon seeing the worsening condition of the Star.

chapters.title: Chapter 243: Hunting
paragraphs: The health of the weakened Star was deteriorating way too fast now, and the Pope knew he had to do something to stop Vritra.
"How can I counter this skill? It is related to blood so if I remove all the blood from his body will it be stopped? Or do I need to—"
THOOOOM
The Pope was deep in thought when out of nowhere a hard kick connected to his jaw, almost twisting his head backward as he was blasted away.
Vritra had become too slippery and none were able to even see his afterimages. The Pope’s first priority was to save the Star, so he wasn’t attacking Vritra right now.
BOOOOOM
KRRAAASSHHHH
"Aaaaaaaaaah! Where is he? I can’t see him, how did he become so fast all of a sudden?"
"Ughhhhh! I- it is as if he already knows how we are going to attack. Can he see the future or something?"
"What is going on? What sort of trick is this now? Is this some sort of illusion? Has he awakened his true power as the Demon Lord?"

All the Grieves were baffled when they weren’t able to touch Vritra, let alone hurt or capture him, even after several minutes. He was faster, knew what was going to happen, and struck them at just the right moment.
The fight continued to rage on. Just after a little while, the health of the weakened Star had been lowered to less than 10%. He just lay on the ground and seemed to be on the verge of death.

In front of the weak Star, the Pope was standing as he desperately tried to find some way to stop that skill, but every attempt seemed fruitless. He could only watch as the life of one of his Stars was being sucked away.
"H- Huh? Where did he disappear off to suddenly? He was just here right now?"
A feeling of fear was now slowly appearing in the hearts of all the Grieves. They looked all over but couldn’t find him.
The Star was dazedly staring at the sky, hoping that the almighty Pope could save him. With each passing moment, the fear of death grew in his heart.
His heart was sinking, and he just wished that it was some other Grieve who got hit by this cursed skill.

The Pope’s heart was pounding wildly as he exhausted every effort he could to save him, but all of a sudden, two bloodied hands emerged out of the ground and clutched the weak Star’s head. Then, with a painful cry, his head was split in two as greyish blood splattered all over.

His skull was destroyed as Vritra’s fingers pierced through his flesh, turning his eyeballs and brain into minced meat. The Pope was so shocked that he couldn’t understand anything and just stared dazedly at the gruesome scene while the scream died down.
Vritra didn’t stop there. Blue energy rushed out of his hand and traveled into the Star’s body as he continued to rip him apart, tearing his body into two parts.

"Nooooooo!! Get away, you demon!!" the Pope roared in anger as he launched an attack at Vritra’s hands. He just wanted to kill Vritra right away. The Grieves only had loyalty towards one another, and all of them were like one big family.
Before the Pope’s attack could land on Vritra, he dragged the Star’s broken body into the ground as the two disappeared from sight, and soon...
[You have killed a Level 2967 Grieve.]
[+EXP Earned.]
[+EXP Earned.]
The Pope and the other Grieves froze upon sensing the death of one of the Stars. They couldn’t believe that the situation had escalated to this when they were clearly in the winning position.
The shift was too hard; they were suddenly being hunted by the same being they were mocking just moments ago.
’Extract!!’
Before the Grieves could even get over the shock of the death of one of their members, Vritra flashed behind another Star at such a speed that even the Pope failed to notice him.
He used a tiny bit of the Evil-Veyll God Essence to wrap around his fist and struck the Star’s back, piercing through his flesh.
[Blood Lock Activated.]
[Target Locked. Time Until Death: 43 minutes 45 seconds.]
"Ah- No, no! I don’t want to die!!" the Star was terrified; he understood immediately what Vritra had just done.
"Kill him! Don’t hold back!!" the Pope roared. The lives of the Grieves were more important than any experiment. Along with everyone, he too charged at Vritra.
Vritra made the new Grieve Soul Wraith devour the human Soul Wraith as its level rose. Instead of adding it to the fight, Vritra just made it guard the entrance of the inheritance for now.
This new Grieve Soul Wraith would soon be devouring a lot more of its brethren.
[Switch: Demonification (3%)]

Bringing his speed to the extreme, Vritra moved across the space inside the barrier as he dodged all sorts of attacks just at the right moment, and he would even have the time to launch counterattacks despite fighting so many deadly creatures at once.

Yasmine, who was observing everything silently, was just as baffled as the Grieves. She wondered what had changed in the time she was not awake, though she had a feeling this was somehow related to the Scarlet Couple inheritance—the Null.
Zrrrrrrrrrrr...
BAAANNNNNGGGGGGGGG
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOM
Countless attacks were being launched at Vritra with each passing moment—physical, elemental, energy, and much more—but they couldn’t even touch his skin.
"Fuck!! Take possession of him," the Pope ordered while desperately rushing behind Vritra. Even with his high speed, he just couldn’t get close to that demon.

One of the Stars rushed forward, and after locking onto Vritra’s position, he initiated the process of taking possession of his body. The Star’s body transformed into a grey fog as it flew towards Vritra.

And no matter what Vritra tried, it was just impossible to avoid this, so he could only let the grey fog rush into his head. The Star attacked his consciousness in the next moment, as intense pain coursed through his body.
Vritra used the remaining energy from the Evil-Veyll God Essence and sent it swirling towards the new presence in his body that was trying to destroy his soul and mind.
Vritra gritted his teeth and endured the pain of the purple energy rampaging in his body, and finally, the Star got swallowed by this energy. It instantly caused heavy injuries in his body.

Feeling fear for his life, the Star had no choice but to rush back out of his body. As the grey figure materialised in front of Vritra, everyone saw the failed attempt at taking possession, and it shocked them greatly.

Such a thing could only happen if they tried to take possession of someone who was too strong or had some way to resist it. But Vritra was truly an anomaly; he injured his own body just to throw out the Grieve.
Before the Star could come back to his senses, a hand pierced through the back of his head as the fingers came out of his face, making even his eyeballs pop out.
The Star’s mouth was opened wide, even unable to let out a scream.

chapters.title: Chapter 244: RUNNNNNNNNN!!
paragraphs: Twisting his arm, Vritra grasped his brain tightly and pulled his hand back. As a brain unlike the human brain wriggled over his palm, he squeezed it while the body of the Star began to fall down. Vritra disappeared.
This wasn’t his first target. Even though this Grieve was badly injured, it was nowhere near enough to kill him. Vritra looked at the Star who was getting weaker under the effect of the Blood Lock.

Just after twenty or so minutes, his health and strength had gone down by more than forty percent. When they got too weak, killing them became a lot easier with the method of brute force that Yasmine always used against them.
All the Grieves were enraged, especially after the death of one of the Stars. They were mindlessly chasing after Vritra and attacking him — even the Pope had gone mad.

It wasn’t long before the health of the locked Star was down to less than seventy percent, and Vritra finally struck. Many of the Grieves were trying to help him by creating a glyph to fight the strange curse, but nothing was working.
"STOP HIM!! Don’t let him kill the 2nd Star—"
As Vritra appeared in front of the weak Star, the people were horrified and understood his plan. But before they could react, Vritra dragged him into the ground as well.
His dust ability was also shaping up into a deadly skill; he could already use it in so many ways. And after the next upgrade, it would become an S-ranked skill, truly deadly.
"Aaaaaaaaah S-Save meeee ughhhh Popeeeee—" the Grieve screamed before he became silent forever.
[You have killed a Level 2970 Grieve.]
[+EXP Earned.]
[+EXP Earned.]
’Extract!!’
Upon the death of the second Star, the Pope was finally jerked to his senses. He understood that even if Vritra was overall weaker than him, in his current state it was almost impossible to hurt him.
He looked around — Yasmine wasn’t there, so he couldn’t use her to hurt Vritra. The metallic ball and the greyish-black Soul Wraith that was just about to devour another Grieve couldn’t be killed.
So there was only one way: use Vritra’s weakness, and that was by trying to enter the inheritance. He would certainly try to stop them, and it would finally limit his agility.
"Stop attacking him and enter the inheritance." The Pope roared as he turned and rushed towards Bob and the greyish Soul Wraith.
All the Grieves stopped attacking and looked at their leader in confusion. After a moment, they understood what he wanted to do. They ignored Vritra and rushed towards the large fiery door.
’Shit, there are still too many of them.’ Vritra cursed through his teeth as he appeared in front of the door. This was such a huge disadvantage for him.
BAANNNGGGGG!!
Finally, an attack from one of the Grieves landed on his hand, almost ripping it apart as Vritra went on full defensive mode.
Once again, the battle had shifted and Vritra was barely holding on. Even with all the advantages, his overall combat power was still lacking compared to all these people.
"Keep attacking him."

Vritra and the Soul Wraith fought together, barely defending themselves as the injuries on their bodies continued to accumulate. If things continued like this, it wouldn’t be long before the Grieves claimed their victory once again.
The Pope crushed a glyph in his hand as a large hole blasted in Vritra’s shoulder. Even his skills were becoming unstable as he struggled to hold on.

’I am already at my limit and have nothing else to turn the tide. Fiona needs more time; it hasn’t even been half a day. What can I do now?’ Vritra thought. He couldn’t control Null yet, so slowing time was already far beyond his limit.
He didn’t even have the time to reactivate the Blood Lock.
With the passage of each minute, the injuries on Vritra’s body became more severe, and it wasn’t long before the Soul Wraith was defeated. As it disappeared, Vritra had to face them all once again.

With the help of glyphs, even the weakest Grieves could launch attacks of power much higher than their level. It was such a strange scene — more than three hundred of the Grieves attacked just one person, who could not even move away from the door.
More than half of Vritra’s body was now visible, and the injuries were extremely severe. Even his high healing wasn’t having much of an effect; his health was already down to less than fifty.

Vritra was panting heavily as he defended against hundreds and thousands of attacks, not giving way to let any of them take a step closer to the door — protecting his Fiona with every bit of his strength.
"His health is already down by more than sixty percent, just continue for a bit longer—"
FSSSSSSSSHHHHH...
CRAAACCCCCKKKKKKKKKKK!
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!
All of a sudden, a dark shadow flashed into the small forest as it rushed forward at lightning speed. Cracking the barrier, it lunged inside and blasted the Pope away.
The atmosphere inside the barrier, which had already healed, suddenly became darker. An eerie pressure spread throughout as all the Grieves grew cautious.
In front of Vritra hovered the Dark Knight, holding a giant sword protectively.
CRAAACCCCCKKKKKKKKKKK!

Another sound of the barrier breaking echoed, and Hellmancer entered the barrier, its aura no less strong than the Dark Knight’s. The Hellmancer brought along such a strong pressure that a couple dozen of the Grieves were pushed down to the ground as they struggled to stay on their feet.
Floating while holding a big magic staff in its hand, the Hellmancer — Great Sorcerer — made his appearance!!

"Knight, Hell, you two are finally back!" Vritra exclaimed as he finally got a chance to take a breath. Those wretched Grieves had been bombarding him with such deadly attacks for over thirty minutes.

"Master, forgive us for being late." The Hellmancer and the Dark Knight turned and respectfully bowed towards Vritra. Their strength had truly soared. Both of them were much stronger than even the newly created Soul Wraith.
Vritra tried to use appraisal on them but failed to see their level, so he asked the expert.
"Wifey, what do you think their levels are?"
"At the 4th Legion rank!!" Yasmine exclaimed, shocked at their growth.

The rate of growth of the Soul Wraiths was much faster than any other creature in existence, and now they had gotten their hands on the broken core of the Demon Lord, where wisps of his soul were still lingering.
Their levels were much higher than what she had originally expected, but it was a great thing.
If Chimera was still alive, their level wouldn’t have been so high.
"Fourth Legion?!!" Vritra was equally baffled. These two monsters... both of them had far surpassed his expectations, they were certainly his strongest soldiers now.
The Pope was shocked to see these new entries. He could sense that their overall strength was much higher than Vritra’s, and even his own strength could not really be compared to one of them.
The Pope was still at the 3rd Legion rank, even though quite close to reaching the peak. Sensing the dreadful pressure, there was only one thing that came to his mind.
"RUNNNNNNNNNNN!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 245: Dark Hell
paragraphs: The frozen Grieves came back to their senses as they trembled in dread before scattering around in all directions, abandoning the inheritance they struggled to keep just for their life.
"Hah, after bullying me all this time, now you wish to escape? Not happening." Vritra mumbled before looking at the Hellmancer and ordering: "Hell, trap them all here."
"Yes, master."
TUK
Hellmancer rose high into the sky. Raising the staff slightly, he tapped the bottom against the air, creating a light sound as a blinding light flew in all directions.

The space itself twisted as light swallowed the entire space, even the barrier included. It was like this part of the small forest had been transformed into a separate piece of space, and it lost all connection to the outside.
BANNGGGG
BANNGGGG
BANNGGG
All the Grieves collided against the invisible barrier that separated the spaces. They desperately tried to break it, but nothing was working.
They took out various types of glyphs, such as ones to create powerful explosions, to break the space, to teleport, but everything was useless in Hellmancer’s territory.
He was like the god in this part, and with a snap of his fingers, all the Grieves suddenly appeared exactly in front of him, even the Pope.

"Hello there, what’s the hurry to leave? Since you have come to our door, give us the opportunity to show our hospitality." Vritra said, pointing towards the large fiery door, then he added: "Knight, Hell, don’t leave a single one alive."
"Understood, master!!" In the very next instant both of them disappeared from their positions, their speed was so fast that even Vritra could barely follow it with his eyes despite the time delay.

While the two cuties were busy cleaning these Grieves, Vritra decided to join in on the fun. He called back the Grieve soul wraith and made it stand beside Bob before rushing forward as he started slaughtering the Grieves.

Even though the Dark Knight and Hellmancer were clearly overpowering the Grieves, killing these cockroaches was extremely time-consuming. They wouldn’t die even if their bodies were completely destroyed.

But with the death of each Grieve, the strength of the two of them continued to increase. Vritra allowed them to devour all the Grieves they were killing. It was such a free killing zone—kill and steal, take as much as you want.

He even fed a few to Bob and the greyish soul wraith, while killing one Grieve after another. It was still taking dozens of minutes to kill just a single Grieve, and even though the result was already obvious, it was going to take quite a lot of time.
The Dark Knight started fighting against the Pope, soon bringing him to his knees.
Despite her effort to be as fast as possible, Fiona had been inside the inheritance for more than three days already. Even with Ghoul’s constant help, there was just no end to this inheritance.
All sorts of creatures kept popping in front of them, and if Ghoul wasn’t with her, Fiona doubted she could have reached even a quarter of the distance she had covered in three days.
"Huff... W-What’s happening outside? Is Darling safe?" Fiona asked. She was feeling a stabbing pain in her heart, thinking how her man would be facing all those Grieves.

If she could get out of the inheritance, then he wouldn’t need to stay there any longer and they could just flee together. But she had become a hindrance for him; she knew Vritra wouldn’t let anyone enter through that door as long as he was standing.
And this would be his greatest disadvantage, on top of the fact that all the Grieves were a lot stronger than him.
"This damned inheritance, why isn’t it ending?" Fiona was anxious and afraid the more time she spent in this place. Turning back now wasn’t an option as well, but the ending just won’t appear.
"Ghoul, what is happening outside?" she asked with agitation in her heart. Her fists were clenched, and she was nervously chewing on her lip to the point of hurting herself.
"..." Ghoul remained silent for a while, and then he shook his head, replying: "I don’t know, but master is still alive."

"Those darned Grieves, so they had been searching for this inheritance all this time... sigh, it would have been better if I didn’t enter, then Darling wouldn’t have needed to fight against them all." Fiona continued to hurry.
Fighting various sorts of creatures along with Ghoul, and finally she saw a door. It looked a lot more majestic than the one outside, a large phoenix was present on top of it.

"Haa, I hope this is the final door, I can’t waste any more time in here." Fiona said and rushed into the large door. There was some sort of barrier at the entrance, and now even Ghoul, who had weakened slightly after fighting for three days, wasn’t able to pass through it.
"Go ahead, I will wait here." Ghoul said as he stopped right outside the door. Fiona looked back and nodded before disappearing into the flames.
Just as she had expected, this was actually the final room of the Phoenix inheritance. After passing through all the hurdles, she was finally qualified to receive the inheritance.
Fiona looked around at the large and grand hall. It was as if it was pulled right out of a great castle made of material more precious than gold and diamonds.
Fiona looked around and soon her gaze landed on a large throne. Her body moved on its own as she approached the seat and sat on it.
In the very next moment, red aura flooded out of the throne and swallowed her body, as the process of receiving the inheritance started.
A red feather swayed in the air as it fell down from somewhere and landed exactly on top of Fiona’s head.
Without Ghoul’s help, this whole process would have been so difficult and would have taken several times more time.
After several hours had passed, the process of receiving the inheritance was finally complete. Fiona’s hair looked even more vibrant, her cheeks rosy and her skin tender and milky.
There wasn’t a drastic change in her appearance, but she looked more beautiful than before.
Even her stats had increased by quite a lot. This was indeed a great inheritance left here by the first Phoenix.
Not only had Fiona obtained the bloodline and physique of the Phoenix Queen, but she had also obtained a great ability, an ability that could allow her to fight opponents much stronger than her.

It was with the help of the first Phoenix Queen’s energy that was stored in her body. It was a little similar to the Demon Lord’s core stored in Vritra’s body, but its energy was less in quantity, and it wouldn’t hurt her.

"Haa... It has been almost four days inside this inheritance, I have to go out." The sinking feeling in Fiona’s heart was palpable. She was feeling afraid that Vritra might have gotten hurt because of her—or worse...
Throwing all those thoughts aside, she rushed out of the majestic door and saw Ghoul waiting there.
Even though Fiona was perfectly fine, her face looked a little pale and she was feeling cold. Her body was shivering slightly at the anticipation of the condition outside.

sentences.text: The frozen Grieves came back to their senses as they trembled in dread before scattering around in all directions, abandoning the inheritance they struggled to keep just for their life.
"Hah, after bullying me all this time, now you wish to escape?
Not happening." Vritra mumbled before looking at the Hellmancer and ordering: "Hell, trap them all here."
"Yes, master."
TUK
Hellmancer rose high into the sky.
Raising the staff slightly, he tapped the bottom against the air, creating a light sound as a blinding light flew in all directions.
The space itself twisted as light swallowed the entire space, even the barrier included.
It was like this part of the small forest had been transformed into a separate piece of space, and it lost all connection to the outside.
BANNGGGG
BANNGGGG
BANNGGG
All the Grieves collided against the invisible barrier that separated the spaces.
They desperately tried to break it, but nothing was working.
They took out various types of glyphs, such as ones to create powerful explosions, to break the space, to teleport, but everything was useless in Hellmancer’s territory.

"Hello there, what’s the hurry to leave?

He called back the Grieve soul wraith and made it stand beside Bob before rushing forward as he started slaughtering the Grieves.
Even though the Dark Knight and Hellmancer were clearly overpowering the Grieves, killing these cockroaches was extremely time-consuming.
They wouldn’t die even if their bodies were completely destroyed.
But with the death of each Grieve, the strength of the two of them continued to increase.
Vritra allowed them to devour all the Grieves they were killing.
It was such a free killing zone—kill and steal, take as much as you want.
He even fed a few to Bob and the greyish soul wraith, while killing one Grieve after another.
It was still taking dozens of minutes to kill just a single Grieve, and even though the result was already obvious, it was going to take quite a lot of time.
The Dark Knight started fighting against the Pope, soon bringing him to his knees.

chapters.title: Chapter 246: Unbreakable!! Unshakeable!!
paragraphs: "Let’s go!!" she said, but just as she was about to fly back, the door she had just come out of started glowing, and soon the blurry vision of the outside became slightly visible.
"Oh, is this door leading to the outside?" Fiona wondered. The first Phoenix had left it there so that her successor wouldn’t have to go all the way back to exit.
Ghoul observed the door and nodded. The two didn’t waste a single second as they flew out of the door. Fiona was also able to fly now.
As she came out, the blinding light of the sun hit her sight. Fiona narrowed her gaze and then glanced down, looking at her surroundings, and froze, feeling shivers run through her body.
Everything was in ruins. Trees, the ground—everything was destroyed and now lay in shambles. It was such a disturbing sight.

Wherever her gaze went, Fiona only saw destruction. A sea of blood filled the ground. Red and grey-colored blood was present all over the earth and broken trees, and a few spots were covered in purple blood.
Limbs were lying all over the place—pieces of flesh and shattered bones.
It was like her heart was being clutched in a tight grip. Fiona was on the verge of collapse as her gaze ran all over the place. She could only see destruction.
Fiona could tell through all the rubble just how much Vritra must have suffered to keep everyone away from the door, to keep her safe.

Her eyes became teary and blurry. It felt like something was stuck in her throat as her brain felt like shutting down. But soon she caught sight of someone—the one who had been making her worry to death.

Vritra was sitting on the ground, his back pressed against one of the broken trees. A big pond of blood was forming around him. He was completely drenched in blood, and drops of grey blood were still dripping from his hair.
He was panting lightly. Although no wounds were visible on his body, it was obvious he had been through a very dangerous battle.
Vritra looked up, and as their eyes met, there was a small smile on his lips.
Fiona flew to his side and just threw herself into his arms, not caring if he was dirty with blood or anything else. She wrapped her arms around his body and started crying like a baby.
Just now, she had felt she had lost him. Her heart still felt as if being stabbed by countless needles. The feeling of losing him forever made everything else seem completely pointless.
Fiona had already fallen too deeply for him—to the point she didn’t want to live in a world where he didn’t exist.
Vritra hugged her back, and while gently caressing her head, he spoke: "Ha, my crybaby, don’t cry. Look, everything is fine. You didn’t get hurt inside, did you?"
As he cupped her cheek and pulled her face upwards, Fiona looked so cute with her cheeks puffed and tears in her eyes like a squirrel.
Vritra chuckled lightly and almost kissed her lips, but he stopped himself since he was completely covered in blood right now.

"You... sob... sob... this—sob... sob... what... sob... sob..." Fiona tried to speak, but because of her sobs, she couldn’t even say two words straight. She just hugged him tightly and refused to move at all.

Vritra looked towards the sky and saw the door disappear into pieces. He sighed in relief that he was able to protect his woman—his family—in this dangerous and foreign world. In the end, strength dictates it all.
Right or wrong, it all depends on one’s personal strength. And after this battle, which was full of twists and turns, Vritra’s strength was undoubtedly going to soar.
His level was currently stuck at 1999. Though he had obtained a lot of experience points and already had the empty 2nd legion stone, so he could level up at any time.
Not to mention all his soul wraiths that had grown stronger after this battle.
After shutting all his skills down, the stream of time returned to normal. Though that reckless usage had undoubtedly caused a bit of a problem across the universe.
But at least he had managed to control the skill a little bit. Still, Vritra decided not to use the Null ability like that again—at least not until he was forced into a truly desperate situation.
Hugging the sobbing redhead, Vritra just sat there staring at the sky. He had just passed one of the biggest challenges of his life so far and had barely achieved victory.

At least his luck was better now. In the previous battle against the Bone Blood Cult, the Nine Pacts, and the Demon Generals, the Divine Sin Arrow appeared only after the end. But at least Hellmancer and Dark Knight had appeared just in time.

Vritra allowed Fiona to cry in his arms for a while. Then he pulled her face up and wiped her tears before speaking gently to her: "Let’s go back. We have been away for four days. Mom must be very worried about us."
"Sob... Mmmm..." Fiona nodded. She still couldn’t speak properly, and her throat was hurting. Vritra shook his head at this crybaby and took out some water from his inventory, feeding it to Fiona.

Finally, she felt a bit better and spoke in a hurry: "Darling, a-are you hurt? Sob... Those disgusting Grieves, I am going to kill every single one of them! Sob... I-I can’t live without you. Don’t ever leave me behind, please... sob... I will die if we can’t be together..."
"My lovely Fiona, don’t think of anything useless. Calm down, I am fine, and yes, we will always be together.
So just stop crying. I don’t like tears in my woman’s eyes; it makes me feel I have failed somehow. I just want to see your beautiful smile—hmm, you look gorgeous, my cutie."
Vritra spoke and stood up, gently holding her waist. Then they held one another’s hands and intertwined their fingers as the two flew into the sky at full speed and soon disappeared.
Hellmancer stayed behind to get rid of all the traces.
After this incident, the bond between Vritra and Fiona had become unbreakable. The two’s feelings for one another had far surpassed the level of madness.
It didn’t take long for Vritra and Fiona to arrive back at the castle. They sneaked into Fiona’s room, and first of all, Vritra took a bath.
He had fought for several days continuously, and even with all his regeneration skills, he was still feeling exhausted.
Fiona cleaned herself too after Vritra. He was still a bit hesitant to take the final step with Fiona since he first wanted to tell her all about his relations.
And since Vritra didn’t want to lose her, he was making their relationship extremely solid before telling her about Vanessa and Diana... and even Yasmine, probably.
After the bath, Vritra and Fiona both went to the next door, where Vanessa and Diana were anxiously waiting for the two of them.
"Mom..." Vritra knocked on the door and called out. Then hurried footsteps sounded from inside, and the gate swung open.
Vanessa’s hair was messy, and she appeared as if she hadn’t slept properly for days. The beautiful succubus pulled Fiona and Vritra into a tight hug. Her body felt really tense.

chapters.title: Chapter 247: I am already tamed!!
paragraphs: Vritra lay on the bed, his mother hugging him from the right and Fiona on the left. Both were clinging to him as if he might just disappear at any moment. Fiona was already very shaken by the entire event, and upon knowing everything that had happened in the forest, Vanessa nearly fainted.
The two women wouldn’t separate from him, as they felt comfort in his warmth, claiming different sides of his body as their private property.
Diana sat to the side, glancing at the two and feeling jealous. It seemed like they were really enjoying cuddling. She really wanted to join in, but there was no space left for her.

’Sigh, I never thought him ignoring me could feel like such a punishment. Before, I was afraid of his attention on me, and now I desperately want him to even look at me...’ Diana thought, feeling miserable for herself.

The goddess knew she had to do something—somehow win his trust completely. She had already lost any thought of bringing harm to Vritra a long time ago. She longed for his touch so badly and wanted to continue what they had ended halfway the previous time.

’Haa, how should I go about it? Won’t I appear too desperate? But I am indeed desperate, so it should be fine... YES, let’s do this.’ Diana thought with strong resolution, her intense gaze fixed completely on Vritra.

Feeling her piercing gaze, Vritra knew the goddess was truly reaching her limits now. She had seemed to really look forward to the main event when they had gone into the forest, but Vritra ended the session abruptly, even though she had pretended she was really disappointed.
Compared to before, the goddess had already changed a lot.
For now, he removed her from his mind and focused on the current situation. He couldn’t even move his arms as they were surrounded by softness and warmth.

"Sigh, I wonder how your luck actually works. I can’t understand how you seem to end up at the wrong place at the wrong time and then face all sorts of dangerous entities. It is a miracle that we are still alive." Yasmine said, releasing a long, tired sigh.

’Sorry for making you go through all that, but I am innocent. Yeah, I provoked the Nine Pacts by killing their members since I didn’t like them and needed the Divine Sin Arrow. But Bone Blood Cult, the Demon Generals, and now Grieves—it was completely coincidental.’ Vritra too sighed, wondering which bastard was constantly cursing his luck.
"Anyway, I will soon be giving you a surprise." Yasmine said, her tone turning mischievous.
’What sort of surprise?’ Vritra asked curiously.
"Hehe, do I need to define what the word surprise means? You will have to wait a little longer to know it." She teased, enjoying keeping him in suspense.

’Fine, I will wait.’ Vritra said, rolling his eyes. Then he pondered: ’Since Hell and Knight have finished absorbing all that energy, then the labyrinth must have already collapsed by now. Then those three Demon Generals might really have fallen for my lie. They might have gone to the small forest to wait for me. If this went right, then I would be able to obtain new slaves.’

Then he gazed at his level that was still stuck at 1,999 and decided to use the empty 2nd Legion Stone as soon as possible. The increase in each level after reaching the 2nd Legion rank was even more difficult and needed a large amount of experience points.

And Vritra had just gotten lucky, as he had killed more than six hundred powerful beings—mindless humans and the Grieves—even the Pope, who was at the 3rd Legion rank. So he had accumulated a large amount of experience points.
Currently, his soul wraith inventory had expanded a little: Hellmancer, Dark Knight, Bob, Bobby, Ghoul, Ghost, and Psyche, his new soul wraith that possessed the abilities of the Grieves.
It even had the knowledge about the glyphs.

And right now, except for Bobby, all the soul wraiths were at least of the 2nd Legion rank. Hellmancer and Dark Knight were at the beginning levels of the 4th Legion rank, Bob was in the middle of the 2nd Legion rank, Bobby at the peak of the 1st Legion rank, Ghoul and Ghost both close to the peak of the 2nd Legion rank, and Psyche in the middle levels of the 3rd Legion rank.
It was a bit messy for now, but Vritra was planning to raise the levels of all his soul wraiths.

’Sigh, it’s been so long. When is the Misty Essence Mythic Halo going to come out? There is no point in staying in this kingdom anymore otherwise, as the danger will only increase the longer I stay here.’ Vritra thought as he relaxed between the two women who were sleeping peacefully despite it being afternoon and bright outside.
’I will do all that later. For now, I just need a good long rest.’ Vritra yawned and felt his eyelids becoming heavy. He glanced at Diana and spoke: "Why don’t you rest as well?"
"O-Oh, can I?" the goddess stood up with hope in her eyes. She wouldn’t have minded sleeping on top of him, resting her head over his chest, and enjoying embracing him.
"Yeah, go back to your room and rest all you want." Vritra barely stopped himself from laughing when her expression shifted from eager to utter disappointment. She made it so obvious.
’Don’t tell me... did he lose all interest in me already?’ the goddess felt depressed as she walked out of the room in a daze. She glanced back at the three one last time before closing the door.
Then she headed back to her room in misery.
"Hahaha, it is hard to believe it is the same goddess from some time ago. You have really trained her well." Yasmine laughed. The goddess was becoming cuter by the day.
’I am practicing. After all, I need to tame my Dragon Queen in the future.’ Vritra replied, keeping his eyes open with a little difficulty.
"What do you mean tame? I am already yours. I would just love whatever you do to me..."
While talking to her, Vritra soon fell asleep, and Yasmine decided to rest too.
When out of nowhere all the members of the temple disappeared—even the Pope—the four men from the Golden Moon became even more confident in their belief that they truly might be possessed by Grieves.

They started searching all over the place for them for several days, even inside the small forest, but found absolutely nothing. It was as if the earth had swallowed them all. Not even the traces of the fight were found—all thanks to Hellmancer.

After a long rest, Vritra woke up when it had started to turn dark. The other women were already awake and waiting for him to eat dinner together. After washing his face to throw all sleepiness away, Vritra left his room.
Soon he sat along with the three women and ate dinner. Finally, the peaceful and wholesome family time had returned, and Vritra always enjoyed it as long as it lasted.
After dinner, the women took a walk around the castle along with him and then went back to their rooms, while Vritra decided to pay the King a visit... a friendly one.

He couldn’t even move his arms as they were surrounded by softness and warmth.
"Sigh, I wonder how your luck actually works.
I can’t understand how you seem to end up at the wrong place at the wrong time and then face all sorts of dangerous entities.
It is a miracle that we are still alive." Yasmine said, releasing a long, tired sigh.
’Sorry for making you go through all that, but I am innocent.
Yeah, I provoked the Nine Pacts by killing their members since I didn’t like them and needed the Divine Sin Arrow.
But Bone Blood Cult, the Demon Generals, and now Grieves—it was completely coincidental.’ Vritra too sighed, wondering which bastard was constantly cursing his luck.
"Anyway, I will soon be giving you a surprise." Yasmine said, her tone turning mischievous.
’What sort of surprise?’ Vritra asked curiously.
"Hehe, do I need to define what the word surprise means?
You will have to wait a little longer to know it." She teased, enjoying keeping him in suspense.
’Fine, I will wait.’ Vritra said, rolling his eyes.
Then he pondered: ’Since Hell and Knight have finished absorbing all that energy, then the labyrinth must have already collapsed by now.
Then those three Demon Generals might really have fallen for my lie.
They might have gone to the small forest to wait for me.
If this went right, then I would be able to obtain new slaves.’
Then he gazed at his level that was still stuck at 1,999 and decided to use the empty 2nd Legion Stone as soon as possible.
The increase in each level after reaching the 2nd Legion rank was even more difficult and needed a large amount of experience points.
And Vritra had just gotten lucky, as he had killed more than six hundred powerful beings—mindless humans and the Grieves—even the Pope, who was at the 3rd Legion rank.
So he had accumulated a large amount of experience points.
Currently, his soul wraith inventory had expanded a little: Hellmancer, Dark Knight, Bob, Bobby, Ghoul, Ghost, and Psyche, his new soul wraith that possessed the abilities of the Grieves.
It even had the knowledge about the glyphs.
And right now, except for Bobby, all the soul wraiths were at least of the 2nd Legion rank.

Hellmancer and Dark Knight were at the beginning levels of the 4th Legion rank, Bob was in the middle of the 2nd Legion rank, Bobby at the peak of the 1st Legion rank, Ghoul and Ghost both close to the peak of the 2nd Legion rank, and Psyche in the middle levels of the 3rd Legion rank.
It was a bit messy for now, but Vritra was planning to raise the levels of all his soul wraiths.
’Sigh, it’s been so long.
When is the Misty Essence Mythic Halo going to come out?

There is no point in staying in this kingdom anymore otherwise, as the danger will only increase the longer I stay here.’ Vritra thought as he relaxed between the two women who were sleeping peacefully despite it being afternoon and bright outside.
’I will do all that later.
For now, I just need a good long rest.’ Vritra yawned and felt his eyelids becoming heavy.
He glanced at Diana and spoke: "Why don’t you rest as well?"
"O-Oh, can I?" the goddess stood up with hope in her eyes.
She wouldn’t have minded sleeping on top of him, resting her head over his chest, and enjoying embracing him.
"Yeah, go back to your room and rest all you want." Vritra barely stopped himself from laughing when her expression shifted from eager to utter disappointment.
She made it so obvious.
’Don’t tell me... did he lose all interest in me already?’ the goddess felt depressed as she walked out of the room in a daze.
She glanced back at the three one last time before closing the door.
Then she headed back to her room in misery.
"Hahaha, it is hard to believe it is the same goddess from some time ago.
You have really trained her well." Yasmine laughed.
The goddess was becoming cuter by the day.
’I am practicing.
After all, I need to tame my Dragon Queen in the future.’ Vritra replied, keeping his eyes open with a little difficulty.
"What do you mean tame?
I am already yours.
I would just love whatever you do to me..."
While talking to her, Vritra soon fell asleep, and Yasmine decided to rest too.
When out of nowhere all the members of the temple disappeared—even the Pope—the four men from the Golden Moon became even more confident in their belief that they truly might be possessed by Grieves.
They started searching all over the place for them for several days, even inside the small forest, but found absolutely nothing.
It was as if the earth had swallowed them all.
Not even the traces of the fight were found—all thanks to Hellmancer.
After a long rest, Vritra woke up when it had started to turn dark.
The other women were already awake and waiting for him to eat dinner together.
After washing his face to throw all sleepiness away, Vritra left his room.
Soon he sat along with the three women and ate dinner.
Finally, the peaceful and wholesome family time had returned, and Vritra always enjoyed it as long as it lasted.
After dinner, the women took a walk around the castle along with him and then went back to their rooms, while Vritra decided to pay the King a visit... a friendly one.

chapters.title: Chapter 248: Leaps and Bounds
paragraphs: Henry was relaxing in his room, he had just survived such a disaster after all. After begging in front of Vritra, all the misfortunes had suddenly stopped, he was more than happy with the result even though he had to throw out his dignity.
He was lying all alone in complete darkness, enjoying the new peace that he had lost an arm to achieve.
"Sigh, now nothing could go wrong with my life, but it’s a pity that my youngest had become like that. Well, I guess it is time to make a new youngest—"
Just then the door to his room burst open. The king was baffled as he hastily pulled the blanket to cover his precious body, leaking out a feminine sound:
"Kiyaaaaaah!!"
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Embarrassed +1}
Vritra: "..."
"Cough, I mean Aaaaaaaah." The king cleared his throat upon seeing Vritra and feeling embarrassed. Then he asked: "S- Sir, do you need me for something? Are you still angry at me?"
Since his left hand was cut off, he had added a fake hand. He could have just put back his original arm, but in fear of Vritra he decided not to.

"Yeah, as soon as possible try to gather as many soul potions as you can. I don’t care what you do, but gather a lot of them." Vritra said, standing at the gate. For some reason, he felt disgusted to take just a single step inside.
Especially after hearing that scream.
"S- Soul potions? Did you receive a soul-related injury or something? There were a lot of soul potions in the inventory—"
Henry paused, remembering that the inventory had been emptied by a mysterious thief, and the thief was most probably the guy in front of him.
"What about it?" Vritra asked in an emotionless tone.

"N- Nothing, sir. I will gather as many soul potions as I could. Oh wait, the money—" Henry paused again as he remembered that even the gold and other treasures were stolen, well, around half of them.
He looked back at Vritra, wondering how he was supposed to get the soul potions without the money. He needed to run the kingdom as well after all.
"Is there a problem?" Vritra asked.
"No, sir. I- I will do it as soon as possible, I will gather all the soul potions I could find." The king said as he deflated like a balloon, feeling miserable.
"Good, you will be a great king." Vritra approved with a nod and then disappeared, breaking into particles of dust.
’What kind of crazy dog bit me that day that I invited such a demon to my house... sob, I am scared, I don’t want to be the king anymore.’ Henry hugged the pillow like a baby and started crying.
[Fourth Dimension Activated]

He flew out of the castle and headed towards the Small Forest to level up, and maybe he could also find the three demon generals. Vritra cautiously entered the forest; after all, the members of the Golden Moon, Nine Pacts, and even the Grieves might be lingering there.
He sent Ghost away to see if the inheritance he had been waiting for had opened or not, and soon the soul wraith returned, delivering the sad news.
After checking the place where the battle had occurred previously, Vritra didn’t find anyone.
Then he travelled to a different and more desolate area. After scanning the area around with his Nether Eye, he didn’t sense anyone aside from a few beasts.
"This is the perfect place to make my great breakthrough. I wonder how many levels I will gain this time. After all, I did kill so many people."
Vritra mumbled to himself as he sat midair and took out the empty stone from his inventory and came out of fourth dimension.
It didn’t look all that much different from the 1st Legion rank stone he had used before.

"Hubby, let’s see how high you can go this time. The experience points you need for each succession of level is several times higher." Yasmine said. She loved seeing him grow strong step by step, though he was climbing way too fast.
"Yeah, let’s see how high I go this time." After muttering, he closed his eyes and started the process of absorbing the empty stone as it broke into tiny specks of energy and traveled into his body.
It was like a dam had broken as a vast amount of energy spread through his body. Vritra could clearly feel all the changes occurring, but it was just impossible to explain.

His surroundings were greatly affected as a strong storm flooded all around him, all the trees were pulled out—it was like a big tornado had appeared there. But Vritra was prepared, as he had already covered his surroundings with a barrier.

The phenomenon of entering the 2nd Legion rank was even more dramatic. Purple energy swarmed through the surrounding, leaving the area in an even worse state in a range of a couple of kilometers around him.
It took around an hour or so to finally complete the leveling-up process. Vritra finally opened his eyes and stretched his body.
"Haa, that’s sure refreshing..." Vritra mumbled. He definitely felt stronger, but it was hard to know exactly how much his combat strength had grown.
BOOM
A thundering sound exploded as Vritra suddenly clenched his fist. It was really as if a bomb had exploded. Even his presence had become a lot more terrifying.
"Don’t delay, let’s see your levels." Yasmine said hurriedly. She wanted to see his status window together with him.
"Yes, yes, my Queen, we will do as you say." Vritra smiled as he opened the status window and started reading.
Name: Vritra Arclis
Level: 2,589 (2nd Legion rank)
Class: Dust Lord (Rank: A) [SSS+(?)]
Title: The Cursed Hunter [Level 10]
Race: Demon God (Origin), Dragon
Vitality: 100%
Stats:
Intelligence: 60,409 (+1,000)
Luck: 512
[Allocation points:13,830]
"Woah, such a high jump. Great job, hubby." Yasmine praised him excitedly. Every victory seemed worth it when Vritra’s strength grew exponentially each time.
If he were to face those Grieves again, the fight would still be a bit difficult and take quite some time, but it would be a one-sided slaughter. They wouldn’t even be able to hurt him at all.
Though the Pope would still have been quite difficult to handle.
"Where should I put my allocation points..." Vritra pondered, and the answer wasn’t too difficult.
He divided some between Intelligence and Agility. With Shift in the store, he didn’t really need to think too much about this stuff.
Stats:
Intelligence: 68,239 (+1,000)
Luck: 512
[Allocation points:0]
"Now this looks better." Vritra mumbled. Then he added: "How about we use Shift with these stats? I wonder how big the improvement will be..."
Without wasting a moment, he used the skill.
[Shift Activated.]
[Strength + Endurance → Agility]
Agility: 187,773
Strength: 29,549
Endurance: 28,731

With a slight push forward, Vritra’s body shot like a rocket, covering more than a kilometer in an instant. His current speed was certainly dozens of times faster than before. Now he truly felt that he had grown stronger once again.
Just then, he sensed three presences approaching.

chapters.title: Chapter 249: Trapped
paragraphs: All of a sudden, Vritra sensed three presences approaching. They had probably noticed when he flew at such a high speed. He scanned the surroundings and, just as he expected, it was the three demon generals.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +3}

"L- Lord?!!" Thaddeus exclaimed as they caught sight of Vritra. His aura seemed even stronger than the last time. They had been away for such a short period, yet his strength seemed to have grown by a lot.
How can an ordinary human be capable of that? It has to be their lord, Voromir Zuke.
"So you are finally back." Vritra puffed out his chest and held his hands behind his back as he gazed at the three demon generals indifferently.
The three generals knelt in front of him. Even though Vritra was still weaker than them, they were shivering before him because of past trauma.

"W- We are sorry to have doubted you. Forgive us, lord. There is no way an ordinary human could control your core. But why didn’t you say anything the first time we met?" Silquor spoke, looking at Vritra with his head tilted.
"Hmm hmm. Good question." Vritra nodded as he flew towards the three generals, who were patiently waiting for an explanation.

But in the next moment, Vritra pulled out a leather slipper from his inventory and hit the faces of the three at lightning-fast speed. He had still kept Shift activated. Vritra even added a little bit of the demon lord’s energy to make them feel a little pain.
THWACK THWACK THWACK
"You garbage slaves, you believe you are worthy enough to receive an explanation from me, Voromir Zuke? It seems you have forgotten all your manners."
Vritra was frowning as if he was really angry. He didn’t even need to use his brain to play the part of this demon lord.
Just act arrogant and vulgar, reply to anything with slaps, and they wouldn’t doubt him one bit.
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +3}
"F- Forgive us, my lordddddd—" the three generals were so frightened they kept lowering their heads until their foreheads collided with the ground.

"I- I didn’t mean that! If we knew it was you before—no no no, it is our fault that we failed to recognize you earlier! We will accept whatever punishment you wish to give us." Morvik said hastily. The fearsome generals were really like chickens right now.
"..." Vritra slowly descended towards the ground and landed exactly in front of them. None of them even dared to raise their heads.
"Sigh. Forget it, you three are still just kids, and I am really happy that you have stayed loyal to me despite all these years since my death.
If you hadn’t brought that core near the labyrinth at that time, then I wouldn’t have been able to take this body." Vritra said, looking at his own body as if it felt foreign.
{Sin Point Gained: Shocked +3}
{Sin Point Gained: Looked up to +3}

"My lord..." the three looked up in reverence and joy at receiving his forgiveness. They thought he would certainly kill them for attacking him before, but it seemed death had changed him a lot, and they felt happy to see this new side of him.
"You remember the Nihil-Anima, right?" Vritra spoke as his aura suddenly became violent and his expression turned enraged.

"Of course, lord. That cursed thing is exactly what killed you before. You were just sacrificed by the demon god and then thrown away. It all happened because of that darned Mythic Halo." Silquor answered, his wrinkly skin shivering.

"Yes, even after my death, my fight with that Mythic Halo didn’t end. For the world, both of us were dead, but our legendary battle continued for years upon years." Vritra said in a dramatic tone while the three generals listened in awe. They were like little kids with stars in their eyes, listening to their idol.
{Sin Point Gained: Intrigued +3}
"A- And then, what happened?" Thaddeus asked curiously.
"Of course I defeated that Mythic Halo." Vritra said proudly, his head raised high as he extended his right hand, and invisible flames burst out of his palm.
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +3}
{Sin Point Gained: Amazed +3}
"Whoa!!" the three were flabbergasted as they stared at the Mythic Halo in a daze.

"L- Lord, you actually took down this thing that not even a demon god could subjugate? Even that other Mythic Halo was almost devoured by it, and you really became its owner?!!" Morvik asked in shock.
"Yes, I am the first lord of the Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo, and it is completely under my control. But don’t tell anyone about it." Vritra said, showing how much he trusted the three of them.

Silquor, Thaddeus, and Morvik felt even happier. Previously, their lord wouldn’t even share the smallest secrets with them, and now he shared such a big secret, so he really trusted them with his life.
It seemed their effort in trying to bring him back was worth it.
Finally, Vritra cleared his throat and brought their attention towards him: "Now, I want to ask if the three of you want to follow me in the future or live your own lives.
But I can promise you one thing—this time we will be a lot stronger than before and reach much higher. I will make even the gods kneel."

"..." All three of them felt goosebumps as they imagined such a great future. How could they deny it? So they readily nodded their heads: "Yes, lord. Even in the future, we wish to be your loyal soldiers. We will follow every single one of your commands."

"I completely trust you, but just like how you had a doubt about me in your mind, I have a slight doubt. And until that doubt has disappeared, we can’t be a family." Vritra said as his expression turned solemn.
’F- Family? He called us his family?’ The generals were once again baffled and overjoyed as they hit their heads against the ground and shouted in a voice full of energy:
"Lord, just give us an order and we will prove our loyalty to you!"
As he looked down at the three kneeling generals, a big, evil, and twisted smile spread across his face. Everything was going according to his plan.
"Ooof, that evil smile—I love it!!" Yasmine was laughing hard all this while. Her hubby was too great of an actor.

"It is sort of a formality, just a simple test, nothing much. After this, I will be completely sure that you are 100% loyal to me. You don’t have to do anything..." Vritra paused as he once again brought Nihil-Anima out, over his palm.
"This Mythic Halo, as you know, is connected to souls, and it has a hidden ability that allows me to see if you hold any negative thoughts against me.

So I will just send this flame to search through your soul. Don’t reject it even if it feels a bit weird and uncomfortable—it is a very, very simple test of your loyalty." He explained, his expression returning to a calming smile.
Even the generals were confused about it, but how could they reject their lord’s offer of becoming a family with him? It was going to be a simple little test anyway.
{Sin Point Gained: Trapped +3}
"Yes, lord, please go ahead." The three agreed, pushing each other back to gain his trust first.

"..." All three of them felt goosebumps as they imagined such a great future.
How could they deny it?
So they readily nodded their heads: "Yes, lord.
Even in the future, we wish to be your loyal soldiers.
We will follow every single one of your commands."
"I completely trust you, but just like how you had a doubt about me in your mind, I have a slight doubt.
And until that doubt has disappeared, we can’t be a family." Vritra said as his expression turned solemn.
’F- Family?
He called us his family?’ The generals were once again baffled and overjoyed as they hit their heads against the ground and shouted in a voice full of energy:
"Lord, just give us an order and we will prove our loyalty to you!"
As he looked down at the three kneeling generals, a big, evil, and twisted smile spread across his face.
Everything was going according to his plan.
"Ooof, that evil smile—I love it!!" Yasmine was laughing hard all this while.
Her hubby was too great of an actor.
"It is sort of a formality, just a simple test, nothing much.
After this, I will be completely sure that you are 100% loyal to me.
You don’t have to do anything..." Vritra paused as he once again brought Nihil-Anima out, over his palm.
"This Mythic Halo, as you know, is connected to souls, and it has a hidden ability that allows me to see if you hold any negative thoughts against me.
So I will just send this flame to search through your soul.
Don’t reject it even if it feels a bit weird and uncomfortable—it is a very, very simple test of your loyalty." He explained, his expression returning to a calming smile.
Even the generals were confused about it, but how could they reject their lord’s offer of becoming a family with him?
It was going to be a simple little test anyway.
{Sin Point Gained: Trapped +3}
"Yes, lord, please go ahead." The three agreed, pushing each other back to gain his trust first.

chapters.title: Chapter 250: Just leave if you don’t trust me...
paragraphs: {Sin Point Gained: Trapped +3}

"Yes, lord, please go ahead." The three agreed, pushing each other back to gain his trust first. Nihil-Anima was a terrifying entity even among the mythic halos, so they didn’t doubt what he had just said.
"..." Vritra showed a faint smile at seeing their enthusiasm. He looked at Thaddeus and said: "You come forth first."
"T- Thank you, my lord, I will forever be your loyal subject." Thaddeus showed a grin to the other two, then stood up proudly in front of Vritra.

He was like a giant, Vritra had to hover a bit higher to balance the height. Then he pressed his palm against Thaddeus’s chest, and sent the invisible flame into his body. The demon generals were very strong—if they put just a little resistance, Vritra would undoubtedly fail. That’s why he put up such an act.
But even so, this wasn’t going to be easy.
Nihil-Anima entered into Thaddeus’s body and went directly for his soul.
The demon general’s brows furrowed slightly at the strange and uncomfortable sensation, but he didn’t resist at all. Otherwise, wouldn’t he look like he had bad thoughts for his lord?

Then the invisible flames started surrounding his soul, slowly trying to trap it, just like how it went with Diana. Thaddeus gritted his teeth, it was becoming more and more uncomfortable, but the general persevered even though he was becoming more doubtful.
’What is going on? Is this really just a test?’ Thaddeus thought. His soul was highly rejecting this feeling, but he trusted Voromir Zuke with his life, so he didn’t raise any sort of question.
Nihil-Anima had to work quite hard to subdue such a strong soul. It took nearly half an hour, and finally Thaddeus had turned into his slave.
"Alright, done. I am now sure that you are perfectly loyal to me." Vritra said as he pulled back, and glanced at Silquor.
"Thank you, my lord." Thaddeus bowed, and in his joy he completely ignored the strange sensation present in his soul that soon disappeared.
He had finally become a loyal slave. No matter how high his level was compared to Vritra, he would never be able to disobey him.
"Silquor." Vritra called out as the old demon general straightened his body and stood on his toes to look taller.
Vritra had to land on the ground before starting the same process for the second time, and it went exactly like the first. It wasn’t long before Vritra obtained another slave.
"You are indeed loyal to me, I will trust you completely in the future." Vritra said as he patted his shoulder, and then glanced at Morvik and nodded.
"Hoo, my lord, I pledge my loyalty to you." Morvik stood up and bowed his head, feeling acknowledged.
Vritra ignored the constant pouring of messages of sin points. He smiled faintly and pressed his palm against Morvik’s chest.
The same process began for the third time. Nihil-Anima seemed a bit exhausted now; taking control of the strong souls of these demon generals wasn’t an easy task after all.
"Ughh M- My lord, is this normal? I feel like my soul is being chained..." Morvik muttered, his expression twisting as he barely resisted the urge to resist the changes.

Vritra frowned. He suddenly pulled his hand back, leaving the Nihil-Anima inside his body, and glared at Morvik before raising his hand and giving a hard slap with a leather slipper that had appeared in his hand at some point.

"It seems your trust in me is completely broken, and I can’t bring a person into my family who can’t even trust me. If any outsider ever tried to sow discord between us, then I am sure you would be the first one to betray me. Thaddeus and Silquor are enough, you can just leave!!" Vritra’s voice was filled with anger and disappointment.

"Tch. Lord, I have always had my doubts about this bastard. Just the two of us will be enough to fight alongside you, we don’t need a traitor." Thaddeus said, ready to break his friendship for his lord.
"Yes, lord, should I just kill him for showing such disrespect towards you?" Silquor asked, ready to launch an attack at any moment.

"N- No, my lord, that’s not what I meant. P- Please forgive me for my insolence..." Morvik, the silent and mysterious general, instantly fell to his knees, feeling abandoned and regretting speaking just now.
"No, just leave if you don’t trust me." Vritra said, raising his head high.
"B- But my lord, I trust you completely—" Morvik really looked as if he was about to break down.
"No, just leave if you don’t trust me." Vritra said, raising his head even higher.
"Please forgive me, I- I will prove to you—" Morvik tried to speak but was interrupted by Vritra as he spoke again:
"No, just leave if you don’t trust me."
"Sigh... fine, my lord. If—" Morvik resigned himself to his fate and decided to repent for the remainder of his life.
"Alright, since you are begging so much, I will give you another chance." Vritra said as he suddenly put his hand over Morvik’s shoulder and continued with the process.

"Looks like my doubts were for naught. As I expected, all three are devoted followers. In the future, we are going to achieve great things and make even the gods kneel in front of us." Vritra said, his voice giving motivation to the three generals.
"But first tell me, aside from trying to bring me back to life, what else have you been doing?" he asked suddenly.
The generals were standing in front of him, their bodies bent slightly to show respect. Silquor took a step forward and spoke: "Please allow me to speak, my lord."
’Oof, these overly dramatic demons... sigh, I will play along...’ Vritra thought and nodded. Whether they knew the truth now or not wouldn’t make much of a difference.
But it was better that they were going to work for him of their own will, so he didn’t tell them anything yet.

"Most of our time and efforts were spent in trying to locate you and finding the necessary items to bring you back. But we had also been taking care of your kingdom, your subjects. After your death, most of your soldiers and normal demons left to live in other demon lord’s territories. But many, who were loyal to you, stayed there. In the Voromir Kingdom, there are still a few thousand demons who believed you would come back. They would all be overjoyed if they found out you are back. So, my lord, why don’t we head there?" Silquor spoke respectfully.
"..." Vritra wanted to ask where that place exactly was, but that would blow his cover. He could use memory loss or such excuses, but that wasn’t optimal.

And like always, one of his two saviors instantly came to his rescue as Yasmine spoke: "They don’t live on their planet but in a different dimensional realm which is connected to this planet via a dimensional rift."
’Thank you, wifey, you are the best. I love you...’ Vritra said before questioning: "I doubt they would be living in the same realm after I was gone."
